source.file: 雅思听力历年真题中英文本.docx

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning Wilson Drama School. How may I help you today?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好，威尔逊戏剧学校。今天能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. I'd like to find out more about the training programs you offer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。我想了解更多关于你们提供的培训项目的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Of course. First, could I get some of your information so I can fill out the student form for you? No problem. My name is Jan Creswick. Could you spell your surname, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然可以。首先，我能获取您的一些信息以便为您填写学生表格吗？没问题。我叫简·克雷斯威克。能拼一下您的姓吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: C-R-E-S-W-I-C-K.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: C-R-E-S-W-I-C-K。

transcriptBlocks.english: Got it. Thanks. Have you taken any courses with us before?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 记下了。谢谢。您以前在我们这里上过课吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes. I studied theatre in your school around 60 years ago.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的。大约60年前我在你们学校学过戏剧。

transcriptBlocks.english: Let me check your student profile. Here we go. I can see your record on my computer. Has your address changed since then? No.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我查一下您的学生档案。找到了。我在电脑上看到了您的记录。您的地址从那以后变过吗？没有。

transcriptBlocks.english: No. What I've got on file is number 79 Place Avenue.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 没有。我存档的地址是普莱斯大道79号。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's incorrect. It should be Palace Street.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那不对。应该是帕莱斯街。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. I've corrected the information. Since you've had some training before, is acting your current profession? Unfortunately, I haven't had a chance to work as an actress since I finished that course. I'm working as a waitress in a downtown restaurant now. But acting has been my passion for a long time and I want to take it seriously.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。我已经更正了信息。既然您以前有过一些培训，表演是您当前的职业吗？不幸的是，自从完成那门课程后，我还没有机会做演员。我现在在市中心的一家餐厅做服务员。但表演一直是我的热情所在，我想认真对待它。

transcriptBlocks.english: What kinds of workshops are you interested in? We offer a wide range of options including theatre, musical and opera workshop, as well as preparatory programs for beginners.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 您对哪种工作坊感兴趣？我们提供多种选择，包括戏剧、音乐剧和歌剧工作坊，以及初学者的预备课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, I often have shifts in the evening, so I can only attend classes in the afternoon. Are there any classes available then? Absolutely. We have two workshops for the afternoon. There's the classical track, which is all about drama and Shakespeare. Or the comic track, which covers improvisation, timing and different performance styles.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我经常晚上轮班，所以只能参加下午的课程。那段时间有课吗？当然。我们有两个下午的工作坊。一个是古典方向，主要关于戏剧和莎士比亚。或者喜剧方向，涵盖即兴表演、节奏把控和不同的表演风格。

transcriptBlocks.english: I've seen some plays of Shakespeare, but watching and acting can be a different story. Well, it could be challenging for some students, but the good news is our workshop is designed to break down the language and make performing Shakespeare feel accessible, even for beginners.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我看过一些莎士比亚的戏剧，但观看和表演可能是两码事。嗯，对有些学生来说可能有挑战性，但好消息是我们的工作坊旨在分解语言，让表演莎士比亚变得易于上手，即使对初学者也是如此。

transcriptBlocks.english: Honestly, this is a potential career for me, so I need something practical. Which track do you think offers more professional opportunities? If making a living is the goal, comedy is the more practical path right now. Plus, our instructors have extensive industry connections and often help students network with casting directors.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 老实说，这对我来说是一个潜在的职业，所以我需要一些实用的东西。您觉得哪个方向提供更多的职业机会？如果以谋生为目标，喜剧是当前更实际的路径。此外，我们的导师有广泛的行业人脉，经常帮助学生与选角导演建立联系。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, you've sold me. I'll go with that one.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，您说服我了。我就选那个。

transcriptBlocks.english: What are the fees for this program? It's £450 for the full eight-week program. However, since you previously took classes with us, we offer a 20% discount for returning students. That brings it down to £360.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这个项目的费用是多少？完整的八周课程是450英镑。不过，由于您之前在我们这里上过课，我们为返校学生提供20%的折扣。这样降到360英镑。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's quite reasonable, and the discount really helps.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那相当合理，折扣确实很有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: When does the workshop start? The next session starts in three days, on the 30th of May. Would that work for you? Oh, I'm quite occupied this weekend, next week. Let me check other sessions. How about the 13th of June? That works for me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 工作坊什么时候开始？下一期三天后开始，5月30日。您方便吗？哦，我这周末和下周都很忙。我看看其他时间。6月13日怎么样？那可以。

transcriptBlocks.english: Perfect, I'll sign you up. Please arrive by 5.30pm.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了，我给您报名。请在下午5：30前到达。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, I'll keep that in mind.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我会记住的。

transcriptBlocks.english: We also provide some snacks during the training. Do you have any food allergies or dietary restrictions? I'm more of a vegetarian these days. I eat less meat, and more importantly, I can't have anything that contains milk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们在培训期间也提供一些点心。您有任何食物过敏或饮食限制吗？我现在更偏向素食。我少吃肉，更重要的是，我不能吃任何含牛奶的东西。

transcriptBlocks.english: Noted.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 记下了。

transcriptBlocks.english: By the way, how did you hear about our workshops? We've done a lot of advertising in newspapers this year. Perhaps you saw something there? Not really. I like to search for courses on the internet, and I came across your programs one day when I was doing online research.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 顺便问一下，您是怎么听说我们的工作坊的？我们今年在报纸上做了很多广告。也许您在那里看到了？不完全是。我喜欢在网上搜索课程，有一天我在做在线研究时偶然看到了你们的项目。

transcriptBlocks.english: I see.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我明白了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Will there be any materials I should review before the first session? All course information will be included in the leaflet, so you'll have a clear overview of what to expect. We'll mail it to you next week.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在第一次上课前有什么材料需要我预习吗？所有课程信息都会包含在手册里，这样您就能清楚了解课程内容。我们下周会寄给您。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ah, that's helpful. And if you have any other questions before the first session, don't hesitate to call or email. We look forward to seeing you soon.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 啊，那很有帮助。如果在第一次上课前您还有其他问题，请随时打电话或发邮件。我们期待很快见到您。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thanks. Bye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢。再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. Is this Rocky's stream farm?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。是洛基溪农场吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: You are at the right place. What can I do for you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你找对地方了。我能为你做什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: Great. I'd like to make a reservation for a group visit next month.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。我想为下个月的团体参观做一个预订。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay. How many people are in the group? Nearly 40. The exact number is still uncertain.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。团里有几个人？将近40人。确切人数还不确定。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, our current capacity is up to 38 people per session. While we hope to accommodate more next year, it's not yet confirmed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我们目前的接待能力是每场最多38人。虽然我们希望明年能接待更多人，但还没有确认。

transcriptBlocks.english: I understand. Do you happen to have a meeting room or indoor activities? Yes. But unfortunately, it's currently closed due to some recent issues.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我理解。你们有会议室或室内活动吗？有的。但不幸的是，由于最近的一些问题，目前关闭了。

transcriptBlocks.english: May I ask why? We had a big storm here last week and the roof leaked badly. The whole room got damaged and needs fixing.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我能问为什么吗？上周这里有一场大风暴，屋顶漏水很严重。整个房间都损坏了，需要修理。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's too bad. By the way, do you need any food service? Yes. Tell me more.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太可惜了。顺便问一下，你们需要餐饮服务吗？是的。告诉我更多。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, our meal options are pretty flexible. You're welcome to dine out at nearby restaurants or use the cooking facilities in our central kitchen. If you'd like to try some specialties of our farm, just let us know in advance. We'll arrange a chef for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我们的用餐选择相当灵活。你们可以去附近的餐馆用餐，或使用我们中央厨房的烹饪设施。如果你们想品尝我们农场的特色菜，提前告诉我们就行。我们会为你们安排一位厨师。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great. What activities can we do on the farm this year? I remember you had a tractor demonstration before. Is that still operating? We don't have that anymore. We have a few new activities, such as taking pictures with our star sheep and cows.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。今年我们在农场可以做什么活动？我记得你们以前有拖拉机演示。那个还在运营吗？我们不再有了。我们有一些新活动，比如和我们的明星羊和牛拍照。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our group is all adults. Do you offer anything more educational? For sure, we have a few fields where organic produce is grown. And visitors can join interactive activities that help them understand how organic farming works. This is suitable for people of all ages.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们团全是成年人。你们提供更有教育意义的活动吗？当然，我们有几块种植有机农产品的田地。游客可以参加互动活动，帮助他们了解有机农业是如何运作的。这适合所有年龄段的人。

transcriptBlocks.english: Moreover, we run a survival course and it's getting popular. Oh, what is it about? It's basically about learning to survive in nature. Our local woodland, which offers a beautiful and immersive experience, will be the classroom where people practice the skills to find what's suitable to eat. In case of dehydration, we have set up pumps in different spots to provide drinking water. This course is perfect for people who want to go camping or hiking in the wild.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，我们还开设了一个生存课程，越来越受欢迎。哦，是关于什么的？基本上是学习在大自然中生存。我们当地的林地提供了美丽和沉浸式的体验，将是人们练习寻找可食用物品技能的课堂。为了应对脱水情况，我们在不同地点设置了水泵提供饮用水。这门课非常适合想去野外露营或徒步的人。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sounds great. We'd love to sign up for it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来很棒。我们很想报名参加。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, I've made a note of that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我记下了。

transcriptBlocks.english: If we want to take a look at the areas nearby, what's the best way? Maybe go horseback riding? We used to have some horses, but they now belong to another farm, which is quite a distance away.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果我们想看看附近的地方，最好的方式是什么？也许骑马？我们以前有一些马，但现在它们属于另一个农场，距离相当远。

transcriptBlocks.english: Then would going for a walk be fine? Well, we do have a few walking paths, but they're currently unavailable due to maintenance and seasonal flooding risk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那散步可以吗？嗯，我们确实有几条步行道，但由于维护和季节性洪水风险，目前无法使用。

transcriptBlocks.english: How about a cycling tour? You can hire bicycles and enjoy the surrounding views. It's quite relaxing and fun. What if it rains? If the weather turns bad, we'll arrange a shuttle to the town museum, which is hosting a special historical exhibit right now.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 骑自行车游览怎么样？你们可以租自行车，享受周围的美景。这很放松又有趣。如果下雨呢？如果天气变坏，我们会安排班车去镇上的博物馆，那里目前正在举办一个特别的历史展览。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds like a great backup.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那听起来是个不错的备选方案。

transcriptBlocks.english: How long do you plan to stay? Probably three or four days. We're running a special rate on our three night stay package, about $100 per person. For four nights, we can quote you a similar discounted rate.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们计划住多久？大概三四天。我们的三晚住宿套餐有特别优惠，大约每人100美元。如果住四晚，我们可以给你类似的折扣价。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's great. Can I pay by check? No problem. Either way, the booking requires a 50% deposit. Please note that the deposit is non-refundable if you cancel.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。我可以支票支付吗？没问题。不管怎样，预订需要50%的订金。请注意，如果取消预订，订金不予退还。

transcriptBlocks.english: So can the rest of the fees be paid when we arrive? Yes, that's correct.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么剩余的费用可以在我们到达时支付吗？是的，没错。

transcriptBlocks.english: Before I go, I'd like to confirm your address. Sure. It's 13 Cotehele Road, Blackmarsh. That's C-O-T-E-H-E-L-E.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我走之前，我想确认一下你的地址。当然。是布莱克马什的科特赫尔路13号。拼写是C-O-T-E-H-E-L-E。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, and the postcode I've got is SH121LQ. Oh, it should be SH121LQ. The old postcode is no longer in use. Got it. Thanks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我记下的邮编是SH121LQ。哦，应该是SH121LQ。旧邮编不再使用了。知道了。谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, city council, how may I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好，市议会，我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh hi, I got a flyer at the mall the other day, about the Peterson Summer Festival coming up in June, but I couldn't find it now. So I'm calling for more information about this festival.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦嗨，我前几天在商场拿了一张传单，是关于六月份即将到来的彼得森夏季节的，但我现在找不到了。所以我打电话来了解更多关于这个节日的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh no problem. I can tell you what's going to happen at the event. There are some fun things to do for three days in a row.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦没问题。我可以告诉您活动期间会发生什么。连续三天都有一些有趣的事情可以做。

transcriptBlocks.english: On the 19th at 7pm, there is a live concert by our local band, the Jones Brothers. Their tickets aren't cheap, you know. But, it's totally free this year!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 19日晚上7点，我们的本地乐队琼斯兄弟有一场现场音乐会。他们的票可不便宜，你知道的。但今年完全免费！

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh great, I love seeing them play. Where is that being held? They usually play at the town hall, don't they? Well this one is at the theatre, so weather won't be a concern.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦太好了，我喜欢看他们表演。在哪里举行？他们通常在市政厅演出，对吧？嗯，这次在剧院，所以不用担心天气。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds nice. I wonder what refreshments will be provided there. Will there be beer and...wine? No, there won't be any alcohol. Soft drinks will be available instead.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来不错。我想知道那里会提供什么茶点。会有啤酒和……葡萄酒吗？不，不会有任何酒精饮料。会有软饮料。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's good to hear. I can bring my son along then. Now that he's getting a little older, I think he would enjoy the band as well. What other activities are planned for the event?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那太好了。那我可以带我儿子一起去。现在他长大了一点，我想他也会喜欢这个乐队的。活动还计划了什么其他活动？

transcriptBlocks.english: Well on the 20th, there is a tour of a medieval castle. It recently opened, and I think this is a good opportunity for visitors with children.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，20日有一个中世纪城堡之旅。它最近开放了，我觉得这对带孩子的游客来说是个好机会。

transcriptBlocks.english: It sounds so interesting. What time is the tour? Is that in the evening as well? No, this event is scheduled in the afternoon at 4:30. As it's a newly developed area, the restaurants are still under renovation. So we suggest you bring your own food and drinks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来好有趣。游览是什么时间？也是在晚上吗？不，这个活动安排在下午4：30。由于这是一个新开发的区域，餐馆仍在装修中。所以我们建议您自带食物和饮料。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's not a problem. Where is the meeting point? Is it near the train station? Nope, this time you will see the tour guide at the bus station. Don't forget to wear comfortable shoes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那不是问题。集合点在哪里？在火车站附近吗？不，这次您会在公交车站看到导游。别忘了穿舒适的鞋子。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay I will. Is there a children's singing competition this year? That was fun last year! No, this year will be a cooking competition instead. That's actually happening on the third and final day of the festival, the 21st, and it's being held in the city centre.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的我会的。今年有儿童歌唱比赛吗？去年那个很有趣！不，今年将是一个烹饪比赛。实际上那是在节日的第三天也是最后一天，21日，在市中心举行。

transcriptBlocks.english: What is the age limit for the competition? It's mainly designed for young people. If you have children aged between 11-15 years old, you can sign up for them and give it a try. The prize is really special this year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 比赛的年龄限制是多少？主要是为年轻人设计的。如果您的孩子在11到15岁之间，您可以给他们报名试一试。今年的奖品真的很特别。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great! My son just turned 11 years old, it should be a wonderful opportunity for him to showcase his baking skills.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了！我儿子刚满11岁，这对他来说应该是一个展示烘焙技巧的好机会。

transcriptBlocks.english: Will the contestants need to bring anything, such as food materials, for the competition? Um... let me see... You won't need to bring ingredients, as those are provided for the on-site challenge. But yes, all participants should bring a plate with them. It's for presenting their finished dish to the judges for tasting.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 参赛者需要自带什么东西吗，比如食材？嗯……让我看看……您不需要带食材，因为这些会为现场挑战提供。但是的，所有参赛者都应该带一个盘子。这是为了把他们完成的菜品呈现给评委品尝。

transcriptBlocks.english: Got that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 明白了。

transcriptBlocks.english: And there is a special fireworks night that wraps up the festival this year, also on the 21st, on the same day as the competition. It should be a lot of fun. Really?! My husband and I always love that. Where is that being held--at the beach, I guess? Actually no. The fireworks display will take place alongside the river.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 今年还有一场特别的烟花之夜为节日画上句号，也是在21日，和比赛同一天。应该会很有趣。真的？！我丈夫和我一直很喜欢那个。在哪里举行——在海滩，我猜？实际上不是。烟花表演将在河边举行。

transcriptBlocks.english: That is a wonderful spot for taking pictures! It is. Don't forget to bring your camera. I wonder what time the fireworks show will end? It can't last for too long. The activity will finish at 10.15pm. Oh, that's a little late in our case, but it's okay for a special occasion.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那真是拍照的好地方！是的。别忘了带相机。我想知道烟花表演几点结束？不可能持续太久。活动将在晚上10：15结束。哦，对我们来说有点晚，但特殊场合没关系。

transcriptBlocks.english: Just a heads-up, will you be driving that day? I think so. Is there a problem? They only offer a small parking lot which only accommodates around 100 cars. And you can't reserve a spot, so first come, first served.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 提醒一下，您那天会开车吗？我想是的。有问题吗？他们只提供一个小停车场，只能容纳大约100辆车。而且不能预订车位，所以先到先得。

transcriptBlocks.english: Looks like we have to take public transport then. Well, the good news is they offer free pickups for the guests this year. You can check their website www.events.com to see whether there is a pickup point near your home.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 看来我们得坐公共交通了。嗯，好消息是他们今年为客人提供免费接送。您可以查看他们的网站www.events.com，看看您家附近是否有接送点。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's good to know. I'll take a look later.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 很高兴知道。我稍后去看看。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have further questions, requests, or anything else you'd like to communicate, you can give your feedback through the website. Someone will call you back in 24 hours.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果您有其他问题、要求或任何其他想沟通的事情，您可以通过网站提供反馈。会有人在24小时内给您回电。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thanks for letting me know. You're welcome. Hope you have a great time at the festival!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢您告诉我。不客气。祝您在节日玩得开心！

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning, welcome to the Eastwood community office, how can I help you today?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好，欢迎来到伊斯特伍德社区办公室，今天能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hi, I'm trying to find a school for my child. Have I come to the right place? Yes, you're in the right place. We can help you with the school application process. Are you hoping to enrol your child this year or next?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗨，我想为我的孩子找一所学校。我来对地方了吗？是的，您来对地方了。我们可以帮您处理学校申请流程。您是希望今年还是明年为孩子注册？

transcriptBlocks.english: I'd like to enrol her this year, if it's not too late.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果不算太晚的话，我想今年给她注册。

transcriptBlocks.english: Let me see... we currently have two schools with vacancies: Montery Elementary School and Monstone Elementary School. We've just moved to Hurst Street. Which school is closest to us? Ideally, I'd like to be able to walk my daughter to school every day. Based on your address, Montery Elementary School would be the best option. It's within walking distance from Hurst Street.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我看看……我们目前有两所学校有名额：蒙特里小学和蒙斯通小学。我们刚搬到赫斯特街。哪所学校离我们最近？理想情况下，我希望能每天步行送女儿上学。根据您的地址，蒙特里小学是最佳选择。从赫斯特街步行即可到达。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds perfect! Can you spell the name of the school for me? Sure! It's spelled M-O-N-T-E-R-Y. For Monterey Elementary registration, you will need to visit the school library, where the registration center is currently located. The staff will guide you through the process.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来太完美了！您能帮我拼一下学校的名字吗？当然！拼写是M-O-N-T-E-R-Y。对于蒙特里小学的注册，您需要去学校图书馆，注册中心目前在那里。工作人员会指导您完成整个流程。

transcriptBlocks.english: Got it, thank you. Before you head there, I'll help you fill out some preliminary forms here so that most of the details are ready before your visit. This will save you time during registration. Sounds great.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 明白了，谢谢。在您去那里之前，我会帮您在这里填写一些初步表格，这样您到访前大部分细节就准备好了。这会在注册时为您节省时间。听起来太好了。

transcriptBlocks.english: What is your daughter's name? Her name is Grace Campbell.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 您女儿叫什么名字？她叫格蕾丝·坎贝尔。

transcriptBlocks.english: May I ask what you do for work? This information is often required on school forms. I previously worked as a surgeon at the hospital, but due to high stress levels, I decided to pursue a different career path. Now I'm working as a dentist.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 可以问一下您做什么工作吗？学校表格上经常需要这些信息。我曾在医院做过外科医生，但由于工作压力太大，我决定走一条不同的职业道路。现在我是一名牙医。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay... How would you prefer to receive updates from school, text messages or mail? Mail would be better.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的……您希望如何接收学校的更新信息，短信还是邮件？邮件更好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Perfect, I'll note that down.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我记下来。

transcriptBlocks.english: If I have any questions about schoolwork or my daughter's performance, where can I get the answers? You can directly contact her teacher. This is usually done by scheduling a parent-teacher conference, which typically happens once a month. Additionally, you can check the school website for reports and updates.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果我对学业或女儿的表现有任何问题，在哪里可以得到答案？您可以直接联系她的老师。通常是通过安排家长会来进行，一般每月一次。此外，您可以在学校网站上查看报告和更新。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's good to know. Does the school provide meals during the day? Yes. They recently received funds to improve the pupils' meals, and they've decided to cover two meals every school day, which is great news for parents.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 很高兴知道。学校白天提供餐食吗？是的。他们最近收到了改善学生餐食的资金，他们决定每个上学日提供两餐，这对家长来说是个好消息。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's wonderful. Given that my daughter's a bit picky about food, I hope the meals will suit her taste. Most kids get used to school meals quickly, so it's likely that she'll enjoy eating at school.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。鉴于我女儿有点挑食，我希望餐食能合她的口味。大多数孩子很快就习惯了学校的餐食，所以她很可能会喜欢在学校吃饭。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, that's a relief. By the way, my wife and I finish work quite late, so I'm wondering if my child can stay at school til around 7 pm? Unfortunately, there is no after-school care available. You may consider the childcare centre two blocks away if your daughter needs it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，那就放心了。顺便问一下，我和妻子下班都很晚，所以我想知道我的孩子能否在学校待到晚上7点左右？不幸的是，学校没有课后托管服务。如果您的女儿需要，您可以考虑两个街区外的托儿中心。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, I will check it out later. Also, the transportation service by bus to and from school isn't available yet. The school hasn't had enough funds to arrange it so far this year. We won't need it anyway, living so close to the school. What is the date for Grace to start? I heard from my neighbour that some schools start late, around September. For your daughter's school, the new term will begin on the 1st August. The school will be open from that day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我之后去看看。另外，往返学校的巴士交通服务目前还没有。学校今年到目前为止还没有足够的资金来安排。反正我们也不需要，住得离学校这么近。格蕾丝什么时候开学？我从邻居那里听说有些学校开学晚，大约在九月。您女儿所在学校的新学期将于8月1日开始。学校从那天起开放。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, I didn't expect it to be that early. It's just two weeks away. I wonder where I can buy a school uniform for my daughter? No need to worry about that. The school will provide the clothing for free.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，我没想到这么早。只有两周了。我想知道在哪里给我女儿买校服？不用担心这个。学校会免费提供服装。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, that's nice. When and where can I pick it up? Friday works for me. You can go to the student service office, which is open until 5 o'clock in the afternoon, Monday to Friday. It's best to call them ahead of time to let them know the size you prefer. Here's the contact information. I've already registered you for the uniform pickup.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，那太好了。我什么时候在哪里可以领取？周五我可以。您可以去学生服务办公室，那里周一至周五开放到下午5点。最好提前打电话告诉他们您偏好的尺码。这是联系方式。我已经帮您登记了校服领取。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great, thanks! Just one more question, what are the regular school hours for the school? School starts for all grades at 8:00 am and finishes at 2:05pm, with a break in the middle for lunch at 11:30 am.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了，谢谢！还有一个问题，学校的常规上课时间是什么？所有年级早上8点开始上课，下午2：05放学，中间11：30有午餐休息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you so much for all your help.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 非常感谢您的所有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning, Rainbow Cleaning Services. How may I assist you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好，彩虹清洁服务。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, my name is Barbara Hill. I'm in need of house cleaning services.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好，我叫芭芭拉·希尔。我需要房屋清洁服务。

transcriptBlocks.english: You've certainly made the right choice to call us. May I know where you're located?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 您打电话给我们确实做出了正确的选择。能告诉我您的位置吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm in Southeast London. Do you cover that area?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我在伦敦东南部。你们服务那个区域吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Absolutely, we service that area frequently. Could you please provide your postcode for our records? Sure, it's SW100... Sorry let me check, it should be SW1050.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，我们经常服务那个区域。能提供您的邮编以便我们记录吗？当然，是SW100……抱歉让我查一下，应该是SW1050。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you. May I know the number of rooms that you would like us to clean? Yes. There are three rooms in my house. The two double rooms are the ones that need deep dusting. It's been a while since they were cleaned. The third room, you'd better be careful. I used it as an office. I have some important files and equipment in the room.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢。能告诉我您需要我们清洁的房间数量吗？好的。我家有三个房间。两个双人房需要深度除尘。有一段时间没打扫了。第三个房间，你们最好小心一点。我把它用作办公室。房间里有重要的文件和设备。

transcriptBlocks.english: Understood. The last cleaning company I hired, they messed up with the wires and my router, which caused me two days to fix. I hope your staff have been thoroughly trained. I don't want to see that happen again.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 明白了。我上次雇的清洁公司把电线和路由器弄得一团糟，我花了两天时间才修好。我希望你们的员工受过充分培训。我不想再看到那种情况发生。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh you can rest assured with us, madam. We treat our clients' belongings with extra caution and haven't received any complaints like that before. OK, hope we can have a good start.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，女士，您可以放心。我们对待客户的物品格外小心，以前从未收到过那样的投诉。好的，希望能有个好的开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's for sure. Any other areas for cleaning? Yes, my kitchen and conservatory need a thorough cleaning, but the lounge just needs a quick tidy-up.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那是肯定的。还有其他区域需要清洁吗？是的，我的厨房和阳光房需要彻底清洁，但客厅只需快速整理一下。

transcriptBlocks.english: I've noted the requests. By the way, do you offer any gardening services? Unfortunately, we don't provide that at the moment, but we do offer bed linen changes and we're planning to add window cleaning soon. Would that be of interest? Yes. I'd love to have some help with bedding changes. Do you offer regular cleaning packages for mats and other items? Absolutely, we can schedule mat cleaning monthly and carpet cleaning every three months if you're interested. Additionally, we have a special promotion this month where you can add annual furniture cleaning to your package at a discounted rate.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我已经记下了这些要求。顺便问一下，你们提供园艺服务吗？不幸的是，我们目前不提供这个，但我们提供更换床单服务，并且计划很快增加擦窗服务。您感兴趣吗？是的。我想在换床单方面得到一些帮助。你们提供地垫和其他物品的定期清洁套餐吗？当然，如果您感兴趣，我们可以安排每月清洗地垫，每季度清洗地毯。此外，我们这个月有一个特别促销活动，您可以以折扣价将年度家具清洁添加到您的套餐中。

transcriptBlocks.english: I'll opt for the carpet cleaning package. Wonderful choice! In addition to those cleaning services, we also offer a premium deep cleaning option for your bathroom surfaces. This includes a thorough scrubbing of tiles, and grout to ensure a sparkling clean finish. No, that's not needed right now.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我选地毯清洁套餐。很好的选择！除了那些清洁服务，我们还提供浴室表面的高级深度清洁选项。包括彻底擦洗瓷砖和填缝剂，以确保闪亮干净的效果。不，现在不需要。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's OK! We aim to provide comprehensive cleaning solutions for our customers. Would you like to know more about our laundry service for washing and ironing? Well, I have an automatic washing machine at home, but I find it difficult to make time for ironing. I have over 15 shirts to iron every week, and it's really time-consuming.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 没关系！我们旨在为客户提供全面的清洁解决方案。您想了解更多关于我们洗衣和熨烫服务的信息吗？嗯，我家里有自动洗衣机，但我发现很难抽出时间熨烫。我每周有超过15件衬衫要熨，真的很费时。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, we can help with that. How about having a free trial first? If you find it helpful, we'll move on to a regular package. Yeah, that works for me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，我们可以帮您解决。先免费试一次怎么样？如果您觉得有用，我们就转为常规套餐。好的，那对我适用。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, let's set up a time to start our services and ensure that everything is taken care of. Now, I just need to take down a few more of your personal details. What is your exact address? It's Amyes Street, on the corner. I assume it's spelled A-M-I-E-S? That's incorrect. It's spelled A-M-Y-E-S. The house is distinguished by the stone wall surrounding it and the oak tree in the garden.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，让我们安排开始服务的时间，确保一切都能妥善处理。现在，我只需要再记录一些您的个人信息。您的确切地址是什么？是艾米斯街，在拐角处。我猜拼写是A-M-I-E-S？不对。拼写是A-M-Y-E-S。房子的特点是周围的石墙和花园里的橡树。

transcriptBlocks.english: Understood. And which days are you available to have someone come and clean for you? Perhaps Wednesday would be suitable, as we have no other plans. Unfortunately, we don't have any available cleaners on Wednesdays this month. Would Mondays be convenient for you? No, we have a doctor's appointment on that day. What about Thursdays? That works.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 明白了。您哪天方便让人来清洁？也许周三比较合适，因为我们没有其他安排。不幸的是，我们这个月周三没有清洁工有空。周一您方便吗？不，那天我们有医生预约。周四呢？可以。

transcriptBlocks.english: How long would you like us to clean for? The maximum duration of the service is three hours, whether it's on a weekly or fortnightly basis. Oh, that's good for me. I'd prefer a high level of cleaning in my house. We tend to keep things tidy.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 您希望我们清洁多长时间？无论是每周还是每两周一次，服务的最长时长是三小时。哦，那对我来说很好。我希望我家能有高水平的清洁。我们平时也保持整洁。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, I have noted down all your information and will arrange for someone to visit you. Is there anything else I can help you with? No, all good. Thank you very much for your assistance.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我已经记下了您的所有信息，会安排人上门。还有什么我能帮您的吗？没有了，都很好。非常感谢您的帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, Stellar Performance, Penny speaking.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好，星辰演艺，我是佩妮。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hi, I'd like to enquire about the programs you have coming up this year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗨，我想咨询一下你们今年即将推出的演出节目。

transcriptBlocks.english: Certainly. Do you have a copy of our current brochure?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然。您有我们最新的宣传册吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hmm, I'm not sure if mine is up-to-date. I think I picked it up a few months ago.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我不确定我的是不是最新的。我想我是几个月前拿到的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, just let me know what interests you, and I'll give you the latest information.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，只要告诉我您对什么感兴趣，我会给您最新的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay. The first one is Bear's Legend. Are tickets still available? And if so, what's the price?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。第一个是《熊的传说》。票还有吗？如果有的话，价格是多少？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, tickets are available at 40 pounds each. However, please note the start time is now 8 pm, not 7 pm as listed in the older brochures. We found that the later time worked better for most of our patrons.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有的，票价每张40英镑。但是请注意，开始时间现在是晚上8点，而不是旧宣传册上列的7点。我们发现晚一点的时间对大多数观众更合适。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, I'm not sure if my elderly parents would want to stay out so late. What about Love and Fear? Unfortunately, it's temporarily unavailable due to casting problems. We hope to have it back on stage next season. I can put you on a waiting list if you'd like to be notified.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，我不确定我年迈的父母是否愿意在外面待到这么晚。《爱与恐惧》呢？不幸的是，由于选角问题，它暂时无法上演。我们希望下个季度能重新上演。如果您想收到通知，我可以把您放在等候名单上。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's disappointing. My wife really wanted to see that one. Anyway, I'm also interested in The Myth in Egypt. I saw in the brochure that there's usually a discount available. The discounted tickets are all sold out, I'm afraid. We only have tickets left at £55, which offer a great view of the stage.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 真遗憾。我妻子真的很想看那个。不管怎样，我也对《埃及神话》感兴趣。我在宣传册上看到通常有折扣。恐怕折扣票都卖完了。我们只剩下55英镑的票了，视野很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ah, that's a bit over our budget. Let me see... how about Double Identity? It has great reviews and looks like it's usually a bit cheaper. Let me check availability... Oh, I'm so sorry. It sold out within the last hour. It's incredibly popular.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 啊，有点超出我们的预算。让我看看……《双重身份》呢？它评价很好，而且通常看起来便宜一些。让我查一下是否有票……哦，非常抱歉。它在最后一小时内售罄了。它非常受欢迎。

transcriptBlocks.english: We do have another show that's getting rave reviews -- Dream of the South. Would you consider that one? It's also currently on special offer. What type of drama is that? Well, it's a new type of opera that incorporates interactive holographic projections into the set design. It's quite spectacular, actually. The way they blend the virtual elements with the live performers is really innovative.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们还有另一场获得好评的演出——《南方之梦》。您会考虑那个吗？它目前也有特别优惠。那是什么类型的戏剧？嗯，它是一种新型歌剧，将互动全息投影融入舞台设计中。实际上相当壮观。他们将虚拟元素与现场表演者融合的方式真的很有创新性。

transcriptBlocks.english: How much is it? I think it's £40, but let me double-check... Oh, the price has been reduced to just £30! It's part of a special promotion we're running this month. A real bargain! Alright, I'll think about that. Now, could you tell me about the venues for each performance? My father is in his late 60s, and my mother uses a wheelchair, so accessibility is key.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 多少钱？我想是40英镑，但让我再确认一下……哦，价格已经降到了只有30英镑！这是我们本月特别促销活动的一部分。真的很划算！好的，我会考虑的。现在，您能告诉我每场演出的场地吗？我父亲快70岁了，我母亲用轮椅，所以无障碍设施是关键。

transcriptBlocks.english: Absolutely. Let's start with Bear's Legend. That's at the Rolley Theatre, which is fully accessible. It has a ramp, a dedicated wheelchair seating section at the front of the orchestra, and accessible restrooms. Sounds good. For The Myth in Egypt... Let me just pull that up... Okay, that's at the Richmond City Library. They have wheelchair access, designated seating on the ground floor, and accessible restrooms. There's also ample accessible parking right outside. Oh, that's convenient, not far from my home at all.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然。我们从《熊的传说》开始。那是在罗利剧院，完全无障碍。它有坡道，乐队区前面有专门的轮椅座位区，还有无障碍卫生间。听起来不错。《埃及神话》……让我调出来看看……好的，那是在里士满市图书馆。他们有轮椅通道，底楼有指定座位，还有无障碍卫生间。外面也有充足的无障碍停车位。哦，那很方便，离我家一点也不远。

transcriptBlocks.english: And for Double Identity, it's performed at Wellington City's Town Hall. Another fully accessible venue with ramps, lifts, wheelchair spaces, and accessible parking. They also have a dedicated staff member to assist patrons with mobility needs. Excellent. And Dream of the South... let me see... that's at the Clinton Street Studio. It was going to be at the cinema, but they changed the venue. Please note that this is a very small venue with stairs leading to the second floor, so it may not be suitable for your parents.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 《双重身份》在惠灵顿市政厅演出。这也是一个完全无障碍的场地，有坡道、电梯、轮椅位和无障碍停车位。他们还专门配备了工作人员来帮助有行动需求的观众。太好了。《南方之梦》……让我看看……在克林顿街工作室。原本计划在电影院，但他们改了场地。请注意，这是一个非常小的场地，有通往二楼的楼梯，所以可能不适合您的父母。

transcriptBlocks.english: Noted. I'll discuss these options with my family and call you back later. Perhaps you could give me the website address where I can see photos of the venues' accessibility features? Absolutely. It's www.stellarperformancevenues.com. You'll find detailed information and photos there. And please don't hesitate to call back if you have any other questions. Okay, thanks. Bye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 知道了。我会和家人讨论这些选择，稍后再给您回电话。也许您可以给我网站地址，让我能看到场地无障碍设施的照片？当然。是 www.stellarperformancevenues.com。您可以在那里找到详细信息和照片。如果您还有其他问题，请随时回电。好的，谢谢。再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, everyone. Thanks for attending tonight's event.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大家好。感谢大家参加今晚的活动。

transcriptBlocks.english: Let me start with the early history of our charity, Eyesaver.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我从我们慈善机构Eyesaver的早期历史开始说起。

transcriptBlocks.english: Eyesaver was founded by a retired optometrist Timothy Gaines. Now, our charity has been helping people for three decades.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: Eyesaver由退休验光师蒂莫西·盖恩斯创立。现在，我们的慈善机构已经帮助人们三十年了。

transcriptBlocks.english: I have spent much of my working life at Eyesaver. I am 60 years old now and I started working for this organization 15 years ago when I left a corporate position to help people with eye problems.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我的大部分工作生涯都在Eyesaver度过。我现在60岁了，15年前我离开了企业职位，开始为这个组织工作，帮助有眼疾的人。

transcriptBlocks.english: You may know that we are now doing various other things to help people with eye problems. That includes medications for children with eye diseases and operational help to those in the public who have eye problems. But when Mr. Gaines just founded Eyesaver, he wanted the program to be able to offer common eye equipment to those who needed it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们可能知道，我们现在做各种其他事情来帮助有眼疾的人。包括为患有眼病的儿童提供药物治疗，以及为公众中有眼疾的人提供手术帮助。但在盖恩斯先生刚创立Eyesaver时，他希望这个项目能够为需要的人提供常见的眼科设备。

transcriptBlocks.english: We receive occasional donations from corporations and charity groups. Now we have over 1500 volunteers who work on the streets with the little red donation boxes which many of you are familiar with, and this is the main source of funding for us. Besides, we are planning to work to secure donations from wealthy benefactors.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们偶尔会收到企业和慈善团体的捐赠。现在我们有超过1500名志愿者，带着你们很多人熟悉的小红捐赠箱在街头工作，这是我们主要的资金来源。此外，我们正计划努力争取来自富有的捐助者的捐赠。

transcriptBlocks.english: Many people are passionate about charity cause and have been inquiring how to donate money to us. I really appreciate that. But our main need is to collect glasses for our patients. Many of you have multiple pairs of old glasses in your possession and we encourage you to gather these pairs which you no longer need and donate them to our cause. In doing this, you'll be able to make sure that someone else can see better. Most of us cannot imagine a life in which we are unable to see well. This is why your eyeglass donations are so critical to our mission. And, as a side note, we offer full-time positions, let me know if you are interested.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 许多人对慈善事业充满热情，一直在询问如何向我们捐款。我非常感激。但我们的主要需求是为患者收集眼镜。你们很多人都有多副旧眼镜，我们鼓励你们把这些不再需要的眼镜收集起来，捐给我们的慈善事业。这样做，你们就能确保其他人能看得更清楚。我们大多数人无法想象视力不好的生活。这就是为什么你们的眼镜捐赠对我们的使命如此关键。另外，我们提供全职职位，如果你们有兴趣请告诉我。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our goal is to make people aware that even the smallest of donations can help change a person's life. So, your donation can be a turning point for them. The other day, when I was talking to some people on the street, they were surprised to find out how easily some eye problems can be cured. And I'm proud to say that our next program will aim at educating people about common eye diseases, we are able to prevent many fatal eye problems.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们的目标是让人们意识到，即使是最小的捐赠也能帮助改变一个人的生活。所以，你们的捐赠对他们来说可能是一个转折点。有一天，当我在街上和一些人交谈时，他们惊讶地发现一些眼疾可以很容易地被治愈。我很自豪地说，我们的下一个项目旨在教育人们关于常见眼疾的知识，我们能够预防许多致命的眼疾。

transcriptBlocks.english: In order to publicize our charity program, we surely need to do some advertising. When we first started our program, we used computers to create awareness for our cause. For instance, promoting seminars in which we informed people as to how they could help us to solve eye problems. But in recent years, the main means of advertising our program is through audio recordings. We have found it cost-efficient and effective. It's good to know that many of our staff are recommending our program to their friends and colleagues, but I am afraid that our training cannot show people the whole picture of our program.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 为了宣传我们的慈善项目，我们当然需要做一些广告。当我们最初启动项目时，我们用电脑来提高人们对我们事业的认知。例如，推广研讨会，在会上我们告知人们如何帮助我们解决眼疾问题。但近年来，我们宣传项目的主要方式是通过音频录音。我们发现这既具成本效益又有效。很高兴知道我们的许多员工向朋友和同事推荐我们的项目，但恐怕我们的培训无法向人们展示项目的全貌。

transcriptBlocks.english: Finally, I would like to tell you about some organizations which have played important roles in the development and success of Eyesaver.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后，我想告诉你们一些在Eyesaver的发展和成功中发挥了重要作用的组织。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our affiliation with the National Vision Funding Group has allowed us to gain fame and to become even more significant. So, many people around the country are coming for our services. Our association with the Eye for the Future organization has allowed us to run cooperative ads by which we seek producers of equipment to work with us. Meanwhile some of our staff has been sent to this organization for some special training, their skills should be improved very soon.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们与国家视力资助集团的联盟使我们获得了声誉，变得更加重要。所以，全国各地的许多人都在寻求我们的服务。我们与“未来之眼”组织的合作使我们能够投放合作广告，通过广告寻找设备生产商与我们合作。与此同时，我们的一些员工已被派往该组织接受一些特殊培训，他们的技能应该很快就能得到提高。

transcriptBlocks.english: Also, we have had a longtime cooperation with Sam's Eyecare Institution. Our relationship with it has given us the opportunity to link with many different academic institutions, including colleges and universities with good reputation. And we have a similar friendship with a group called Youth Health. Our connection with that group allows us to link directly with young kids since this is a crucial stage in their growth. We plan to contact with some colleges and hope that with their help, more college students could get to know our program.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，我们与山姆眼科机构有着长期的合作关系。我们与它的关系使我们有机会与许多不同的学术机构建立联系，包括声誉良好的学院和大学。我们与一个叫“青年健康”的团体也有类似的友谊。我们与该团体的联系使我们能够直接与幼儿建立联系，因为这是他们成长的关键阶段。我们计划联系一些大学，希望在他们帮助下，更多的大学生能了解我们的项目。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, as you can see, we have all bases covered in linking with students, as we have affiliations directly with both administrators and the students themselves.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 所以，正如你们所见，我们在与学生建立联系方面全面覆盖，因为我们与行政人员和学生本身都有直接的合作关系。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you so much for your attention today. As we try to stamp out eye problems, we will appreciate your donations, no matter how large or how small. We believe with our efforts, the world will be a brighter and more beautiful...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 非常感谢大家今天的关注。在我们努力消除眼疾的过程中，无论捐赠多少，我们都将不胜感激。我们相信通过我们的努力，世界将变得更加明亮和美丽……

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, all. Welcome to Aspen Ski Resort near Cumbria.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大家好。欢迎来到坎布里亚附近的阿斯彭滑雪度假村。

transcriptBlocks.english: It is one of my favorite vacation spots. I first discovered this fantastic resort when it was recommended to me by a journalist who was interviewing me. I then contacted my travel agent for further information about the resort and, from the first time I visited the place, it was "love at first sight". Now, when I don't have acting jobs to do, I would come here and relax.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这是我最喜欢的度假胜地之一。我最初发现这个美妙的度假村是一位采访我的记者向我推荐的。然后我联系了旅行社了解更多关于度假村的信息，从我第一次访问这个地方起，就是“一见钟情”。现在，当我没有演戏工作时，我就会来这里放松。

transcriptBlocks.english: My parents were both geographers and their profession afforded my siblings and I the opportunity to travel with them all over the world when we were growing up, visiting some of the places I had seen in the television documentaries I had watched. Their passion kept affecting me and eventually I realized that travelling has been something I love for a long time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我的父母都是地理学家，他们的职业使我和兄弟姐妹在成长过程中有机会和他们一起环游世界，参观我在电视纪录片中看过的一些地方。他们的热情一直影响着我，最终我意识到旅行是我长久以来热爱的事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: A bit of background on the Aspen Ski Resort: The area of Cumbria was first known as a vacation spot in the 1920s, however that was only as a summer vacation spot. The area became home to a summer resort in the 1930s. In the 1960s, with the increasing popularity of downhill skiing, the first British ski resort appeared. The Aspen Ski Resort was established soon after in 1968 and the Cumbria area became a popular destination for winter skiing vacations.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 关于阿斯彭滑雪度假村的一些背景：坎布里亚地区在20世纪20年代首次被称为度假胜地，但那只是作为夏季度假胜地。该地区在20世纪30年代成为避暑胜地的所在地。在20世纪60年代，随着下坡滑雪越来越受欢迎，第一个英国滑雪度假村出现了。阿斯彭滑雪度假村很快在1968年成立，坎布里亚地区成为冬季滑雪度假的热门目的地。

transcriptBlocks.english: Although snow skiing is the most popular winter activity at the resort, there are also some other popular activities. In the spring, summer, and fall seasons, playing golf is easily the favorite activity of most of the resort's guests. There are five top-ranked courses within a short driving distance of the resort and the resort offers many packages for visitors during the warmer months.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 虽然滑雪是度假村最受欢迎的冬季活动，但也有其他一些受欢迎的活动。在春季、夏季和秋季，打高尔夫球很容易成为度假村大多数客人最喜欢的活动。度假村附近短途车程内有五个顶级球场，度假村在温暖的月份为游客提供许多套餐。

transcriptBlocks.english: Also, throughout the year, many of the resort's guests like to visit the Great Waters Brewing Company. But it is under reconstruction at the moment. Also, many of our visitors take advantage of skydiving activities offered by a skydiving school, but the school is located in another town which is about 2-hour drive from here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，全年都有许多度假村客人喜欢参观大水域酿酒公司。但它目前正在重建中。此外，我们的许多游客会利用跳伞学校提供的跳伞活动，但学校在另一个镇上，离这里大约两小时车程。

transcriptBlocks.english: Some people ask what activities are recommended in the nearby Edimore region. Many visitors to that popular destination often also visit either the hot springs near the city of Marlborough or the local market in the city of Jameston. The hot springs are geothermally heated groundwaters that rise from the crust of the earth and are enjoyed by folks of all ages. However, the price of having a hot spa there is quite high this season. The Edimore Nature Museum is a great alternative. You will see details of the animals which are native to the area. Most visitors in the past gave really positive feedback about the museum. The market in Jameston region has a nice selection of fruits and vegetables which are grown on farms in the area and also a selection of fresh seafood. The market is not open this week.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有些人问在附近的埃迪莫尔地区推荐什么活动。许多到这个热门目的地的游客也经常参观马尔堡市附近的温泉或贾梅斯顿市的当地市场。温泉是地热加热的地下水，从地壳上升，受到各个年龄段的人的喜爱。然而，这个季节在那里泡温泉的价格相当高。埃迪莫尔自然博物馆是一个很好的替代选择。你将看到该地区本土动物的详细信息。过去大多数游客对博物馆给予了非常积极的评价。贾梅斯顿地区的市场有很好的水果和蔬菜选择，它们是在该地区的农场种植的，还有一些新鲜海鲜。这周市场不开放。

transcriptBlocks.english: Please note that the Aspen Resort sponsors monthly education and entertainment programs which are open to the public. Previous programs have featured Mountain Walking in Europe and Wildlife around the World. The upcoming entertainment program which will take place at 7 p.m. May 18th in the resort's conference center will be about the Landscape of the United Kingdom. These events are free to those attending, but seats are available on a first come, first served basis.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 请注意，阿斯彭度假村赞助每月向公众开放的教育和娱乐项目。之前的项目包括“欧洲山地徒步”和“世界野生动物”。即将于5月18日晚上7点在度假村会议中心举行的娱乐项目将是关于“英国景观”的。这些活动对参加者免费，但座位先到先得。

transcriptBlocks.english: Finally, let me outline what some of the Cumbria area's other skiing locations are popular for. Lakeside is the oldest of the area resorts. Its popularity barely decreases over the years and it was recently renovated. A newly-built ski school there has attracted some attention and it will be open to the public within a couple of months. Petersburg is well-known as a training site for skiing teams. It's the home training base for Olympic champion Billy Randolph. Winterton is a resort that is well-known as a place for inexperienced skiers. It has many different bunny hills for new learners, and it doesn't require any good equipment. Al-slops is a resort that will provide you with some special service. They have a certified staff that will care for your kids while you are on the slopes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后，让我概述一下坎布里亚地区其他一些滑雪地点因什么而受欢迎。莱克赛德是该地区最古老的度假村。多年来它的受欢迎程度几乎没有下降，最近还进行了翻新。那里新建的滑雪学校引起了一些关注，将在几个月内向公众开放。彼得斯堡是著名的滑雪队训练基地。它是奥运会冠军比利·伦道夫的家乡训练基地。温特顿是一个以缺乏经验的滑雪者而闻名的度假村。它有许多不同的初学者雪道，不需要任何好的装备。阿尔-斯洛普斯是一个能为您提供一些特殊服务的度假村。他们有经过认证的员工，当您在雪道上时，他们会照顾您的孩子。

transcriptBlocks.english: For people who want to enjoy the beauty of nature as well as having some exciting activities, these places are...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些想欣赏自然之美同时享受一些刺激活动的人来说，这些地方是……

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. My name is Damon and I would like to share my experiences of Oceanic Island Traveling.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。我叫达蒙，我想分享我在海洋岛屿旅行的经历。

transcriptBlocks.english: First of all, some of you have been asking me how Oceanic Island Traveling keeps its tour group members updated while they are on the travel trip. Please note that the information board is updated daily and we encourage you to check it every morning before you begin your day on the beach, in the cottage, or participating in any of the many activities offered, so please remember to check it at the reception area in the front of the visitor center of the resort.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 首先，你们中的一些人一直在问我，海洋岛屿旅行如何在旅行中保持旅游团成员的信息更新。请注意，信息板每天更新，我们鼓励你们每天早上在开始海滩、小屋或参加任何活动之前查看，所以请记得在度假村游客中心前面的接待区查看。

transcriptBlocks.english: You are probably aware of the many different activities offered on our trips. There is something you should know before booking. Reservations are not necessary for most activities, such as sand soccer, beach volleyball, and even scuba diving. However, if you are planning to participate in our water-skiing activity, we encourage you to book that activity at least 48 hours beforehand, as we hire an outside group to conduct this activity and we need to notify them of how many participants will be involved.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们可能知道我们旅行中提供的许多不同活动。在预订之前有一些事情你们应该知道。大多数活动不需要预订，如沙滩足球、沙滩排球，甚至水肺潜水。然而，如果你们计划参加我们的滑水活动，我们鼓励你们至少提前48小时预订，因为我们聘请外部团体进行这项活动，我们需要通知他们有多少参与者。

transcriptBlocks.english: One of the many activities available to the guests is the Mystery Cave Tour. Some people interested in participating in those tours don't know what the ticket price includes. The ticket price includes transportation to the caves. All participants are required to wear a safety helmet inside the caves and the ticket has covered that for you. If you are joining this tour, you will need to wear some comfortable shoes, as there will be some walking involved with this tour. If you are interested to see a map of the Mystery Cave in advance of your trip, you can see it on the Oceanic Island Traveling website. Of course, we will offer you a map of the cave if you need it during the tour, but it will cost an extra fee.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 为游客提供的众多活动之一是神秘洞穴之旅。一些有兴趣参加这些旅游的人不知道票价包括什么。票价包括前往洞穴的交通。所有参与者都需要在洞穴内佩戴安全头盔，票价已经为您覆盖了这一点。如果你们参加这个旅游，你们需要穿舒适的鞋子，因为这次旅行会有一些步行。如果你们想在旅行前提前看到神秘洞穴的地图，可以在海洋岛屿旅行网站上看到。当然，如果在旅行中需要，我们会提供洞穴地图，但需要额外付费。

transcriptBlocks.english: For those of you interested in visiting the Davison Wildlife Park, you should know that the park is an excellent site for families to do some research. Again, transportation to the park is included in your ticket price. And please note that children aged 12 and under receive a discounted ticket price. In the wildlife park, children can often watch elephant shows which are really an attraction, but now some elephants are ill and they need some time to recover. Still there is another activity that should entertain kids---they are allowed to feed the animals. This activity is extremely popular with kids.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些有兴趣参观戴维森野生动物园的人，你们应该知道该公园是家庭做研究的好地方。同样，前往公园的交通包含在票价中。请注意，12岁及以下的儿童享受折扣票价。在野生动物园，孩子们经常可以观看大象表演，这真的很有吸引力，但现在有些大象生病了，需要时间恢复。不过还有另一项活动可以让孩子们开心——他们被允许喂动物。这项活动非常受孩子们欢迎。

transcriptBlocks.english: Among the most popular animals at the zoo are the collection of red kangaroos. The size of these kangaroos is similar to that of black bears, but generally they are bigger than adults and, if you're lucky, you might even be able to see some baby kangaroos while you are visiting. The crocodiles are also very popular at the wildlife park. These prehistoric animals have a lifespan of over 50 years. A male crocodile can even be expected to live to the age of 80. You won't get as close to the crocodiles as you will to some of the other animals in the park, as they are somewhat dangerous, you will be able to view these animals from a distance in their natural habitats.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 动物园里最受欢迎的动物之一是红袋鼠。这些袋鼠的大小与黑熊相似，但通常比成年人更大，如果幸运的话，你们甚至可能在参观时看到一些小袋鼠。鳄鱼在野生动物园也很受欢迎。这些史前动物的寿命超过50年。雄性鳄鱼甚至有望活到80岁。你们不会像接近公园里的其他动物那样接近鳄鱼，因为它们有些危险，你们可以从远处在它们的自然栖息地观察这些动物。

transcriptBlocks.english: For those of you that have previously participated in this tour, please know that some of the activities which were previously available are no longer available and have been replaced with new activities. The barbecue and the bonfire are now restricted by ordinance due to fire precautions in the area. Instead of going hiking on the hills, most of our tourists prefer to visit many of the gift shops in the area to buy souvenirs for themselves or for family and friends who are not on the tour. The emu farm, which has previously been a popular place to visit, is now temporarily closed for business. But newly available to you is a popular trip offered to the Nelson Cheese factory in which visitors can take a tour and learn all about the process of manufacturing cheese. And finally, a visit to the St. John's Fruit Farm is another very popular day trip. The fruit farm is within walking distance of our cottages and you can get there by minibus this time, but we'll have a few nature trails that go past the cottages in the future. At the farm, you will be able to pick strawberries and apples in the farm's orchards and fields. Many tourists enjoy this activity a lot. We don't have hill hiking in the area, but we do have tours that involve in other destinations, contact me if you are interested.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些以前参加过这次旅游的人，请注意，以前的一些活动不再提供，已被新活动取代。由于该地区的防火措施，烧烤和篝火现在受到法令限制。大多数游客不再去山上徒步，而是喜欢去该地区的许多礼品店为自己或不在旅行团中的家人和朋友购买纪念品。曾经是热门景点的鸸鹋农场现在暂时关闭。但新开放的是尼尔森奶酪工厂的热门之旅，游客可以参观并了解奶酪制造的全部过程。最后，参观圣约翰水果农场是另一个非常受欢迎的一日游。水果农场离我们的小屋步行可达，这次你们可以乘小巴去，但我们将来会有几条经过小屋的自然小径。在农场，你们可以在果园和田野里采摘草莓和苹果。许多游客非常喜欢这项活动。我们该地区没有山地徒步，但我们有涉及其他目的地的旅游，如果你们感兴趣请联系我。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good evening, and thank you for joining us to learn more about our fitness package.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 晚上好，感谢大家来了解我们的健身套餐。

transcriptBlocks.english: We recognize that many of our valued customers are also dedicated parents, and with that in mind, we've designed our childcare services to enhance your workout experience, making it both convenient and enjoyable.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们认识到许多尊贵的客户同时也是尽心尽责的父母，因此我们设计了托儿服务来提升您的健身体验，使其既方便又愉快。

transcriptBlocks.english: For those of you striving to maintain an active lifestyle while ensuring your children are in good hands, our play area has recently doubled in size, offering ample space for kids to play, explore, and have a great time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些努力保持积极生活方式同时确保孩子得到妥善照顾的客户，我们的游乐区最近扩大了一倍，为孩子们提供了充足的空间玩耍、探索和享受美好时光。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our caring staff is on hand during daytime hours to provide attentive childcare, giving you the freedom to concentrate on your workout without any worries.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们富有爱心的员工在白天随时提供贴心的托儿服务，让您能够无忧无虑地专注于锻炼。

transcriptBlocks.english: Moreover, we've introduced special classes aimed at nurturing children's physical and mental growth, allowing them to learn and stay active while you attend to your fitness needs.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，我们还推出了旨在培养孩子身心发展的特别课程，让他们在您满足健身需求的同时学习和保持活跃。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now, you might be thinking that such a comprehensive service would come with a hefty price tag. However, we are delighted to offer these childcare services at reasonable rates, ranging from $5 to $10 per hour for our members, ensuring quality service and a positive experience for all.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在，您可能会想这样全面的服务一定价格不菲。然而，我们很高兴以合理的价格提供这些托儿服务，会员每小时5到10美元，确保为所有人提供高质量的服务和积极的体验。

transcriptBlocks.english: Previously, our canteen catered to both adults and children. However, for the safety of our younger guests with allergies or dietary restrictions, we have decided to no longer serve meals to children in our facility. We kindly suggest exploring the nearby dining options, and we've prepared a brochure with a variety of restaurants that are suitable for both adults and children.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 以前，我们的食堂同时为成人和儿童提供餐食。然而，为了有过敏或饮食限制的年轻客人的安全，我们决定不再在我们的设施内为儿童提供餐食。我们建议您探索附近的餐饮选择，我们准备了一本包含各种适合成人和儿童餐厅的宣传册。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, it's a pleasure to share the scoop on our current class offerings. Get ready to move to the rhythm in our dance classes---they're the perfect blend of cardio and fun, guaranteed to get your heart racing and your spirits soaring.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来，很高兴与您分享我们当前课程的最新消息。准备好在我们舞蹈课上随着节奏舞动吧——它们是心肺训练和乐趣的完美结合，保证让您心跳加速、精神振奋。

transcriptBlocks.english: At the same time, each of you will have the opportunity to partake in an exclusive program, designed to elevate your arm strength to new heights. Brace yourselves for a challenge that will test your endurance like never before. This program sets itself apart from any previous offerings, as it spans a month of daily sessions. Rest assured, the results will leave you pleasantly surprised. Weightlifting may be included in the future once our trainers are ready to deliver a combined course. So stay tuned for our upcoming program.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 与此同时，你们每个人都将有机会参加一个独家课程，旨在将您的手臂力量提升到新的高度。准备好迎接前所未有的耐力挑战吧。这个课程与以往任何课程都不同，它持续一个月，每天都有训练。放心，结果会让您惊喜。一旦我们的教练准备好提供综合课程，未来可能会加入举重项目。所以请持续关注我们即将推出的课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: Regarding class times, we know that evenings are a popular request. However, we're currently sticking to our schedule into next year to ensure that each class is led by our exceptional instructors. And a quick note for the teens---we're in the process of designing classes just for you, tailored to your unique energy and interests.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 关于上课时间，我们知道晚间时段很受欢迎。然而，我们目前坚持现有的时间表直到明年，以确保每节课都由我们优秀的教练授课。给青少年们一个温馨提示——我们正在为你们设计专属课程，根据你们独特的精力和兴趣量身定制。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now, let me introduce our top trainers to you, so you can decide who will be the most suitable for your training course.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在，让我向您介绍我们的顶级教练，以便您决定谁最适合您的训练课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: First on the list is Kimberly, who is a tennis retiree as I like to call him. He won several local and international honours before he took his leave and is one of the people I used to love watching while he played.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 名单上的第一位是金伯利，我喜欢称他为退役网球选手。他在退役前赢得了多项本地和国际荣誉，是我过去喜欢观看的球员之一。

transcriptBlocks.english: Martin is also a sportsman of international reputation. He recently suffered an ankle injury but has recovered and is back at the top level.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 马丁也是一位享有国际声誉的运动员。他最近脚踝受伤，但已经康复并回到了顶级水平。

transcriptBlocks.english: I know you must all have heard of the star boy Robert, who has won the New York City prize 3 times.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我知道你们一定都听说过明星男孩罗伯特，他三次获得纽约市奖项。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, Mr. Edward has always been around fame and it has really rubbed off on him. He networks with elites and celebrities and it is no wonder he was recently recognized as one of the top 50 most influential men in our city.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来，爱德华先生一直与名望为伴，这对他产生了影响。他与精英和名人交往，难怪他最近被评选为我们城市最有影响力的50位人物之一。

transcriptBlocks.english: Andrew Gills has won the hearts of many fans and is a beloved figure among our community. I remember seeing five ladies wearing shirts with his face branded on them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁·吉尔斯赢得了许多粉丝的心，是我们社区中深受爱戴的人物。我记得见过五位女士穿着印有他头像的衬衫。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our last trainer is someone very special to me. Tommy is a legend. Right from when we were in school together, he has always had a heart for people. He single-handedly began running nonprofit programs for children with disabilities from France and Australia while in school. He has always been a source of motivation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们最后一位教练对我来说很特别。汤米是个传奇人物。从我们一起上学时起，他就一直关心他人。他在上学时就独自创办了针对法国和澳大利亚残疾儿童的非营利项目。他一直是一个激励他人的源泉。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, that concludes today's introduction. Thank you for joining us. We look forward to welcoming you and your family soon!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好了，今天的介绍就到这里。感谢大家的参与。我们期待很快欢迎您和您的家人！

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello listeners, it's your host Sarah here again on the award-winning program, How To!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听众朋友们好，我是主持人莎拉，又回到了获奖节目《怎么做》！

transcriptBlocks.english: Last week, we looked intently on how to rent a car, and today, we would be discussing how to rent a bike in the little town of Chuga.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 上周，我们详细讨论了如何租车，今天我们将讨论如何在楚加小镇租自行车。

transcriptBlocks.english: As usual, we are not advertising for any company, but we just want to help our listeners know the best way to go about renting a bike. We bring you the easiest and best methods of doing things.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 一如既往，我们不为任何公司做广告，只是想帮助听众了解租自行车的最佳方式。我们为您带来最简单、最好的方法。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, let's go right in:
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，让我们直接开始：

transcriptBlocks.english: From wherever you are, you drive or walk to the bike station. You then put your finger on the screen of a bike. Make sure you use your bare hand, gloves or clothes cannot be recognized. But don't touch the alarm on the side as it's quite sensitive.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 无论您在哪里，开车或步行到自行车站。然后您把手指放在自行车的屏幕上。确保使用裸露的手指，手套或衣物无法被识别。但不要触碰侧面的报警器，因为它非常敏感。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, input the password number, which is unique each time and can be applied for all systems and then you would see a button appear. Once it appears, just click it and then undo the lock of the bike.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来，输入密码，每次都是唯一的，适用于所有系统，然后您会看到一个按钮出现。一旦出现，点击它然后解锁自行车。

transcriptBlocks.english: Please note that payment has to have been made prior to this or at least half payment by cash, to the bike company. Remember that the cashier would ask for your proof of payment before directing you to where the bikes are.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 请注意，在此之前必须已经付款，或至少以现金向自行车公司支付一半费用。记住收银员会要求您出示付款证明，然后才会指引您去自行车停放处。

transcriptBlocks.english: Once you get the bike, it is important you understand a few safety measures before setting out. On this program, we always emphasize the fact that life is important to us and as a matter of fact, we still need you around here! So, make sure you do not ride without your helmet. Also make sure that if you have a passenger, they have one too. We have been receiving far too many reports of bike accidents that resulted in deaths from head injuries. So, please let us all adhere to these safety measures, they are for our own good.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 拿到自行车后，在出发前了解一些安全措施很重要。在这个节目中，我们总是强调生命对我们很重要，事实上我们还需要你们在这里！所以，确保不要不戴头盔骑行。也要确保如果有乘客，他们也戴头盔。我们收到了太多因头部受伤导致死亡的自行车事故报告。所以，请大家都遵守这些安全措施，这是为了我们自己的安全。

transcriptBlocks.english: After riding safely and returning, you can return the bike to the rack and make sure that it is well placed. Then lock the bike and you would know when it is properly locked by the light which would turn on.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安全骑行并返回后，您可以将自行车归还到车架上，确保放置妥当。然后锁车，灯亮起时您就知道已经锁好了。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, here we are at our improved bike renting centre. The renovation is not yet complete, but I'm sure you will agree that it looks a lot better than before. We hope that the new layout and amenities will convince people to begin cycling again.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们来到了改进后的自行车租赁中心。装修还没有完全完成，但我相信您会同意看起来比以前好多了。我们希望新的布局和设施能说服人们重新开始骑自行车。

transcriptBlocks.english: In the middle of the facility is the bicycle area. Now, guests can select a bike rather than just being handed one by staff.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 设施中央是自行车区域。现在，客人可以自己选择自行车，而不是由工作人员直接递给他们。

transcriptBlocks.english: Another complaint before was that there was nowhere for customers to take a rest. So on the right side of the facility, just two doors down from the ATM, is the coffee bar. It's spacious enough to fit 20 people.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 之前的另一个抱怨是顾客没有休息的地方。所以在设施的右侧，从自动取款机过去两个门就是咖啡吧。它足够宽敞，可容纳20人。

transcriptBlocks.english: We also have a much bigger meeting room, located by the fountain. It is mostly for discussing bicycle races. Situated next to the ATM is the maintenance office. What's cool about it is that there are glass walls that allow guests to see the staff repair the bikes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们还有一个更大的会议室，位于喷泉旁边。主要用于讨论自行车比赛。自动取款机旁边是维修办公室。酷的是那里有玻璃墙，让客人可以看到员工修理自行车。

transcriptBlocks.english: The locker room for guests is on the left side, just before the exit. In the past, guests had to leave their personal belongings in their car or with a friend. But now, there's a locker available for all riders. However, it is just to keep their things. The changing area is next door. Don't worry. There is a divider to separate the men from the women.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客人更衣室在左侧，就在出口之前。过去，客人不得不把个人物品留在车里或朋友那里。但现在，所有骑行者都可以使用储物柜。不过它只是用来存放物品。更衣区在隔壁。别担心，有隔板将男女分开。

transcriptBlocks.english: As for the employees, there is a staff toilet next to the exit on the right side. Aside from the usual toilet and sink, there is even a shower for employees to freshen up...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 至于员工，右侧出口旁边有员工卫生间。除了普通的马桶和水槽，甚至还有淋浴供员工提神……

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning tourists, I am Jane and welcome to Hampshire. I am very happy to see you all here and I can promise you a very nice time here. We would be visiting six different places which are renowned for different activities of their own.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 游客们早上好，我是简，欢迎来到汉普郡。我很高兴看到大家都来了，我可以向你们保证在这里会度过一段美好的时光。我们将参观六个不同的地方，每个地方都以其独特的活动而闻名。

transcriptBlocks.english: We would begin from Jackson Town, which is known for its buggy ride. Rather than sit in a train, you will sit in a small lightweight carriage pulled by a single horse. It was named after Sanya Jackson who was famous for her generosity in the region. The locals even built a museum for her.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们将从杰克逊镇开始，它以马车之旅闻名。你将乘坐由一匹马拉的小型轻便马车，而不是坐火车。它以桑娅·杰克逊的名字命名，她因在该地区的慷慨而闻名。当地人甚至为她建了一座博物馆。

transcriptBlocks.english: Belleville would be our next stop. We'll get there by helicopter, oh, oh I almost forgot that this mode of transportation has been suspended because of the variable weather. We will get there by taking a jolly train ride, which is a highlight in this area. The people here are very friendly and would always try to make you feel as comfortable as possible. They entertain their guests with local delicacies, like cakes and pastries which are quite famous in this area.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 贝尔维尔将是我们的下一站。我们将乘直升机到达那里，哦，我差点忘了这种交通方式因为天气多变而暂停了。我们将乘坐欢乐列车到达那里，这是该地区的一大亮点。这里的人们非常友好，总是尽力让你感到舒适。他们用当地美食款待客人，比如该地区非常著名的蛋糕和糕点。

transcriptBlocks.english: Albany is a very lively and playful place, so get ready for some good and hearty laughs. It is usually fun to watch some people screaming during a balloon trip which is quite popular there. Albany also features cool relaxation spots where you can just take time to cool off and enjoy yourself.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 奥尔巴尼是一个非常热闹和有趣的地方，所以准备好开怀大笑吧。观看一些人在那里非常受欢迎的热气球旅行中尖叫通常很有趣。奥尔巴尼还有凉爽的放松场所，你可以花时间消暑和享受。

transcriptBlocks.english: Fort Scott is where we have Jackson's Biscuits which is famous for its teddy-bear shapes. There, you can get to see how they are pieced together. The location also has a small refreshment section where you can grab a bite. The chiffon cakes there are just palatable.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 斯科特堡是我们有杰克逊饼干的地方，它以泰迪熊形状闻名。在那里，你可以看到它们是如何拼合而成的。该地点还有一个小茶点区，你可以吃点东西。那里的雪纺蛋糕非常可口。

transcriptBlocks.english: Rawlins has many factories there. Among these factories, the ones that make cakes are gaining more fame than others. Their cakes are made from pure cream, cheese, eggs, and sugar, no food additive. I always advise our tourists to get some for themselves and their families as their products will never disappoint you. Rawlins' council has decided to combine their products with the native culture in the future, which will be a strong selling point.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 罗林斯有许多工厂。在这些工厂中，生产蛋糕的比其他工厂更出名。他们的蛋糕由纯奶油、奶酪、鸡蛋和糖制成，没有食品添加剂。我总是建议我们的游客为自己和家人买一些，因为他们的产品永远不会让你失望。罗林斯议会决定在未来将他们的产品与本土文化相结合，这将是一个强大的卖点。

transcriptBlocks.english: Greensville boasts about its native American culture which is widely known. A lot of artifacts have been collected around here and now kept in the local art museum for studies and tourists' sake. A lot of people who had been looking for their roots have been able to make a sort of connection by coming to this place. The museum has been around for decades and it was recently renovated. However, the story has not changed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 格林斯维尔以其广为人知的本土美洲文化而自豪。这里收集了许多手工艺品，现在保存在当地艺术博物馆供研究和游客观赏。许多一直在寻找根源的人通过来到这个地方找到了一种联系。博物馆已经存在了几十年，最近进行了翻新。但故事没有改变。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now let me briefly talk about other buildings and sites in Greensville. Please take a look at the map which I gave you earlier.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在让我简要谈谈格林斯维尔的其他建筑和景点。请看之前我给你们的 map。

transcriptBlocks.english: Greensville has a good kindergarten for younger children and it is situated just to the north of Monument Street. It has well trained teachers and a conducive environment for learning. As it's receiving an increasing number of children, the city council has decided to move it to a larger site on Oak Road this November. The new spot is uncertain though.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 格林斯维尔有一所很好的幼儿园，位于纪念碑街以北。它有训练有素的教师和有利的学习环境。由于接收的孩子越来越多，市议会决定在今年11月将其迁至橡树路一个更大的地点。不过新地点还不确定。

transcriptBlocks.english: We also have a craft shop which is at the end of Ash Road. The craft shop is for displaying all types of art and drawings, paintings and the likes. It is a key feature of Greensville due to its art exhibitions which run three times a year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们还有一家工艺品店，位于灰烬路的尽头。工艺品店用于展示各种艺术、素描、绘画等。它是格林斯维尔的一大特色，因为每年举办三次艺术展览。

transcriptBlocks.english: Wickson's school used to be situated at the intersection of Oak Road and George Avenue. But the site wasn't big enough as the number of students kept growing. So the larger piece of land right beside the old location has become the new site for the school since last year. It is important to note that the school has been around for a while, so there are well experienced teachers to help students develop at their own pace.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 威克森学校曾经位于橡树路和乔治大道的交汇处。但随着学生数量的不断增加，场地不够大了。所以去年开始，紧挨着旧址旁边的那块更大的土地成为了学校的新址。值得注意的是，这所学校已经存在了一段时间，所以有经验丰富的老师帮助学生按自己的节奏发展。

transcriptBlocks.english: The cake factory that we spoke about is actually between Monument Street and Maple Street, just by the roadside. The people of Greensville are very hospitable...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们之前提到的蛋糕工厂实际上位于纪念碑街和枫叶街之间，就在路边。格林斯维尔的人民非常热情好客……

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello Mr. and Mrs. Clark. I believe you are doing well.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克拉克先生和夫人，你们好。我相信你们一切都好。

transcriptBlocks.english: I am Tom, the sales manager of Housed Inc. and I got your mail requesting for a house that would suit your specifications.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我是Housed Inc.的销售经理汤姆，我收到了你们要求寻找符合你们规格的房子的邮件。

transcriptBlocks.english: I have been able to do some work and have come up with two options that I think should fit what you are looking for.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我已经做了一些工作，提出了两个我认为应该适合你们需求的选项。

transcriptBlocks.english: The first house is situated on Allen Street and the owner told me that he bought the house largely because of where it is located. The house was decorated a few years ago, but I think it still looks new to a large extent. Anyways, you might dislike the old-fashioned design of the house, which was modelled to the original owner's taste. Of course, you can arrange decorations of your own. I just have to inform you beforehand. I looked through your profile and it said that you have a large family of six. I felt this house could be more appropriate for you with children than just young couples as it has eight rooms, including four bedrooms.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 第一栋房子位于艾伦街，房主告诉我他购买这栋房子主要是因为它的位置。房子几年前装修过，但我认为在很大程度上它看起来仍然很新。无论如何，你们可能不喜欢房子的老式设计，这是按照原房主的品味设计的。当然，你们可以自己安排装修。我只是提前告知你们。我看了你们的资料，说你们有一个六口之家。我觉得这栋房子更适合有孩子的你们，而不是年轻夫妇，因为它有八个房间，包括四间卧室。

transcriptBlocks.english: According to your budget, although the house is a bit pricy, the price hasn't exceeded your limit yet. It's very reasonable though, for a house on Allen Street. The owner had initially fixed every afternoon for potential buyers to visit, then he shifted it to all weekends, but by yesterday, he informed me that he would be allowing only Wednesdays, during lunch time for visits. So, it means we have to go either tomorrow or next week.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 根据你们的预算，虽然房子有点贵，但价格还没有超过你们的限额。不过对于艾伦街上的房子来说，这已经非常合理了。房主最初把每个下午定为潜在买家的看房时间，然后改为所有周末，但到昨天为止，他通知我他只允许周三午餐时间看房。所以，这意味着我们要么明天去，要么下周去。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, onto the next house. I was able to get the layout of this building to help you understand it better. The house is situated on Pearl Street just around the corner. It is a well-planned and designed house. In the southeast of the house, you can see the master room, whereas the dining room is in the northwestern corner. There is a bathroom in the southwestern corner of the house that is modern and well-equipped. It provides adequate storage for the whole family. As for the bedroom which is kept especially for visitors, it is in the direct south of the house, just between the bathroom and the master room. You will see the kitchen to your left when you just step in the house.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，来看下一栋房子。我拿到了这栋建筑的平面图，可以帮助你们更好地了解它。房子位于珍珠街，就在拐角处。这是一栋规划良好、设计精良的房子。在房子的东南部，你们可以看到主卧室，而餐厅在西北角。房子西南角有一间现代化且设备齐全的浴室。它为整个家庭提供了充足的储物空间。至于专门为访客保留的卧室，它在房子的正南方向，就在浴室和主卧室之间。你们一进房子就会看到厨房在左手边。

transcriptBlocks.english: Of course, I should give as much information as I can so as to help you in the decision-making process. The second house has both advantages and disadvantages and you should know well about them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，我应该尽可能多地提供信息，以帮助你们做决定。第二栋房子既有优点也有缺点，你们应该清楚地了解它们。

transcriptBlocks.english: First, the premises are quite lovely and there is a small garden just behind the main building. Also, you do not have to manage space with other neighbours since there is a big parking lot, unlike the first house. As you can see, north of the house you have a lot of banks and to the east and west, there are a good number of companies and malls. It is very compact and easily accessible, due to its central location.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 首先，房屋本身很可爱，主楼后面有一个小花园。此外，你们不必与邻居争夺空间，因为有一个大停车场，不像第一栋房子。正如你们所见，房子北面有很多银行，东西方向有很多公司和商场。由于地处中心位置，它非常紧凑且交通便利。

transcriptBlocks.english: Again, in contrast to the first house, there are only two bedrooms and this would have been good for a young couple with a small family size. However for a family size like yours, I really am not sure. But, if necessary, perhaps you could turn the storeroom into a bedroom, then there will be three bedrooms. The last problem is that it lacks a garage which is a very important feature for residents here as every household has at least one car and there are few public car parks in this area.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 再说一次，与第一栋房子相比，只有两间卧室，这对年轻夫妇或小家庭来说很好。但对于像你们这样的家庭，我真的不确定。但如果必要的话，也许你们可以把储藏室改成一间卧室，那样就有三间卧室了。最后一个问题是缺少车库，这对这里的居民来说是一个非常重要的设施，因为每家每户至少有一辆车，而且这个地区几乎没有公共停车场。

transcriptBlocks.english: This is all I have for now and...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这就是我现在掌握的所有信息，还有……

transcriptBlocks.english: Mark, have you finished preparing for the biology lecture?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 马克，你为生物讲座的准备工作完成了吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm still working on it, Ms. Harrison. There is a lot to do. I want to make sure I have everything well-organized in mind.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我还在做，哈里森女士。有很多要做的事。我想确保在脑子把所有内容都整理清楚。

transcriptBlocks.english: I've got a list of your topics here, so let's go through them one by one.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我这里有一份你的主题列表，所以我们一个一个过一遍。

transcriptBlocks.english: The first is biological rhythm?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 第一个是生物节律？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes. I found this to be a fascinating topic. It involves so much of what is happening behind the scenes in our body, from our hormones to daily patterns.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的。我发现这是一个很吸引人的话题。它涉及到我们身体内部发生的很多事情，从荷尔蒙到日常节律。

transcriptBlocks.english: Instead of spending too much time on sleep problems, I think the highlight should be the fact that we can train our body to be awake at different times, namely, our sleep habits. I also plan to design a chart for the audience to check if they have healthy routines.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 与其花太多时间在睡眠问题上，我认为重点应该放在我们可以训练身体在不同时间醒来这个事实上，也就是我们的睡眠习惯。我还计划设计一个图表让观众检查他们是否有健康的作息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hmm, I don't think you'll have enough time for that. The design needs to cater to different age groups, but your presentation is a week away.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我不认为你有足够时间做那个。设计需要迎合不同的年龄群体，但你的展示只剩一周了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, I overlooked the range of age group. I'll try simplifying the design.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，我忽略了年龄群体的范围。我会试着简化设计。

transcriptBlocks.english: What do you think of my next topic, blood pressure?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你觉得我的下一个主题，血压怎么样？

transcriptBlocks.english: It's a good one, but I suggest you put your focus on heart disease.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 不错，但我建议你把重点放在心脏病上。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. I'd make a full list of problems that people may have in their diet, which can contribute significantly to heart disease, such as a trans-fat-rich diet. I'll work with researchers at a local hospital to collect some data for that. It might be interesting to conduct non-invasive experiments on some volunteer classmates.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。我会列出一份人们饮食中可能导致心脏病的完整问题清单，比如富含反式脂肪的饮食。我会和当地医院的研究人员合作为此收集一些数据。对志愿者同学进行非侵入性实验可能会很有趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's a great idea! Can I conduct these experiments in the school stadium? Hmm, it's currently being used for the career expo, I'm afraid there won't be enough space. Perhaps you could ask Mr. Green for permission to use the theatre hall.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好主意！我可以在学校体育馆进行这些实验吗？嗯，目前那里正在用于职业博览会，恐怕没有足够的空间。也许你可以请格林先生允许使用剧院大厅。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. As for my analysis into stress levels of different social groups, including office workers, it is progressing well. What tasks do you still need to complete? I'm still unsure about what to do with the findings. It's better to compare yours with those of other students, so that you can get a more comprehensive picture of the subject. That's a great idea, I'll do that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。至于我对不同社会群体（包括办公室职员）压力水平的分析，进展顺利。你还需要完成什么任务？我还不确定怎么处理这些发现。最好把你的发现和其他学生的进行比较，这样你就能对这个主题有更全面的了解。好主意，我会做的。

transcriptBlocks.english: And I've been looking into utilising the school gym for the purpose of conducting experiments on bodily stress. Is this feasible? It would be a great idea. The bad news is although the gym can be used free of charge, it is currently closed, due to extensive maintenance work being carried out. You may consider renting one of the gyms in town. OK. I'll look into finding one.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我一直在考虑利用学校健身房来进行身体压力的实验。这可行吗？这会是好主意。坏消息是虽然健身房可以免费使用，但目前因大规模维护工作而关闭了。你可以考虑租用镇上的一个健身房。好的，我会去找找。

transcriptBlocks.english: What's for the last part of your preparation? I find the study of Heart Rate very interesting, particularly turbulence-related issues. I believe, if we are able to find the root causes for such a problem, then we would be closer to finding a cure.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你准备的最后一部分是什么？我发现心率的研究非常有趣，特别是与湍流相关的问题。我相信，如果我们能找到这种问题的根本原因，那我们就更接近找到治疗方法。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. What research method will you use? Will you conduct surveys at the hospital? I was thinking of that, but due to a lack of time, I may not be able to collect much data from there. A quicker alternative might be to surprise our audience with an anonymous test on the lecture day, regarding their family genetic history and predisposition to heart rate turbulence. Interesting, but I have some concerns about the way you're collecting data. People may not take it seriously, and the answers could be misleading. In the end, the data you obtain for your research will not be that clear though. Well, I could ask them again afterwards if I find anything wrong. Only if you can find them in time. The students that attend your presentation come from various schools this time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。你会用什么研究方法？你会在医院进行调查吗？我考虑过这个，但由于时间不够，我可能无法从那里收集太多数据。一个更快的选择可能是在讲座当天给观众一个匿名测试，关于他们的家族遗传史和心率湍流的易感性。有趣，但我对你收集数据的方式有一些担忧。人们可能不会认真对待，答案可能会误导。最终，你为研究获得的数据不会那么清晰。嗯，如果我发现问题，我可以之后再问他们。前提是你得及时找到他们。这次来听你展示的学生来自不同的学校。
