transcriptBlocks.english: To avoid further trouble in data collection, I suggest you collaborate with fellow students to share data and insights, leveraging a collective pool of resources and perspectives. Additionally, teaming up with a research professional could save you a lot of time and ensure a more thorough analysis of the data. If you can help me get in touch with a researcher, I would be very grateful. Sure, I'll contact some and let you know.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 为避免数据收集方面进一步的麻烦，我建议你和其他同学合作分享数据和见解，利用集体资源和视角。另外，与研究专业人士合作可以为你节省大量时间，并确保对数据进行更全面的分析。如果你能帮我联系一位研究人员，我会非常感激。当然，我会联系一些人并告诉你。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hi, Rob. How's your assignment going?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗨，罗布。你的作业进展怎么样？

transcriptBlocks.english: I think it's been going on pretty well, although there are still some problems that I need to figure out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我觉得进展得还不错，虽然还有一些问题需要解决。

transcriptBlocks.english: Let's see if I can help. What are you writing about?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我看看能不能帮上忙。你在写什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: I have a strong passion for music, so I decided to delve into that area. However, I am approaching it from a unique perspective -- examining its impact on individuals.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我对音乐有强烈的热情，所以我决定深入那个领域。不过，我是从一个独特的视角来探讨的——研究它对个体的影响。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ah, are you researching how music affects people's health?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 啊，你是在研究音乐如何影响人们的健康吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: No, I am interested in uncovering how music influences people's behavior in restaurants, particularly their choices and spending habits.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 不，我感兴趣的是揭示音乐如何影响人们在餐厅的行为，特别是他们的选择和消费习惯。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's quite interesting. What have you found out so far?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那相当有趣。你到目前为止发现了什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: I've visited a dozen different restaurants. Most of them play some music, but they all have their own strategies. In one restaurant named Shark's Delicacy, they play music in the main hall, the kitchen, even in the restrooms at certain times of the day. In another place called Sam's Café, they play different music but always at the same volume, so you might find the rock too quiet and the country too loud.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我去了十几家不同的餐厅。大多数都播放音乐，但各有各的策略。在一家叫“鲨鱼美食”的餐厅，他们在主厅、厨房、甚至一天中某些时候在洗手间播放音乐。在另一家叫“山姆咖啡馆”的地方，他们播放不同的音乐，但音量总是一样的，所以你可能会觉得摇滚太安静而乡村太吵。

transcriptBlocks.english: Looks like you've been eating out a lot these days!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 看来你这阵子经常在外面吃饭啊！

transcriptBlocks.english: So how are you going to get the information for your own topic? I'm thinking of using questionnaires. I can distribute them to the guests. Umm, I'm not sure if the restaurant would be happy with it. I will talk to the restaurant manager in advance. I've seen other people do that before, it shouldn't be a big problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那你打算怎么为自己的主题获取信息？我在考虑用问卷。我可以把它们分发给客人。嗯，我不确定餐厅会不会乐意。我会提前和餐厅经理谈。我以前见过别人这样做，应该不是大问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: What bothers me is whether I can get what I'm looking for from the customers via the questionnaires. If they already know your intention, then it's hard to get accurate answers. But you can try setting up a few misleading questions in the beginning of the questionnaire. This approach can help obscure the true focus of your survey.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 困扰我的是我能否通过问卷从顾客那里得到我想要的东西。如果他们知道了你的意图，就很难得到准确的答案。但你可以在问卷开头设置几个误导性问题。这种方法可以帮助掩盖你调查的真实重点。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's a great idea. But I won't be making up all the questions myself, I don't think I will have enough time. I plan to use questionnaires that last year's students made in their studies. Make some changes and modifications before you use those questions to suit your own research. I will.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好主意。但我不会自己编所有问题，我觉得时间不够。我打算用去年学生在研究中使用的问卷。在你使用那些问题之前做一些修改以适合你自己的研究。我会的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, I'll have to decide which restaurant to do the research in. Generally, when people choose a restaurant, location and the type of food served are important factors. Actually neither of those matters in this context. You should choose one that has more competitors around it, making it more typical. If it's the only restaurant of its type in that area, people have no choice but to eat there, you know. And you should probably go for larger ones, say, capable of seating around 100 diners or so, to collect more data. OK. Do I need to factor in the popularity of restaurants? Not necessary in this case.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来，我得决定在哪家餐厅做研究。一般来说，人们选择餐厅时，位置和食物类型是重要因素。实际上在这个语境下这两点都不重要。你应该选择周边有更多竞争对手的餐厅，这样更具代表性。如果它是那个区域唯一的同类餐厅，人们别无选择只能去那里吃，你知道的。而且你大概应该选大型一点的，比如能容纳大约100位食客左右的，以便收集更多数据。好的。我需要考虑餐厅的受欢迎程度吗？这种情况下不需要。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. I came across an interesting paper the other day. It gave a general overview of how different types of music affect the people in a specific restaurant. I'm thinking doing a test to see how it works.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。我前几天看到一篇有趣的论文。它概述了不同类型的音乐如何影响特定餐厅里的人。我在想做个测试看看效果如何。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, tell me more about it. For example, the paper mentioned that Jazz apparently makes people relaxed, so they tend to order more food and drinks and stay longer in the restaurant. And if people go to a restaurant where no music is played, the guests often think it's not worth the money, especially the high-end ones. I agree with this.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，跟我说说。比如，论文提到爵士乐显然让人放松，所以他们倾向于点更多食物和饮料，在餐厅待更久。如果人们去一个不播放音乐的餐厅，客人常常觉得不值那个钱，尤其是高档餐厅。我同意这一点。

transcriptBlocks.english: What about classical music? Does the paper comment about its effect? Yeah, it says people tend to leave as soon as they finish eating. I guess this type of music may be annoying to some young customers. I wasn't aware of that. I thought it works better than pop music. On the contrary, if a restaurant plays pop music, it tends to attract repeat customers, which is good for business. That's an interesting phenomenon. We'll see if the test results will be the same with what's described in that paper.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那古典音乐呢？论文中提及其效果了吗？是的，它说人们一吃完饭就倾向于离开。我猜这种音乐可能会让一些年轻顾客觉得烦。我不知道这点。我以为它比流行音乐效果更好。相反，如果餐厅播放流行音乐，往往能吸引回头客，这对生意有好处。这是一个有趣的现象。我们看看测试结果是否和论文中描述的一致。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hey, Paul. Have you decided what to study in your graduate school?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嘿，保罗。你决定好研究生学什么了吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hi Lily. It's a tough decision to make, but somehow, I managed. I'm going to study Tourism.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗨莉莉。这是一个艰难的决定，但无论如何，我做到了。我打算学旅游。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, really? That's quite a departure from your previous pursuits. Why did you choose to study it? Was it because you wanted to travel to more places?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，真的吗？那和你之前的追求很不一样。你为什么选择学这个？是因为你想去更多地方旅行吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, while I do enjoy being a tourist, I haven't had the opportunity to explore many different places yet. After conducting some research in the job market, I believe that studying tourism can offer me a promising future. My friend Mike has been in this field for several years. He is able to make good money and feels inspired every day. I guess that's what makes me more certain of my choice. Good for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，虽然我确实喜欢做游客，但我还没有机会探索很多不同的地方。在对就业市场做了些研究后，我相信学习旅游能给我带来有前途的未来。我的朋友迈克在这个领域已经好几年了。他能赚不错的钱，每天都感到有动力。我想这就是让我更确定自己选择的原因。为你高兴。

transcriptBlocks.english: Have you done some research about the prerequisites for this subject? Some schools may require work experience before starting the course. Yes. They usually accept students with some work experience in tourism. I don't have that, but I have an edge over most students, which is good financial management. As trip planning involves costs and expenses, applicants need to have relevant skills. I've always lived in rented places since high school, which has given me quite a bit of experience in making budgets and planning my money. That's interesting.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你对这门学科的先修要求做过研究吗？有些学校可能要求在开始课程前有工作经验。是的。他们通常接受在旅游业有工作经验的学生。我没有，但我有一个优于大多数学生的优势，就是良好的财务管理。因为旅行规划涉及成本和开支，申请人需要有相关技能。我从高中起就一直租房住，这使我在做预算和规划资金方面有了相当多的经验。那挺有意思的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yeah. And because of that, I learned how to take care of myself and go to different places on my own. You know, it happens to be something a qualified tour guide should have. I understand. I probably have to work on my temper, being a bit more patient as I can't stand waiting for people for too long. You know, there are always clients who wake up late and have other people wait for them to start the tour of the day. Yeah, that's typical. You'll have to learn to tolerate that. Anyway, which school are you going to?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的。正因为如此，我学会了照顾自己，独自去不同的地方。你知道，这恰好是一个合格导游应该具备的素质。我明白。我可能得改改我的脾气，多一点耐心，因为我受不了等人太久。你知道，总有客户起晚了，让别人等他们开始当天的旅行。是的，这很典型。你得学会容忍。不管怎样，你要去哪个学校？

transcriptBlocks.english: A polytechnic. Even though my cousin said it was very expensive, I still chose to go. Many students are interested in attending this school, and what I can learn there will be very practical after I graduate. I'm not sure if it's easy to find a job with a degree from a polytechnic. Moreover, nobody can predict what will happen 10 years from now. We'll see what happens until then.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 一所理工学院。虽然我表姐说它很贵，但我还是选择了去。很多学生都有兴趣上这所学校，而且我在那里学的东西毕业后会很实用。我不确定理工学院的学位是否容易找到工作。而且，没人能预测10年后会发生什么。到那时再看吧。

transcriptBlocks.english: What's your curriculum like in the first term? Oh. There are quite a few. There's a course named travel and business. Sounds easy. We've taken a similar course before. According to the instructor's email I received yesterday, there's a lot to learn. I'll take quite a lot of quizzes before the final exam, looks really tough. Wow. Good luck with that. Thanks. And I'll study the culture of different countries and places. It requires us to have leadership skills since we have to be able to arrange group talks in this course and talk about the cultural customs in front of the public. That's not hard for you. You are a good public speaker.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你第一学期的课程是什么样的？哦。有不少呢。有一门叫旅行与商务的课。听起来不难。我们以前上过类似的课。根据我昨天收到的导师邮件，要学的东西很多。期末考试前会有很多小测验，看起来真的很难。哇。祝你好运。谢谢。我还要学习不同国家和地方的文化。这门课需要我们具备领导能力，因为我们要能安排小组讨论，在公众面前谈论文化习俗。这对你来说不难。你很擅长公开演讲。

transcriptBlocks.english: That doesn't bother me as much as the Japanese and Mandarin course, in which I have to acquire conversational language skills in these two oriental languages. Oh, I spent a few years learning these two languages, perhaps I can help you if needed. That's good to know. And guess what, we need to learn about mechanic operations. What does that have to do with tourism? I was confused at first too. But then my tutor explained that understanding basic mechanic operations is crucial for managing and maintaining vehicles used in adventure tourism, like off-road vehicles for safaris or bikes for mountain tours. It's all about ensuring safety and reliability during trips. Ah, that makes sense. I guess they also teach you medical skills to deal with accidents in this course, right? Exactly. It's quite essential for ensuring tourists' safety and dealing with emergencies effectively. I think I'm going to become well-rounded.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那个倒还好，不如日语和普通话课程让我担心，在那门课里我要掌握这两种东方语言的会话能力。哦，我花了几年学这两门语言，如果需要的话也许我能帮你。那太好了。你猜怎么着，我们还要学机械操作。那和旅游有什么关系？一开始我也很困惑。但后来我的导师解释说，理解基本的机械操作对于管理和维护冒险旅游中使用的车辆至关重要，比如游猎用的越野车或山地旅行的自行车。这完全是为了确保旅行中的安全和可靠性。啊，这就说得通了。我猜这门课还教你们处理事故的医疗技能吧？正是。这对于确保游客安全和有效处理紧急情况非常必要。我想我会变得很全面。

transcriptBlocks.english: Do you need to learn anything about setting up marketing events during peak seasons? There is a course related to it, but it's optional. There's one more course named "Computing of Tourism". Does it require you to be tech-savvy? Like, do you need to do some coding during the course? It's not about developing any tools. In this course, we learn how to use existing tools to enhance customer relationship skills. This includes managing bookings, providing personalized services through data analysis, and effectively communicating with clients online. Interesting. Overall, that's already a ton of courses! Hope you can manage time well for studying them. Yeah, I'll work on that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你需要学习在旺季策划营销活动吗？有一门相关的课，但是选修的。还有一门课叫“旅游计算机应用”。它要求你精通技术吗？比如，你需要在课程中编程吗？那不是关于开发工具的。在这门课里，我们学习如何使用现有工具来增强客户关系技能。这包括管理预订、通过数据分析提供个性化服务，以及在线与客户有效沟通。有趣。总的来说，这已经是一大堆课程了！希望你能好好管理时间学习它们。嗯，我会努力的。

transcriptBlocks.english: I think we also need to report on the methods we used to collect data, which are interviews and inspections. Not really, inspections were in the plan, but in fact we opted for observations because it'd be more effective. Oh yes, I'll correct it later.

transcriptBlocks.english: In regards to the interviews, should we report that we expected to get 450 volunteers for interview, but that only 126 responded? Most of them are from further education colleges. Yes, we need to note that in our essay, but remember it was 136. I have to say that was very disappointing. I wonder how we could have got more people to participate? Perhaps next time we could offer a small prize -- for example, participants could go into a draw to win one of ten cinema tickets. That's a great idea, I think some kind of incentive would assist greatly.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 关于访谈，我们是否应该报告我们原本期望有450名志愿者接受访谈，但只有126人回应？他们大多来自继续教育学院。是的，我们需要在论文中注明这一点，但记住是136人。我不得不说这非常令人失望。我想我们怎么能让更多人参与呢？也许下次我们可以提供一个小奖品——比如，参与者可以参加抽奖，赢取十张电影票中的一张。好主意，我认为某种激励措施会很有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Also, I think that perhaps the research tool wasn't as good as it could have been, there was some confusion on what they should do, so they couldn't complete their assignments due to lack of time. Yes. I have also heard from at least ten students who have complained about unexpected issues with distance learning, such as being cut off during class due to internet connection problems, or experiencing slow progress in group work because people don't communicate much with each other online. I've made a note of that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另外，我认为研究工具可能不够好，参与者对应该做什么有些困惑，所以他们因为时间不够无法完成作业。是的。我还从至少十个学生那里听到他们抱怨远程学习的意外问题，比如因为网络连接问题在课堂上掉线，或者因为人们在网上交流不多而导致小组工作进展缓慢。我已经记下了这一点。

transcriptBlocks.english: And Part 3 of the Essay -- our findings. What would you say are the major findings? I would say that during our research, a major problem was the bad design of the tool. The fact that it was a bit clunky to use and not formatted well? No, I mean that some of the questions were useless and didn't even relate to the topic. I am not sure who designed those, but perhaps we should have reviewed them and made some changes beforehand.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 论文的第三部分——我们的发现。你觉得主要的发现是什么？我认为在我们的研究中，一个主要问题是工具的设计不佳。是使用起来有点笨重且格式不佳吗？不，我是说有些问题没用，甚至与主题无关。我不知道是谁设计的，但也许我们应该事先审查并做一些修改。

transcriptBlocks.english: I understand your point. So what are your thoughts on the differences in results between young students and older ones? Do you think that mature students have any advantages over younger students? Absolutely. Young people are less experienced and tend to be distracted, but older ones show more independence and so can focus on the course. What do you think? I couldn't agree more. For example, due to their life experience, they can often learn with multiple learning styles and effective methods. Indeed. Well, let's get started on the essay, shall we? Yes, let's begin.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我理解你的观点。那关于年轻学生和年长学生结果的差异，你有什么想法？你认为成熟学生比年轻学生有优势吗？当然。年轻人经验较少，容易分心，但年长者表现出更多的独立性，因此能专注于课程。你觉得呢？我完全同意。例如，由于他们的生活经验，他们通常能以多种学习方式和有效方法学习。确实。好了，我们开始写论文吧，好吗？好的，开始吧。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hi Jack, Charlotte. How is your research going with the Willows company?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗨杰克、夏洛特。你们对威洛斯公司的研究进展如何？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Johnson, we've just finished the survey.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 约翰逊先生，我们刚完成调查。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's good. I remember this company used to operate massive production lines. I wonder how they're doing lately?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 很好。我记得这家公司过去运营着大规模生产线。我想知道他们最近怎么样？

transcriptBlocks.english: You're right. In the past, they manufactured various kinds of furniture, in the hope they would be able to expand their retail outlets and increase the profits of the company. However, after a few years of trial, they realized it wasn't profitable and now focus solely on producing one type of product.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你说得对。过去，他们生产各种家具，希望能扩大零售网点，增加公司利润。然而，经过几年的尝试，他们意识到这并不盈利，现在只专注于生产一种产品。

transcriptBlocks.english: Fair enough. How did you two decide to focus on this company for your survey? Did you contact any former executives?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有道理。你们俩是怎么决定把这家公司作为调查对象的？你们联系了以前的高管吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, I've been interested in this company for a while because many of our schoolmates work there full-time after graduation. I guess there must be something special about it. Then one day, the manager of the company read an article by the head of our department, Ms. Walton, and reached out to her. Coincidentally, we were selecting a company in the furniture industry for the survey, she recommended the Willows.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我对这家公司感兴趣有一段时间了，因为我们很多同学毕业后都在那里全职工作。我想它一定有什么特别之处。然后有一天，公司的经理读了我们系主任沃尔顿女士的一篇文章，联系了她。巧合的是，我们正在为调查选择一家家具行业的公司，她推荐了威洛斯。

transcriptBlocks.english: Interesting! What is your opinion on the new software? Do you think the company will find it difficult to use? I personally found it quite straightforward to master. I think it's very helpful. At the moment, it seems that many staff learn to use it quickly, but the long-term outcome is uncertain. It's possible that the old software might be more beneficial for them. Yeah, I agree.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有趣！你们对新软件有什么看法？你们觉得公司会发现它难用吗？我个人觉得它很容易掌握。我觉得它很有帮助。目前，似乎很多员工很快学会了使用，但长期效果还不确定。也许旧软件对他们更有益。是的，我同意。

transcriptBlocks.english: How do you plan to test our new system? Jack and I are planning to ask the IT department for help. They don't have that kind of team in the company, unfortunately. Well, it looks like we'll have to dive into the account details ourselves and keep a complete record. That works, but if you need any kind of data, you will need the manager's permission first. Got that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们计划如何测试我们的新系统？杰克和我计划请IT部门帮忙。不幸的是，公司里没有那样的团队。嗯，看来我们得自己深入研究账户细节并保持完整记录。这可行，但如果你们需要任何数据，首先需要经理的许可。明白了。

transcriptBlocks.english: How did you conduct your interviews? I thought about doing that via online communication, but Jack didn't think it would be that effective. The staff were quite busy during the peak season, so they wanted the interviews to be short and neat. Therefore, we decided to meet them in person and finish all our interviews within one day to avoid disturbing the company later on. Yeah, that would save us a lot of trouble. Understandable.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们是怎么进行访谈的？我考虑过通过在线沟通进行，但杰克认为那样效果不太好。员工在旺季很忙，所以他们希望访谈简短精炼。因此，我们决定亲自见他们，在一天内完成所有访谈，以免以后打扰公司。是的，那会省去我们很多麻烦。可以理解。

transcriptBlocks.english: The questionnaire you use in the application process for this company has received mixed reactions. How do you feel? I'm disappointed because of the little response we received. Me too. I thought it should be rated highly because we spent a lot of time on it. Well, some parts need improvement, but overall, the questionnaire is better than many I've seen. I hope you can improve it further next time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们在这家公司的申请过程中使用的问卷得到了褒贬不一的反应。你们感觉如何？我很失望，因为回应很少。我也是。我以为它应该获得高度评价，因为我们花了大量时间在上面。嗯，有些部分需要改进，但总的来说，这份问卷比我见过的很多都好。希望你们下次能进一步改进。

transcriptBlocks.english: How do you feel the company will benefit from the new software? It's not likely to boost sales or profits. However, it should allow them to increase the size of their workforce. The current workforce is stretched to the limit to fill their orders. I assume it will also reduce the time it takes to produce their stock. Unfortunately, that won't be the case. But labour costs overall will be significantly reduced.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们觉得这家公司会从新软件中受益吗？不太可能提升销售额或利润。不过，它应该能让他们扩大员工规模。目前的员工队伍为了完成订单已经满负荷运转。我猜它也会减少生产库存所需的时间。不幸的是，情况并非如此。但总体劳动力成本将显著降低。

transcriptBlocks.english: What kinds of effects do you think this new software may have? For customers, they can actively participate in the design process for custom-made furniture. The new system enables them to submit requirements and feedback online. At the same time, the company can monitor and evaluate the workload based on these requirements. If there is a shortage of staff, they can instantly start recruiting. However, one drawback is that the designers work offline in the factory, so they cannot access the feedback system themselves. They each have an assistant who will print out customers' feedback and place it on their desks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们认为新软件可能产生什么样的影响？对于客户来说，他们可以积极参与定制家具的设计过程。新系统使他们能够在线提交需求和反馈。同时，公司可以根据这些需求监控和评估工作量。如果人手不足，他们可以立即开始招聘。然而，一个缺点是设计师在工厂里离线工作，所以他们自己无法访问反馈系统。他们每个人都有一个助手，会打印出客户的反馈放在他们桌子上。

transcriptBlocks.english: Don't you think that some customers may have limited knowledge about online submission? That shouldn't be a problem. As far as I know, most of the customers are familiar with online submission, and there were few complaints about technical problems. Besides, customers no longer need to wait to meet the designers in person to discuss their needs, they can now submit their wants and needs online whenever they are ready.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们不认为有些客户对在线提交的了解有限吗？那应该不是问题。据我所知，大多数客户都熟悉在线提交，关于技术问题的投诉很少。此外，客户不再需要等着亲自见设计师讨论需求，他们现在可以在准备好时随时在线提交他们的需求和需要。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, we shall see how this system goes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我们看看这个系统运行得怎么样。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello Mike. Come and have a seat, please.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好迈克。请进来坐。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you. You asked to see me. Is it about my report?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢。您找我。是关于我的报告吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, Mike. Actually, I'm very interested in your topic--oral history. How did you come up with this idea?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，迈克。实际上，我对你的主题——口述历史——很感兴趣。你是怎么想到这个主意的？

transcriptBlocks.english: I first heard of this idea from the Internet. Then, I went to a lecture a week ago and I saw the definition of it on the handouts from the teacher. I became quite interested in it, so I decided to write a report on this topic.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我最初是在网上听说这个想法的。然后，一周前我去听了一个讲座，在老师发的讲义上看到了它的定义。我对此产生了浓厚的兴趣，所以决定写一篇关于这个主题的报告。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ok. The topic may be nothing new but it has been changing in recent years because of the development of science and technology. That's true. One thing I realized is that the Internet allowed more people to have better access to oral history, so the students became more interested in it because of the information they got. However, the most important influence from the Internet is that a lot of resources, such as the recording, can be well kept online. In the past, lots of historical records were lost or damaged, which is a shame. Digital information can be stored for much longer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。这个主题可能不是什么新东西，但近年来因为科技的发展一直在变化。确实。我意识到的一件事是，互联网让更多人能更好地接触到口述历史，所以学生们因为获得的信息而对它更感兴趣。然而，互联网最重要的影响是很多资源，比如录音，可以在网上很好地保存。过去，很多历史记录丢失或损坏了，真可惜。数字信息可以保存得更久。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, hmm, you relate oral history specifically to local football. What made you choose this direction?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 所以，嗯，你把口述历史具体和本地足球联系起来。是什么让你选择了这个方向？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yeah. Actually, I knew nothing about football before. I don't really watch football games. Neither do my friends. Luckily, I could discuss this topic with my father because he has a lot of knowledge about it. He's a big fan of it. No wonder. Where did you find all the records of the past games?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的。其实我以前对足球一无所知。我不太看足球比赛。我的朋友也不看。幸运的是，我可以和我父亲讨论这个话题，因为他很了解足球。他是个超级球迷。难怪。你在哪里找到过去比赛的所有记录的？

transcriptBlocks.english: I don't really think the local football team would post them on the Internet. You're right. I tried a few sports websites, but I couldn't find any. I also went to the biggest bookstore in town to check whether they sold anything relevant, but the attempt wasn't successful either. Later, I found what I wanted in the oldest library in town, so I borrowed all the old newspapers with reports about the games.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我不太认为本地足球队会把它们发到网上。你说得对。我试了几个体育网站，但什么也没找到。我也去了城里最大的书店看看他们是否有卖相关的东西，但也没成功。后来，我在城里最古老的图书馆找到了我要的东西，所以我借了所有有比赛报道的旧报纸。

transcriptBlocks.english: You worked hard. How did you get in touch with the retired football players?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你下了不少功夫。你是怎么联系上退役足球运动员的？

transcriptBlocks.english: I did some research online. There was limited information about the players. Then I went to the local football club to ask the current owner, but he couldn't remember. When I was about to leave, I found an old phone book there. The numbers are still valid. So I got in touch with some of the players. It's like treasure hunting. Interesting! Maybe you can write something about it. I will try.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我在网上做了一些研究。关于球员的信息有限。然后我去了当地足球俱乐部问现在的老板，但他不记得了。当我正要离开时，我在那里发现了一本旧电话簿。那些号码仍然有效。所以我和一些球员取得了联系。就像寻宝一样。有趣！也许你可以写点相关的。我会试试的。

transcriptBlocks.english: There are some things that you could improve in your report and the recordings. Oh, feel free to point them out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你的报告和录音有一些可以改进的地方。哦，请指出来。

transcriptBlocks.english: I saw the questions for the football players you prepared on the draft. I think some of them are too complex. You should simplify them. I was afraid those players wouldn't understand if they are too simple. OK. I will do that later.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我看到了你在草稿上为足球运动员准备的问题。我觉得有些太复杂了。你应该简化它们。我担心如果太简单那些球员会不理解。好的。我稍后会改。

transcriptBlocks.english: And the interview with the players lasted about two hours. It is just too long. Most of the listeners won't be patient enough to finish it all. I will do some editing and make it shorter. Yeah, that would be better. What equipment did you use for the recording? The quality of the recordings is really bad. I wonder if you could find better equipment and do it again. Oh, that would be a lot of work. I will try to see if I can do that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对球员的采访持续了大约两个小时。太长了。大多数听众没有耐心听完。我会剪辑一下，缩短时长。是的，那样会更好。你用了什么设备录音？录音质量真的很差。我想你能不能找到更好的设备重新录一遍。哦，那会工作量很大。我会看看能不能做到。

transcriptBlocks.english: How about my topic about the performance of our local football team over the years? It's a good topic, but I think it's too general. You should probably be more specific and add more details. And your report is filled with too many facts. Remember, this is different from writing a news report. I guess I over quote their words and add some unnecessary facts in the report. Yes. You need to give your own ideas about the football club and everything. Thank you so much for the advice. I am happy to help.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我关于我们本地足球队历年表现的主题怎么样？这是个好主题，但我觉得太宽泛了。你可能应该更具体一些，增加更多细节。而且你的报告里有太多事实陈述了。记住，这不同于写新闻报道。我想我过度引用了他们的话，并在报告中加入了一些不必要的实事。是的。你需要给出你自己关于足球俱乐部和所有事情的想法。非常感谢您的建议。很高兴能帮忙。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Hello Jack. Come in and have a seat. You said you need me to give you some suggestions. So, how can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：你好杰克。请进坐。你说你需要我给你一些建议。那么，我能怎么帮你？

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: Well, I'm a little confused these days. I'm not sure whether I should change my major or not.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：嗯，我这几天有点困惑。我不确定我是否应该换专业。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Well, you are studying chemistry, right? I think that's a good major. why are you thinking of changing it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：嗯，你学的是化学，对吧？我觉得那是个好专业。你为什么想换？

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: Actually, I'm doing quite good in this subject. Last year I had good results in my final exams. My teacher was very happy with my performance. And my parents wanted me to continue studying it. However, the problem is that I think chemistry is a little boring. I'm not very motivated.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：实际上，我这门课学得不错。去年我期末考试成绩很好。我的老师对我的表现很满意。我的父母也希望我继续学。然而，问题是我觉得化学有点无聊。我不太有动力。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Chemistry is not easy to learn. I'm glad to hear that you can learn it well. But I understand enthusiasm is also very important for you to succeed in your studies. So, tell me what you have in mind, Jack.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：化学不容易学。很高兴听到你能学得好。但我理解热情对你学业的成功也很重要。所以，告诉我你的想法，杰克。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: Actually, I was thinking of taking a double degree. I mean I could still learn chemistry, but I can learn something else at the same time. A major and a minor.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：实际上，我在考虑修双学位。我的意思是，我仍然可以学化学，但同时可以学点别的。一个主修和一个辅修。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: That sounds like a good idea. You can use your spare time to learn something that is more interesting. You have spare time to do it, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：听起来是个好主意。你可以用业余时间学点更有趣的东西。你有业余时间来做，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: Yes, I do. But I'm not really sure what minor I should choose. I don't want to waste my time. I first thought of studying painting.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：是的，我有。但我不太确定该选什么辅修。我不想浪费时间。我首先想到学绘画。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: It requires some basic skills. So, I think it might be a little difficult for you. Why don't you learn a language course? You could learn Japanese. It can be helpful in your future career.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：那需要一些基础技能。所以，我觉得对你来说可能有点难。你为什么不学一门语言课程呢？你可以学日语。这对你未来的职业可能有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: That sounds interesting. I do want to travel in the Asian countries in the future, but I'm not sure if it would take me too much time to learn another language.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：听起来很有趣。我确实想将来去亚洲国家旅行，但我不确定学另一门语言会不会花太多时间。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Language studying needs a lot of effort and of course there will be extra workload if you do take a second major.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：语言学习需要很多努力，当然如果你修第二专业，会有额外的课业负担。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: I understand. If I want to learn anything well, I should work hard on it. Another thought is to switch my major to engineering.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：我理解。如果我想学好任何东西，就应该努力。另一个想法是把专业换成工程学。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Why engineering? Is it because you are very interested in it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：为什么是工程学？是因为你很感兴趣吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: Actually, I have heard from some senior students that there are many job opportunities for graduates with an engineering degree in the current job market. So, I think it might be more practical for me. It's not easy to find a good job nowadays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：实际上，我从一些高年级学生那里听说，在当前就业市场上，工程学位的毕业生有很多工作机会。所以，我觉得对我来说可能更实用。现在找份好工作不容易。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: The society needs many kinds of engineers these days to support the technological and social development. You can give it a try if you truly think it's a good choice for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：当今社会需要多种工程师来支持技术和社会发展。如果你真的认为这对你是个好选择，你可以试试。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: I have been thinking about it for two weeks. The biggest problem is the fees are quite high for studying engineering. So, I probably need to take one more part time job to pay for the tuition.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：我已经考虑了两周。最大的问题是学工程的费用相当高。所以，我可能得再打一份兼职来支付学费。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: It will be worth it. There are a lot of part time jobs on the campus, you can try.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：那会值得的。校园里有很多兼职工作，你可以试试。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: As you said, chemistry is not a bad major. I mean when I graduate from university I can have a chance to further my study in a foreign country.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：正如您所说，化学不是个差专业。我的意思是，当我大学毕业时，我有机会去国外深造。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: That's true for engineering majors too. There are plenty of good schools out there for you to choose. Of course, you will need a good record of academic performances.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：工程专业也一样。外面有很多好学校供你选择。当然，你需要有良好的学业成绩记录。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: And I also heard that engineering graduates can get a quite decent salary.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：我还听说工程毕业生能拿到相当不错的薪水。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: They usually have a good initial salary but the prospect may be somewhat narrow in the long run. It depends on your work ability.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：他们通常起薪不错，但从长远来看前景可能有些狭窄。这取决于你的工作能力。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: Oh, I think career prospect is very important. Chemistry is good in this respect because I can work in many different companies, even though the jobs may be very hard to find.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：哦，我认为职业前景非常重要。化学在这方面不错，因为我可以在很多不同的公司工作，尽管工作可能很难找。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: True. Chemistry is fundamental science that can be applied in many different areas.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：没错。化学是基础科学，可以应用于许多不同的领域。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: So, which major do you think is better if I consider working overseas? I really like traveling. I might travel and work abroad for a few years.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：那么，如果我考虑去海外工作，您觉得哪个专业更好？我真的很喜欢旅行。我可能会在国外旅行和工作几年。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Engineering majors are popular in some foreign companies, so it might be better if you have a travel plan already.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：工程专业在一些外国公司很受欢迎，所以如果你已经有旅行计划的话，可能更好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jack: This is really a tough decision, but now I think I have a clearer idea about what to do next. Thank you so much for your help!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 杰克：这真的是个艰难的决定，但现在我想我对下一步该做什么有了更清晰的想法。非常感谢您的帮助！

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Hello, Jenny, Tom. Tell me more about the problems you mentioned in your email for the business report.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：你好，珍妮，汤姆。告诉我更多你们在邮件中提到的关于商业报告的问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tom: There are so many different methods for business analysis. And we find some of them kind of confusing.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 汤姆：商业分析的方法太多了。我们发现其中一些有点令人困惑。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jenny: Yes. Take PEST analysis as an example. It is a method that involves political, economic, social and technological areas. And it is part of external analysis for conducting strategic analysis when doing market research. I don't really think it is suitable for our field of research.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 珍妮：是的。以PEST分析为例。它是一种涉及政治、经济、社会和技术领域的方法。它是在进行市场研究时进行战略分析的外部分析的一部分。我不太认为它适合我们的研究领域。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Right. It gives you an overview of different macro environmental factors that can be taken into consideration. However, you need to look from a more detailed perspective.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：对。它让你对不同的宏观环境因素有一个概览，可以考虑进去。然而，你需要从更细致的角度来看。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tom: In terms of the drill-down analysis method, it sounds very complicated. The book says it involves assessing information by starting with the general categories and moving through the hierarchy.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 汤姆：关于下钻分析法，听起来很复杂。书上说它涉及从一般类别开始，通过层次结构来评估信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Well, it provides a method of exploring multidimensional data, but it's very challenging to apply because it requires you to move from one level of detail to the next.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：嗯，它提供了一种探索多维数据的方法，但应用起来很有挑战性，因为它要求你从一个细节层次过渡到下一个。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jenny: We agree. Pareto analysis sounds very useful, though.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 珍妮：我们同意。不过帕累托分析听起来很有用。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Yeah, it's a very formal technique. In essence, the problem solver should estimate the benefit delivered by each action and then select a number of the most effective actions that deliver a total benefit. Tom: That still sounds really confusing. And I think it will take ages.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：是的，它是一种非常正式的技术。本质上，解决问题的人应该估计每个行动带来的收益，然后选择一些最有效的行动来实现总收益。汤姆：那听起来还是很让人困惑。而且我觉得要花很长时间。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: This method is quite time consuming. If you want a quicker way, then you should probably look into something else.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：这种方法相当耗时。如果你们想要更快的方法，那大概应该看看别的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tom: What about the PMI method? It seems quite applicable to me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 汤姆：那PMI方法呢？我觉得它很适用。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: PMI is easy to use because companies just have to identify different types of materials, so it can save them a lot of time. I really recommend this method.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：PMI很容易使用，因为公司只需要识别不同类型的材料，所以可以节省很多时间。我真的很推荐这个方法。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jenny: I think SWOT analysis is also very useful. It's a strategic planning technique used to help a person or organization to identify the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats related to business competition.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 珍妮：我觉得SWOT分析也很有用。它是一种战略规划技术，用于帮助个人或组织识别与商业竞争相关的优势、劣势、机会和威胁。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: Right. The good thing about it is that companies of all sizes can use this analysis method to generate meaningful information and to identify their own competitive advantage.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：对。它的好处是各种规模的公司都可以使用这种分析方法来生成有意义的信息，并识别自己的竞争优势。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tom: We are specifically looking into the manufacturing industry and we feel like that it's really hard for this industry to develop these days.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 汤姆：我们特别在关注制造业，我们觉得这个行业现在真的很难发展。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: It's true. With the advancement of technology, traditional companies are facing a lot of threats. But the reputation of a company can no longer guarantee business success.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：确实。随着技术的进步，传统公司面临很多威胁。但公司的声誉不再能保证商业成功。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jenny: Yeah. And the traditional method of collecting competitors' information is not useful anymore. Companies even put it on their websites for everybody to see. However, companies with experienced employees have a competitive edge. Talents are vital for the future of the manufacturing industry.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 珍妮：是的。收集竞争对手信息的传统方法已经不管用了。公司甚至把它放在网站上让所有人都能看到。然而，拥有有经验员工的公司具有竞争优势。人才对制造业的未来至关重要。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: That's a very good point. In order to succeed, traditional manufacturers should no longer use the old methods like trying to reduce the cost by recruiting cheaper labor force. They should have good business vision, such as trying to expand the market overseas. This will make their business stronger.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：说得好。为了成功，传统制造商不应再使用旧方法，比如试图通过招聘更便宜的劳动力来降低成本。他们应该有良好的商业愿景，比如尝试拓展海外市场。这会让他们的业务更强大。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tom: Domestic market is kind of stable now and there isn't much room for further growth.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 汤姆：国内市场现在比较稳定，没有太多进一步增长的空间。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: It's not easy, but they should not limit themselves to it. Businesses are now using new kinds of advertising, such as the advertisements on cell phones. What impresses me most is that some governments made new legislation to encourage businesses to grow.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：这不容易，但他们不应该限制自己。企业现在使用新型广告，比如手机上的广告。最让我印象深刻的是，一些政府制定了新法规来鼓励企业发展。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jenny: I believe government is working very hard to promote business sector. At the same time, science and technology are growing very fast these days. All of these allow better efficiency in many different areas. Another challenge is we had no problem finding the reference books. Yet, we still find the report difficult to write.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 珍妮：我相信政府在非常努力地推动商业部门的发展。同时，当今科技发展非常迅速。所有这些都在许多不同领域带来了更好的效率。另一个挑战是我们找参考书没问题。但我们仍然觉得报告难写。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tom: There is a lot of information online. So, it's not hard to come up with a good outline. But it's difficult for us to put the theory into practice. I can't find very good examples to support our ideas.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 汤姆：网上有很多信息。所以，想出一个好提纲并不难。但对我们来说，把理论付诸实践很难。我找不到很好的例子来支持我们的观点。

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: I think you should visit some companies or factories to learn more about the actual situation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：我觉得你们应该去参观一些公司或工厂，了解更多实际情况。

transcriptBlocks.english: Jenny: Are there other suggestions for our report?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 珍妮：对我们的报告还有其他建议吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Tutor: You have a clear plan and overall structure. But your report does not have a summary at the end. so, you should work on that. Let's see, the information you provided is quite detailed. So that's good. Tom: OK. Thank you. We will review all the advice.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 导师：你们有清晰的计划和整体结构。但你们的报告最后没有总结。所以，你们应该在这方面下功夫。让我看看，你们提供的信息相当详细。所以那很好。汤姆：好的。谢谢。我们会审阅所有建议。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Hello Mr. Cagle. Thank you for meeting me to talk about my case study.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：你好，卡格尔先生。感谢您抽时间和我谈我的案例研究。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: You're welcome, Susan. I'm very happy that you are interested in my organization and I think your work would be helpful for us too.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：不客气，苏珊。很高兴你对我的组织感兴趣，我觉得你的工作对我们也有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: I know your company organizes field trips especially for teachers and students from schools. Right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：我知道贵公司组织实地考察，特别是针对学校的老师和学生。对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: You are right. At the beginning, the area for some field trips was suffering from environmental problems, so the students were not very happy about it. But when the local government realized the problem, laws were made to regulate exploitation of the natural resources there, which gave us an opportunity to start improving the environment. We later did things like bringing more species like trees and plants, adding more trash cans and inviting students as volunteers to help.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：你说得对。一开始，一些实地考察的区域存在环境问题，所以学生们不太高兴。但当地政府意识到问题后，制定了法律来规范那里的自然资源开发，这给了我们开始改善环境的机会。后来我们做了诸如引进更多树木和植物物种、增加垃圾桶、邀请学生作为志愿者来帮忙等事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: I certainly can tell the changes. So why did you set up the field trip program in the very beginning?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：我确实能看出变化。那么你们最初为什么要设立实地考察项目呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Well, I set up this in order to provide a chance for students to learn something outside school. At that time, I tried to convince local community and the government that I was making meaningful change to the old education system but that attempt was not very successful.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：嗯，我设立这个是为了给学生提供在校外学习的机会。那时，我试图说服当地社区和政府，我正在对旧教育体系进行有意义的改变，但那次尝试不太成功。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: I guess not many people understood the importance back then. But your organization is doing quite good now.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：我猜那时没多少人理解其重要性。但你们的组织现在做得相当好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: You can say that. We publicize an operation report every month, our latest report showed that even though there are still things that need to be improved, we've helped about 200 students and teachers in their work and studies. So, we are positive about the future.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：可以这么说。我们每月发布运营报告，我们最新的报告显示，尽管仍有需要改进的地方，我们已经帮助了大约200名学生和老师的工作和学习。所以，我们对未来持乐观态度。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: What plans do you have for the future?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：你们对未来有什么计划？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Actually, we are planning to change our business model and start designing special packages for our customers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：实际上，我们正计划改变商业模式，开始为客户设计特别套餐。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Can you tell me a bit more about it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：能再多告诉我一些吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Well, we have completed our research on a package for students. It contains special routes, food, drink and activities. I think it's going to be popular. We are thinking of making packages for teachers in the future to meet their specific needs.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：嗯，我们已经完成了对学生套餐的研究。它包含特别路线、食物、饮料和活动。我觉得它会很受欢迎。我们正在考虑将来为教师制作套餐，以满足他们的特定需求。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: That sounds interesting. Can you tell me how exactly these field trips can help the students?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：听起来很有趣。你能告诉我这些实地考察到底如何帮助学生吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Let me give you an example. When some of the participants first came here, they were quite shy, but after this activity, they became more comfortable expressing themselves and less nervous to speak in front of the public. I think that's good.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：我给你举个例子。当一些参与者第一次来的时候，他们很害羞，但经过这个活动后，他们变得更自在地表达自己，在公众面前说话也不那么紧张了。我觉得那很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Yeah, it's a very important change in personality improvement. Are there any other benefits?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：是的，这是个性提升中一个非常重要的变化。还有其他好处吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: We set specific rules, like if they were late for a gathering, they would be punished. As a result, students tried to show up on time. This will be useful in their future career.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：我们制定了具体规则，比如如果他们集会迟到，就会受到惩罚。结果，学生们努力准时出现。这对他们将来的职业生涯会有用。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: I have made an outline of points to talk about in my presentation. Can you take a look at it for me?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：我已经为我的展示列了一个要点提纲。你能帮我看一下吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: OK. Let's see...... I don't think the background of our organization is necessary. People probably are more interested in our current situation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：好的。让我看看……我觉得我们组织的背景没必要写。人们可能对我们目前的状况更感兴趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Right. I will remove that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：好的。我会删掉那个。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: I think you should tell people how to operate the gear we provide.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：我觉得你应该告诉人们如何操作我们提供的装备。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: OK, I'll include equipment instructions. Is there anything else that needs to be changed?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：好的，我会加上设备说明。还有其他需要改的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Let me see, the purpose of our programs......you already have it here. Oh, the conservation rules are something you should add.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：让我看看，我们项目的宗旨……你已经有了。哦，保护规则是你要加的内容。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: What is that exactly?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：那具体是什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Well, we hope more people can be aware of protecting the environment, you could use this chance to educate them and let them know our rules here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：嗯，我们希望更多人能意识到保护环境，你可以利用这个机会教育他们，让他们知道我们这里的规则。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Yes, I almost forgot that. Do you think it's important to mention the health benefits of field trips?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：是的，我差点忘了。你觉得有必要提到实地考察的健康益处吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: You don't have to write about that. I think they have to experience and learn it by themselves.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：你不必写那个。我觉得他们必须自己去体验和学习。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Okay. There are still many things I should modify for this presentation. I have done reading your report of your operations, but I wanted to take some photos of this place. Too bad, my camera is broken.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：好的。这个展示还有很多需要修改的地方。我已经读了你们的运营报告，但我本来想拍些这个地方的照片。可惜我的相机坏了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: I can send some photos to you later. Also, I think you should join one of our trips, especially our group activity.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：我可以稍后发些照片给你。另外，我觉得你应该参加我们的一次旅行，特别是我们的团体活动。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: That's right. I can write about my personal experience.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：对。我可以写我的个人经历。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: Do you want to make a photocopy of our packages?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：你想复印一份我们的套餐资料吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: That wouldn't be necessary, I already have a general idea. However, I think I will need to arrange some interviews with the local teachers to ask them about their opinions.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：那不需要了，我已经有了大致概念。不过，我想我需要安排一些对当地老师的访谈，问问他们的意见。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mr. Cagle: That will be very helpful.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡格尔先生：那会很有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Susan: Thank you very much, Mr. Cagle.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：非常感谢，卡格尔先生。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: Ted, you've looked at my presentation, haven't you? What do you think of it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：特德，你看过我的展示了，对吧？你觉得怎么样？

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: Hey Mona. Yes, I have. Before giving you some advice, I have a question: why didn't you write about the development of design and its influence or connection with social advancement or even art movement? In my opinion, this direction would have more significance.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：嗨莫娜。是的，我看过了。在给你建议之前，我有一个问题：你为什么不写设计的发展及其对社会进步甚至艺术运动的影响或联系？在我看来，这个方向会更有意义。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: Actually, I just want to focus on the history of design. I'm particularly interested in its history from the 1800s. That's why I wrote about it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：实际上，我只想关注设计史。我对19世纪以来的历史特别感兴趣。这就是我写这个的原因。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: I see. It could save some effort.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：我明白了。这样可以省些力气。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: Not really, I've covered different areas of design, such as building, clothing and products. It's a lot of work.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：并不轻松，我涵盖了设计的不同领域，比如建筑、服装和产品。工作量很大。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: Right. Is it because you wanted to give a comprehensive talk?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：对。是因为你想做一个全面的演讲吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: To be honest, I was worried about my teacher's reaction if I only talk about one area. She might think I've been lazy.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：说实话，我担心如果我只谈一个领域，老师的反应。她可能会觉得我偷懒了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: You know what? Even though it's okay to talk about different aspects, I think the topic is too broad, it would be hard for the listeners to focus on any specific area.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：你知道吗？虽然谈不同方面是可以的，但我觉得主题太宽泛了，听众很难专注于任何特定领域。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: Ummmm, you are right..... I only have about 45 minutes for the talk. Maybe I should narrow the range.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：嗯嗯，你说得对……我只有大约45分钟的演讲时间。也许我应该缩小范围。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: That would be much better. And you could use computer technology to assist you in your presentation, like using the CAD or other computer software.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：那会好得多。你可以用计算机技术辅助你的展示，比如使用CAD或其他电脑软件。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: I'm not sure. Although computer technology can improve the visual effects of my presentation, I'd rather use the traditional way since I am talking about the history of design. I guess traditional media is more affected by computers, rather than designing industry.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：我不确定。虽然计算机技术可以改善我展示的视觉效果，但我更愿意用传统方式，因为我谈的是设计史。我猜传统媒体受计算机的影响更大，而不是设计行业。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: That makes sense. You could do it your own way. As for the content, you mentioned purism, and you said it can save people's effort. I don't really agree with that. I think it's not really easy to achieve. On the other hand, I do think it's important to apply this concept in architecture. I mean the buildings should look simple and elegant.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：有道理。你可以按自己的方式做。至于内容，你提到了纯粹主义，你说它可以节省人们的精力。我不太同意这一点。我觉得这并不容易实现。另一方面，我确实认为在建筑中应用这个概念很重要。我的意思是建筑应该看起来简单优雅。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: That's a good point. Ted, what do you think I should do to further improve my talk?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：说得好。特德，你觉得我还应该做什么来进一步改进我的演讲？

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: Well, I think you have read enough books about it. So, it's not the theories that you lack. Why don't you visit the design museum in the north of the city? One of my friends went there last month and he said it was worth it. I'm sure it can give you some inspiration.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：嗯，我觉得你已经读了足够多的关于它的书。所以，你缺的不是理论。你为什么不去城北的设计博物馆呢？我的一个朋友上个月去了那里，他说很值得。我相信那能给你一些灵感。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: How do you usually prepare for a presentation? You have done it many times, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：你通常怎么准备展示？你已经做过很多次了，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: You can say that. When I prepare for a presentation, I would first try to come up with an introduction telling the audience what my topic is. It's very important to grasp people's attention and let them know what you want to talk about.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：可以这么说。当我准备展示时，我会首先尝试写一个引言，告诉听众我的主题是什么。抓住人们的注意力并让他们知道你想谈什么非常重要。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: Ok, I think so. A good beginning can mean everything.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：好的，我同意。一个好的开始可能意味着一切。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: Exactly. Maybe you could use a story to start. Step two, I would research deeper into the topic and give the audience something new.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：正是。也许你可以用一个故事开头。第二步，我会深入研究主题，给听众一些新的东西。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: Yeah that's what I've been working on. I always try to look for more related information online. I want them to learn something from my presentation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：是的，那正是我一直在做的。我总是试图在网上寻找更多相关信息。我想让他们从我的展示中学到东西。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: Since you work so hard, they will like it! I noticed that you used a lot of pictures in your slides. What I would do is to put a statement under each picture, so the audience would know what exactly the pictures are about.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：既然你这么努力，他们会喜欢的！我注意到你在幻灯片中用了很多图片。我会做的是在每张图片下面加一句话，这样听众就知道这些图片具体是关于什么的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: I just thought it would be more impressive to use only pictures.....Alright, I will add that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：我只是觉得只用图片会更有冲击力……好吧，我会加上。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: In the next step, you should try illustrating slide by slide. Each slide should only contain one thought or idea, so all these thoughts will link together in your illustration.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：下一步，你应该尝试逐张幻灯片进行说明。每张幻灯片应该只包含一个想法或观点，这样所有这些观点就会在你的说明中串联起来。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: This step would need a lot of practice.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：这一步需要大量练习。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: Exactly. A lot of practice is needed before you stand in front of the real audience. There's one final step you should not forget. I suggest you prepare some text handouts with important details.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：正是。在你站在真正的听众面前之前需要大量练习。还有最后一步你不该忘记。我建议你准备一些带有重要细节的文字讲义。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: What are they for?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：那是做什么用的？

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: The audience can reflect on what you talk about in and after your presentation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：听众可以在展示期间和之后反思你讲的内容。

transcriptBlocks.english: Mona: I've never thought about that. Thank you so much! Ted, you are a great help.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莫娜：我从没想过这个。非常感谢！特德，你帮了大忙。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ted: No problem, Mona.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 特德：不客气，莫娜。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Susan, the presentation on our Contemporary Sociology assignment is coming up in only about two weeks, isn't it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：苏珊，我们当代社会学作业的展示大约两周后就要进行了，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Yes, that's right, I think it's on 17th October, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：是的，没错，我想是在10月17日，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Um ... Well, actually the 17th is a Sunday, so I think it must be the 15th.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：嗯……实际上17号是周日，所以我想应该是15号。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Oh, right.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：哦，对。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: So, what do we need to do between now and then?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：那么，从现在到那时我们需要做什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Well, as you know, we've already written our joint assignment, so basically what we will need to do is to summarise what is in it. We'll also need to prepare for how we might deal with questions we come across during the presentation and anything else we can think of.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：嗯，如你所知，我们已经写好了联合作业，所以基本上我们需要做的就是总结其中的内容。我们还需要准备好如何应对展示中遇到的问题以及我们能想到的其他事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Yes, something else that comes to my mind is that we need to combine our presentation with data. I also think we should write some kind of review.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：是的，我想到的另一件事是我们需要将展示与数据结合起来。我还觉得我们应该写某种评论。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: A review? What would that be for? To show the popularity of the book, or its length or ...?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：评论？那是为了什么？展示这本书的受欢迎程度、长度还是……？

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: No, I think that a review could actually demonstrate the value of the book we refer to. I can write a draft review if you like so that you understand what I am thinking about.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：不，我觉得评论实际上可以展示我们参考的那本书的价值。如果你愿意，我可以写一份评论草稿，这样你就明白我在想什么了。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Yes, that would be helpful. Another thing - I was thinking we could use software to help us in the presentation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：好的，那会有帮助。另一件事——我在想我们可以用软件来辅助展示。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: That's a good idea! Like a series of slides we can click through as we make the presentation?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：好主意！就像一系列幻灯片，我们在展示时可以点击切换？

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Yes. I'm good at making those, so I can do that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：是的。我擅长做那些，所以我可以来做。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Wonderful, thank you - as you know I'm not very creative with that kind of thing! I have another idea - perhaps we should ask for feedback from the audience on our presentation. We've got another presentation later this year, and it will help us improve next time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：太好了，谢谢——你知道我对那种事情不太有创意！我还有另一个想法——也许我们应该请观众对我们的展示提供反馈。今年晚些时候我们还有另一个展示，这能帮助我们下次改进。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Great. Perhaps we can design a survey to hand out to the audience after the presentation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：太好了。也许我们可以设计一个调查表，在展示后发给观众。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: What would they be assessing? The quality of our speaking maybe, or the electronic slides?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：他们会评估什么？也许是我们演讲的质量，还是电子幻灯片？

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Well, I was thinking that the questions would be more around the content of our presentation, and the organisation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：嗯，我在想问题会更多围绕我们展示的内容和组织。

transcriptBlocks.english: By the way, have you checked the project guidelines for making a presentation?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 顺便问一下，你查过做展示的项目指南了吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: No, but I will have a look now ... Oh, it says that if you do an electronic slideshow presentation, the number of slides is limited.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：没有，但我现在看看……哦，上面说如果你做电子幻灯片展示，幻灯片数量是有限制的。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Oh, OK, are we allowed to have only 10 slides or something?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：哦，好的，我们只能有10张幻灯片左右吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: No ... It's actually limited to only four slides!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：不……实际上只限四张幻灯片！

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Oh, really? That doesn't seem reasonable. We will have to be careful, not to put too much on it, I guess. Is there a section in the project guidelines about whether we can read from the book related to the subject of our assignment?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：哦，真的吗？那不太合理。我想我们得小心，不能放太多内容。项目指南里有没有关于我们是否能从与作业主题相关的书中朗读的章节？

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: I'm not sure ... Oh, here it is. It says we can't quote directly from our book when we do the presentation, so unfortunately, we won't be able to use the book to read aloud. Oh, I almost forgot. A whiteboard will come in handy in the presentation and I strongly encourage you to use it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：我不确定……哦，在这里。上面说我们在做展示时不能直接引用书中的内容，所以不幸的是，我们不能用书来朗读。哦，我差点忘了。白板在展示中会很有用，我强烈建议你使用它。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Well, that doesn't matter too much. We will just have to express our own opinions on the writing techniques using our own words.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：嗯，那不太重要。我们只需要用自己的话来表达对写作技巧的看法。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: OK, and I just remembered something else about the slideshow presentation - in order to make our presentation clear and easy to be understood, maybe we should just use one font and limit the colours we use, otherwise it will look too cluttered.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：好的，我还想起了关于幻灯片展示的另一件事——为了让我们的展示清晰易懂，也许我们应该只使用一种字体并限制使用的颜色，否则看起来会太杂乱。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Yes, that's true.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：是的，没错。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Yesterday, you emailed me quite a few pictures including graphs. Are those for the presentation as well?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：昨天你给我发了不少图片，包括图表。那些也是用于展示的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Yes, they are highly relevant to our topic. Don't you think so?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：是的，它们与我们的主题高度相关。你不觉得吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: That's true. But the problem is that most of them are of poor quality. I'm worried that they're not clear enough to be seen from all parts of the room.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：是的。但问题是它们大多质量不佳。我担心它们不够清晰，从房间各个位置都看不清楚。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Hmm, I'll try other resources and let you know if I can find anything better.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：嗯，我会试试其他资源，如果能找到更好的我会告诉你。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Oh, I nearly forgot to tell you - the teacher told me yesterday that we need to organise for the presentation to be filmed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：哦，我差点忘了告诉你——老师昨天告诉我，我们需要安排对展示进行录像。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Oh! I didn't expect that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：哦！我没想到。

transcriptBlocks.english: NICK: Well, it will be good because it'll help us complete the self-evaluation form.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尼克：嗯，这很好，因为能帮助我们完成自我评估表。

transcriptBlocks.english: SUSAN: Alright. Now shall we ...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 苏珊：好的。现在我们是不是……

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: So, Mary, you've scored very highly in your exams this year. You won't have trouble being accepted into any course you choose. The most popular course available is clinical nursing. Will you choose that one?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：玛丽，你今年考试成绩非常高。你被任何你选择的课程录取都不会有问题。最受欢迎的课程是临床护理。你会选那个吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: No, Professor Fraser. I've thought about nursing, but I've decided against it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：不，弗雷泽教授。我考虑过护理，但我决定不选它。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: May I ask why? With your skills, you could excel.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：我能问为什么吗？以你的能力，你可以很出色。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: I'm concerned about the difficulty of the course. Apparently, it's not easy to get the diploma since I may not be able to complete the assignments. I feel apprehensive about starting a course I may not be able to finish.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：我担心课程的难度。显然，拿到文凭并不容易，因为我可能无法完成作业。我对开始一门可能无法完成的课程感到担忧。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: It's a shame you feel that way. But you have other options available. Have you thought about the surgical operation course?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：你有这样的想法很可惜。但你还有其他选择。你考虑过外科手术课程吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: Biology is a prerequisite for that course. I haven't taken that course yet, so I probably won't be accepted.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：生物学是那门课的先修条件。我还没上过那门课，所以我可能不会被录取。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: This year, we're offering some other alternatives during summer school. If you complete these courses over the semester break, you may have a chance. They are not that difficult.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：今年，我们在暑期学校提供一些其他选择。如果你在学期假期完成这些课程，你可能有机会。它们不那么难。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: I'm not willing to put in the effort it requires. Honestly speaking, I'm more interested in the personal interaction side of medicine. Are there any relevant courses I could apply for?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：我不想投入所需的努力。老实说，我对医学中的人际互动方面更感兴趣。有什么相关的课程我可以申请吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Certainly. Sociology is beneficial, especially if you wish to further your studies in pediatric care. During the class, you will have the opportunity to work with people of all ages, but in particular, young ones.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：当然。社会学是有益的，特别是如果你想在儿科护理方面继续深造。在课堂上，你将有机会与所有年龄段的人打交道，特别是年轻人。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: What career prospects are there for me once I've completed the course?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：完成课程后，我有什么职业前景？

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Believe it or not, many students who complete the sociology studies go on to work in a different field. They find it a rewarding and fulfilling career to work with people who have disability and help them improve the quality of life.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：信不信由你，许多完成社会学学习的学生后来去了不同的领域工作。他们发现与残疾人一起工作并帮助他们提高生活质量是一项有回报、有成就感的事业。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: I see, that sounds great. Thank you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：我明白了，听起来不错。谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: I'm just not sure what I want to do with my life! What do you suggest? Would you recommend studying two courses at once, so as not to limit my options?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：我只是不确定我的人生想做什么！您有什么建议？您会推荐同时学习两门课程，以免限制我的选择吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Many people have done that, but it's difficult. Studying one course causes enough stress, and adding another course would be extremely challenging. You could try a different subject other than medicine. But I recommend you find the exact branch of medicine you want to study and put your focus on that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：很多人这样做过，但很难。学习一门课程已经带来足够的压力，再加一门会极具挑战性。你可以尝试医学以外的不同学科。但我建议你找到你想学的确切医学分支，把精力集中在那上面。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: The Health and Social Care course is popular. Though I'm interested in this subject, I'm not sure whether I should choose it. Are there enough grants for it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：健康与社会关怀课程很受欢迎。虽然我对这门课感兴趣，但我不确定是否应该选它。有足够的资助吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Yes, I guess so. It has acquired a lot of financial support recently, so your research possibilities won't be limited. Also, I do know that Professor Rhodes has a good reputation. He's one of the most respected professors in his field.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：是的，我想是的。它最近获得了大量财政支持，所以你的研究可能性不会受到限制。而且，我知道罗兹教授声誉很好。他是该领域最受尊敬的教授之一。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: Oh, yes. I've heard the professor is world-renowned. So, I will definitely go for it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：哦，是的。我听说这位教授是世界著名的。所以，我肯定会选它。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Alright, then how about occupational therapy?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：好的，那作业疗法呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: Well, my sister studied this subject last year. She says it's very difficult.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：嗯，我姐姐去年学了这门课。她说很难。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Perhaps it is for some students, but generally it can be easy for a student who majors in medicine. Actually, the textbooks used are published by our school, and the writer is a teacher in medical department, so if a student finds them difficult to understand, he can get quick response from the teacher for clarification, which will be of great help in occupational therapy research.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：也许对有些学生来说是这样，但通常对医学专业的学生来说可能容易。实际上，使用的教科书是我们学校出版的，作者是医学系的老师，所以如果学生觉得难以理解，可以很快得到老师的澄清，这对作业疗法研究会有很大帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: That's really great, and I also heard that the textbook is quite easy to follow, but I'd prefer a hands-on career, rather than confine myself to a research role, so I probably will think about other courses.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：那太好了，我还听说教科书很容易理解，但我更喜欢实践型的职业，而不是把自己局限在研究角色中，所以我可能会考虑其他课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Whatever you choose, Milton University is the best school for you and I highly recommend it. The lecture theatre is kind of old, but last year, the Ministry of Education handed out grants to the top universities, and Milton was on the list.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：无论你选择什么，米尔顿大学都是最适合你的学校，我强烈推荐它。阶梯教室有点旧，但去年，教育部向顶尖大学发放了资助，米尔顿在名单上。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: What's been upgraded? I heard they developed a new medical facility.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：什么升级了？我听说他们开发了新的医疗设施。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Not really, but they are going to do that. Although, they did spend a large amount of money on the existing medical department. The entire building was renovated, and new equipment was purchased.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：不完全是，但他们打算这么做。不过，他们确实在现有的医学系投入了大量资金。整栋楼都翻新了，还购买了新设备。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: I'm still having trouble making a decision. Is there any information on the school's website?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：我还是难以做决定。学校网站上有相关信息吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: Yes, and you will find some details you need to know there. Some people have found it useful to discuss with graduating students the benefits of studying their subject. But in terms of familiarising yourself with the content of the course, you could do no better than talking with the tutor and getting to know him or her.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：有的，你会在那里找到一些你需要了解的细节。有些人发现与即将毕业的学生讨论学习他们学科的好处很有用。但就熟悉课程内容而言，最好的办法就是和导师谈谈，了解他或她。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: Perhaps I'll try that. It's not that I want to choose an easy path. I know that only through hard work can I excel in any field. I just have so much trouble making up my mind! I know there will be funding and scholarships available for particular courses, but I just can't choose.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：也许我会试试。我不是想选择一条容易的路。我知道只有通过努力，我才能在任何领域出类拔萃。我只是在做决定方面有太多困难！我知道特定课程会有资金和奖学金，但我就是选不出来。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: By all means, discuss your concerns with other teachers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：当然，你可以和其他老师讨论你的担忧。

transcriptBlocks.english: MARY: They are all quite busy, you know. I'll think about it. Thank you so much for your advice, Professor Fraser.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 玛丽：他们都很忙，你知道的。我会考虑的。非常感谢你的建议，弗雷泽教授。

transcriptBlocks.english: PROFESSOR: You are welcome. If you ...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 教授：不客气。如果你……

transcriptBlocks.english: Around 10 years ago, Australia Zoo, the University of Queensland and Queensland Parks and Wildlife undertook a project to monitor the movements and behavior of the crocodiles in Lakefield National Park.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大约10年前，澳大利亚动物园、昆士兰大学和昆士兰公园与野生动物管理局开展了一个项目，监测莱克菲尔德国家公园中鳄鱼的移动和行为。

transcriptBlocks.english: The aim of the study was to provide better information on how adult crocodiles there interact within a river system, enabling people to have better decisions on how to manage crocodile populations.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 该研究的目的是提供更好的信息，了解那里的成年鳄鱼如何在河流系统中互动，使人们能够更好地决定如何管理鳄鱼种群。

transcriptBlocks.english: This project can lead the world in crocodile management because of the use of satellite, which enables scientists to stably receive accurate information being sent back to them on the computer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这个项目可以在鳄鱼管理方面引领世界，因为使用了卫星，使科学家能够稳定地在电脑上接收传回的准确信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Even though the crocodiles can travel very long distances, scientists can still know where they are, and study their habits.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 即使鳄鱼可以旅行很长的距离，科学家仍然可以知道它们在哪里，并研究它们的习性。

transcriptBlocks.english: The study is going to help scientists gain further knowledge on crocodile behavior, which can help make informed decisions on the management plans for crocodiles not only in Australia but around the world.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这项研究将帮助科学家进一步了解鳄鱼行为，这有助于不仅在澳大利亚而且在全世界做出关于鳄鱼管理计划的明智决策。

transcriptBlocks.english: Crocodile tracking isn't a new idea in Australia. Crocodile studies have been previously conducted by radio. A miniature electronic device was implanted under the skin of these animals and they were released back into the river. These tags enabled scientists to track the movements of these particular crocodiles over the next 10 years.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 鳄鱼追踪在澳大利亚并不是新想法。以前通过无线电进行过鳄鱼研究。一种微型电子设备被植入这些动物的皮下，然后它们被放回河中。这些标签使科学家能够在接下来的10年里追踪这些特定鳄鱼的移动。

transcriptBlocks.english: Of course, there are some unexpected challenges. The data transmitted from each receiver is recorded by some devices employed in the receiving stations. However, some devices are too old that they always lose signals due to a variety of reasons. So, they can't track those animals which they have been studying for months.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，也有一些意想不到的挑战。每个接收器传输的数据由接收站使用的一些设备记录。然而，有些设备太旧了，由于各种原因总是丢失信号。所以，他们无法追踪那些他们已经研究了好几个月的动物。

transcriptBlocks.english: In order to study the crocodiles, they must first be captured so that the device can be put on them. But this is a very difficult task because they are alert and afraid of being followed by humans. So it might take the team several hours to capture one.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 为了研究鳄鱼，必须首先捕获它们，以便安装设备。但这是一项非常困难的任务，因为它们很警觉，害怕被人类跟踪。所以团队可能需要几个小时才能捕获一只。

transcriptBlocks.english: The tracking device has signal transmitters inside and it's waterproof. It is attached to the head of the crocodile, so the crocodile cannot remove the device with its feet or tail.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 追踪设备内部有信号发射器，而且是防水的。它被固定在鳄鱼的头部，这样鳄鱼就无法用脚或尾巴移除设备。

transcriptBlocks.english: The research has begun to reveal the movements of crocodiles. Data showed that crocodiles tend to be more active at night time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这项研究已经开始揭示鳄鱼的移动。数据显示，鳄鱼在夜间往往更活跃。

transcriptBlocks.english: The GPS sometimes shows that in some areas the crocodiles are overpopulated, so scientists at the park have to use a helicopter to relocate the crocodiles in order to control their population in the area. A crocodile would be taken many kilometers away from its original place. However, scientists found that the relocation methods were ineffective because the relocated crocodiles will return to their original location following the most direct route within one week. The tracking data shows that the crocodiles swim right back to where they came from when moved.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: GPS有时显示在某些地区鳄鱼数量过多，所以公园的科学家必须使用直升机重新安置鳄鱼，以控制该地区的种群数量。一只鳄鱼会被带到离原地点许多公里远的地方。然而，科学家发现重新安置方法是无效的，因为被重新安置的鳄鱼会在一周内沿着最短路线返回原地点。追踪数据显示，鳄鱼在被移动后会直接游回它们来的地方。

transcriptBlocks.english: Crocodiles sometimes travel hundreds of kilometers from Indonesia to Australia in order to reproduce. It is interesting to see that they can always find their way and they will not get lost in the ocean. Scientists realized the crocodiles are able to navigate. This is an important ability for them when they have to migrate for very long distances. We may wonder if human beings can learn from the crocodiles and find our way without using technology. However, through lots of research and experiments, scientists conclude that crocodiles can tell directions by using their senses to the sun, so that they know where they're going. This is an ability which human beings don't possess.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 鳄鱼有时会从印度尼西亚旅行数百公里到澳大利亚繁殖。有趣的是，它们总能找到路，不会在海洋中迷路。科学家意识到鳄鱼能够导航。这对它们来说是一项重要的能力，当它们必须迁徙很长的距离时。我们可能会想，人类能否向鳄鱼学习，在不使用技术的情况下找到路。然而，通过大量研究和实验，科学家得出结论，鳄鱼可以通过感官感知太阳来判断方向，从而知道要去哪里。这是人类不具备的能力。

transcriptBlocks.english: Another finding is that, like the migration of birds who can travel thousands and thousands of kilometers, crocodiles have the same system to help them travel.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另一个发现是，就像能旅行数千公里的鸟类迁徙一样，鳄鱼也有同样的系统帮助它们旅行。

transcriptBlocks.english: The research is still going on in northern Australia. Scientists are working hard to gather more information about this amazing creature.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这项研究仍在澳大利亚北部进行。科学家们正在努力收集更多关于这种神奇生物的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: For centuries, we have been captivated by the dolphin, with scientists arguing about whether or not they have a high level of intelligence.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 几个世纪以来，我们一直被海豚所吸引，科学家们一直在争论它们是否具有高水平的智力。

transcriptBlocks.english: Today, we dive into the rigorous research behind dolphin cognition.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 今天，我们将深入了解海豚认知背后的严谨研究。

transcriptBlocks.english: A recent scientific article by Professor Paul Manger, claims that dolphins are not as intelligent as previously thought, and that their brains are not for superior intelligence. He mentions a phenomenon that occurs in quite a few fisheries in different countries: dolphins don't know how to jump over fishing nets for catching tuna, which leads to many unnecessary injuries or deaths. This makes the claim reasonable to some extent as some animals with much smaller size of brain know how to escape from traps.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 保罗·曼格教授最近的一篇科学文章声称，海豚并不像以前认为的那样聪明，它们的大脑并不是为了高级智力而设计的。他提到在不同国家的许多渔场发生的一种现象：海豚不知道如何跳过捕捞金枪鱼的渔网，这导致了许多不必要的伤亡。这使得这一说法在某种程度上是合理的，因为一些大脑小得多的动物知道如何逃离陷阱。

transcriptBlocks.english: On the other hand, their behavior patterns could be no different from other animals with small brains. For example, they may all learn things in a similar way. Young dolphins learn specialized hunting techniques, like using sponges as tools by observing their mothers. Rats learn a maze path faster by following others. The same goes for a "naive" pigeon, which watches an "expert" pigeon perform the task first and try it by itself.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另一方面，它们的行为模式可能与大脑小的其他动物没什么不同。例如，它们可能都以类似的方式学习。幼海豚通过观察母亲学习专门的狩猎技巧，比如使用海绵作为工具。老鼠通过跟随其他老鼠更快地学会迷宫路径。一只"天真的"鸽子也是如此，它先观察"专家"鸽子完成任务，然后自己尝试。

transcriptBlocks.english: The ability to recognize one's own reflection in a mirror is not limited to birds or some land animals, because dolphins are also aware of what their own bodies look like.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在镜子中识别自己倒影的能力不仅限于鸟类或一些陆地动物，因为海豚也意识到自己的身体长什么样。

transcriptBlocks.english: There have been many rumours of dolphins' intelligence for a long time. A typical one is about a dolphin's ability to predict danger. Some claim that a kind of cell, called fatty glial cells, accounts for this. Well, these special fatty cells create a coating around the brain's nerve pathways. However, this fatty layer doesn't give them magic powers; it just helps brain messages travel much faster. This enhanced neural transmission explains why dolphins are good at solving problems, rather than seeing the future. What seems relevant to predicting danger is actually the dolphin's amazing natural sonar, called echolocation. It provides a detailed acoustic picture of its surroundings, far beyond human perception.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 关于海豚智力的谣言已经存在很久了。一个典型的谣言是关于海豚预测危险的能力。有些人声称一种叫做脂肪胶质细胞的细胞是原因。嗯，这些特殊的脂肪细胞在大脑神经通路周围形成了一层涂层。然而，这层脂肪层并没有赋予它们神奇的力量；它只是帮助大脑信息传输得更快。这种增强的神经传导解释了为什么海豚擅长解决问题，而不是预见未来。看似与预测危险相关的，实际上是海豚惊人的自然声纳，称为回声定位。它提供了周围环境的详细声学图像，远远超出人类的感知。

transcriptBlocks.english: Another popular rumour is that dolphins are born with a friendly face, perceived as a smile no matter what happens. But this has been a misunderstanding for a long time. Dolphins do not express their emotions through their faces, because they don't have facial muscles. It's just because their jaw is fixed that way.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另一个流行的谣言是海豚天生有一张友好的脸，无论发生什么都被视为微笑。但这长期以来一直是一个误解。海豚不通过面部表达情感，因为它们没有面部肌肉。只是因为它们的下巴是那样固定的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Despite the suspicions, many scientists still strongly believe that dolphins are intelligent. Dolphins in marine parks are often observed mimicking the walking style of their keepers and doing the same on the surface of the water. This is something only a few highly intelligent animals can do.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 尽管存在质疑，许多科学家仍然坚信海豚是聪明的。海洋公园里的海豚经常被观察到模仿饲养员的走路方式，并在水面上做同样的动作。这是只有少数高度聪明的动物才能做到的事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: Furthermore, they exhibit strategic behaviors in their interactions with humans. For instance, a female dolphin at the Australia National Aquarium has developed a unique behavior that allows her to trade with visitors. This clever dolphin learns to keep a newspaper hidden under a submerged platform in her tank. When visitors approach, she skillfully brings up one piece at a time as a form of currency. In exchange for each piece, she receives fish treats from delighted guests. This fascinating interaction not only showcases the dolphin's intelligence but also has made her a star attraction at the aquarium.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，它们在与人互动时表现出策略性行为。例如，澳大利亚国家水族馆的一只雌性海豚发展出了一种独特的行为，使她能够与游客交易。这只聪明的海豚学会了把报纸藏在她的水箱里一个水下平台下面。当游客靠近时，她熟练地一次拿出一片作为货币形式。作为每片的交换，她得到高兴的游客给予的鱼食。这种迷人的互动不仅展示了海豚的智力，还使她成为水族馆的明星景点。

transcriptBlocks.english: Dolphins rarely live alone, because they are highly social mammals. Ancient texts, including those by Aristotle, describe dolphins living in pods. These pods can consist of a few individuals or several dozen. They are known to work together when hunting, coordinating their movements to herd fish into tight groups. They even help wounded companions breathe on the surface of the water by supporting them from below. You may be curious about what will happen when they finish a fight. Well, they touch and stroke each other to show friendliness. Interesting, isn't it!
