transcriptBlocks.english: Since I will be staying on the island, I guess there won't be much choice regarding the food. That is true, and so the resort provides lunch at a very low price. I think that's a pretty good perk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 既然我要住在岛上，我想食物方面不会有太多选择。确实如此，所以度假村以非常低的价格提供午餐。我觉得这是个相当不错的福利。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sure, that sounds great.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，听起来很棒。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, do you think you would be interested in attending an interview for this job?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，您有兴趣参加这份工作的面试吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, I think it sounds interesting. And you said it finishes in September?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，我觉得听起来很有趣。你说它在九月结束？

transcriptBlocks.english: That's right. The 3rd September.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 没错。9月3日。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, I will book you in for an interview on Wednesday.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我会为您安排周三的面试。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh dear, I'm sorry but I have an appointment at the hospital on Wednesday. Is there any chance for an interview on another day?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦天哪，抱歉但我周三在医院有个预约。有可能换一天面试吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes. No problem. We can do it on Thursday. How does 10 am suit you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 可以的。没问题。我们可以安排在周四。上午10点方便吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds perfect. Thanks a lot. What do I need to bring?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来很完美。非常感谢。我需要带什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: A resume is a must -- just to let you know that the one I have on file is from last year, so perhaps something has changed since then?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 简历是必须的——只是想告诉您，我这里存档的是去年的，所以也许从那以后有些变化？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, that's true, I do need to update it. I'll bring that with me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，确实，我确实需要更新一下。我会带上的。

transcriptBlocks.english: And also we need a color photo of you taken within the past 2 months. We will provide it to the resort for your ID card, so we don't accept black and white photos.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另外我们需要一张您近两个月内拍摄的彩色照片。我们会提供给度假村用于您的工卡，所以我们不接受黑白照片。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, got it. Thanks, and I appreciate your call. Look forward to seeing you soon.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，明白了。谢谢，感谢您的来电。期待很快见到您。

transcriptBlocks.english: See you then. I'll send you an email confirmation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 到时候见。我会发一封确认邮件给您。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning, Green Street Drama Society, Jane speaking. How may I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好，格林街戏剧社，我是简。能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, hi Jane. My name is James. I've just moved into the area and I'm thinking about joining your group. My friend Arthur - Arthur Jones - is one of your members and he recommended that I join.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，嗨简。我叫詹姆斯。我刚搬到这个地区，正在考虑加入你们社团。我的朋友亚瑟——亚瑟·琼斯——是你们的成员，他推荐我加入。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, that's great. James, we're always looking for new members. Just to give you a bit of background, our amateur drama society has been running since 1976 and we currently have 80 active members, so it's a wonderful part of the community.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，太好了。詹姆斯，我们一直在寻找新成员。给你介绍一下背景，我们的业余戏剧社从1976年就开始运作了，目前有80名活跃成员，所以它是社区中很棒的一部分。

transcriptBlocks.english: Do you know where we are?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你知道我们在哪里吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, I think I have seen it -- it's on the university side of the river near the main Post Office ... If I remember correctly, it's on Green Street.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，我想我看到过——它在大学那边的河边，靠近邮局……如果我没记错，是在格林街。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, that's right, Number 117 Green Street is our postal address. If you want to come and check out the rehearsals, then you should come to The Club House. It's on the same road, just before the Post Office.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，没错，格林街117号是我们的邮寄地址。如果你想来看看排练，你应该来俱乐部会所。它在同一条路上，就在邮局前面。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, got that. So what kind of things can I help out with?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，明白了。那我可以帮忙做什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: We are actually currently looking for actors, oh, and male singers. We already have 3 female members in the group.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们目前正在寻找演员，哦，还有男歌手。我们组里已经有三位女性成员了。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds interesting, but I am afraid that I don't have any experience in acting.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来很有趣，但我恐怕没有任何表演经验。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, that's OK. No experience is needed, because we will give you the necessary training.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，没关系。不需要经验，因为我们会给你必要的培训。

transcriptBlocks.english: We are thinking of staging Hairspray as our musical for next year. Are you more interested in acting, or singing?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们正在考虑明年上演音乐剧《发胶》。你对表演还是唱歌更感兴趣？

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, I would like to do acting. Most recently my friend played the role of Harry Bright in Mama Mia! That was with the Footlight Players in Brighton, it was great fun.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我想做表演。最近我的朋友在《妈妈咪呀！》中饰演了哈里·布莱特。那是和布莱顿的脚灯剧团合作的，非常有趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's great. Oh right, we also need people to lend a hand by running errands from time to time, mainly picking up props and costumes. Can you drive?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。哦对，我们还需要有人帮忙跑腿，主要是取道具和服装。你会开车吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, I've got a full licence and I have my own car, that won't be a problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，我有正式驾照，也有自己的车，那没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Fantastic. Hm...what else...?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。嗯……还有什么……

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, yes. I nearly forgot. When are your meetings held? On Thursdays?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，是的。我差点忘了。你们的会议是什么时候？周四吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: No, we used to have them on Thursdays, now we meet on each Tuesday at 7 pm.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 不，我们以前是周四，现在每周二晚上7点开会。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, I thought my friend Arthur said Thursdays...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，我以为我的朋友亚瑟说是周四……

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, that was actually for last year. And we usually close for our summer break for a few weeks in August. So our first meeting isn't until the 6th September.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，那其实是去年的安排。我们通常在八月放几周的暑假。所以我们的第一次会议要到9月6日。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, I will keep that in mind.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我会记住的。

transcriptBlocks.english: How much does it cost to join?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 加入需要多少费用？

transcriptBlocks.english: Let me just double check ...Here it is. It is 60 pounds....
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我再确认一下……在这里。是60英镑……

transcriptBlocks.english: I can also tell you that with the membership comes a club dinner which we usually hold just before we close for the summer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我还可以告诉你，会员附带一次俱乐部晚宴，我们通常在暑假关闭前举行。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, and do you have any concessional rates?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，你们有优惠费率吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: For those who are unemployed or retired, it's only 25 pounds. Last month, there was a discount for retirees, the price was only 15 pounds, but now it's gone back to the original price.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于失业或退休人员，只需要25英镑。上个月，退休人员有折扣，价格只有15英镑，但现在已经恢复到原价了。

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm working so that doesn't apply to me. I was thinking more about my kids.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我在工作，所以那不适合我。我更多是在想我的孩子。

transcriptBlocks.english: Just to check, is this an adults-only drama society, or are children able to join? Unfortunately, children can't join at this stage, we have an age limit of 16. But they can join the local children's drama club. Would you like their contact number?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 确认一下，这是只限成人的戏剧社，还是儿童也能加入？不幸的是，目前儿童不能加入，我们有16岁的年龄限制。但他们可以加入当地的儿童戏剧社。您需要他们的联系电话吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes please, that would be useful. I have twin girls who are twelve and they really enjoy drama so I was hoping there would be a club for them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，那会有用。我有一对12岁的双胞胎女儿，她们非常喜欢戏剧，所以我希望有一个适合她们的俱乐部。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's right, get them on the stage when they're young! The contact person is Maria George and her number is 564 73218.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 没错，让她们从小就登台！联系人是玛丽亚·乔治，她的电话是564 73218。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's great, thanks for that information. So, what types of plays do you mainly put on?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了，谢谢你的信息。那么，你们主要上演什么类型的剧目？

transcriptBlocks.english: It's mostly modern plays, we don't really do classical stuff, like Shakespeare or Moliere.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 主要是现代剧，我们不太演古典作品，比如莎士比亚或莫里哀。

transcriptBlocks.english: I see. Do you organise any events on special days or occasions?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我明白了。你们在特殊日子或场合会组织活动吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: We do a Christmas Charity Performance each year, with the money going to a children's hospital.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们每年都会举办圣诞慈善演出，收入捐给儿童医院。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds like fun. I hope I can be a part of that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来很有趣。我希望我能参与其中。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well we hope so, too, and I look forward to meeting you soon. Would you like to come along in September?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们也希望如此，期待很快见到你。你愿意九月来吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, that would be great for me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，那对我很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: We look forward to meeting you then, James.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们期待到时候见到你，詹姆斯。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thanks Jane, see you then.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢简，到时候见。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good afternoon, Lakeside Eco Farm, Mark speaking.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 下午好，湖边生态农场，我是马克。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, good afternoon, my name is Helen. I was listening to a programme the other day and it said that you are a member of the Northern Hotel Group.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，下午好，我叫海伦。我前几天听一个节目，说你们是北方酒店集团的成员。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, that's correct. Are you a member of the Group?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，没错。您是集团的会员吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, I am, and I would like to find out about staying with you for a week during the school holidays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，我是，我想了解在学校假期期间在你们这里住一周的情况。

transcriptBlocks.english: No problem, Helen. May I have your full name?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 没问题，海伦。能告诉我您的全名吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Helen Pennington. That's P-E-double N-I-N-G-T-O-N.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 海伦·彭宁顿。拼写是P-E-双写N-I-N-G-T-O-N。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you, Helen. And your email address?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢，海伦。您的邮箱地址呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: helen123@email.com. No dashes or underscores.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: helen123@email.com。没有连字符或下划线。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh sorry, actually it's probably better if I give you my work email address, which is more convenient for me. That is helen123@greenfield.com, and greenfield is one word.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦抱歉，实际上最好给您我的工作邮箱，对我更方便。是helen123@greenfield.com，greenfield是一个词。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, and your home address?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，您的家庭地址？

transcriptBlocks.english: It is 66 Lake Road, Sheffield.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢菲尔德的湖路66号。

transcriptBlocks.english: May I ask where you heard about us. You mentioned a program. Is it on TV or?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 能问一下您是怎么听说我们的吗？您提到一个节目。是在电视上还是……？

transcriptBlocks.english: Actually, I heard about you on the radio and I thought it might be a good place to take my children during the summer holidays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 实际上，我是在广播里听到你们的，我觉得这可能是个暑假带孩子去的好地方。

transcriptBlocks.english: What kind of activities do you have?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们有什么活动？

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, here we have lodges in the woods, a couple of lakes, lots of activities and great food so I'm sure your whole family will love it. I can give you prices for all these. But first could I have your membership number?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我们有林间小屋、几个湖泊、很多活动和美食，所以我确信您的全家都会喜欢。我可以给您所有这些的价格。但首先能给我您的会员号吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh yes, I think it's UK765042GE, but I will just check. It has been a while since I used it...just a moment...ah, actually it is UK765024EG.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦好的，我想是UK765042GE，但我查一下。有段时间没用过了……稍等……啊，实际上是UK765024EG。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's fine, thank you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: Can you see my information on your system?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 您能在系统上看到我的信息吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, I've found you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，我找到您了。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, regarding accommodation here at Island Eco Farm, for families I recommend our family chalets, as they are large and suitable for both adults and children.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，关于岛生态农场的住宿，对于家庭我推荐我们的小木屋，因为它们很大，适合成人和儿童。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ah okay, that sounds nice. But a lodge is probably too big for us and I don't think we have much time and energy for cleaning, so we would like to stay in a flat, preferably near the farm.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 啊好的，听起来不错。但小屋对我们来说可能太大了，而且我觉得我们没有太多时间和精力打扫，所以我们想住公寓，最好在农场附近。

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm afraid there's no accommodation near the farm. Would you want to be located near the lake? It's got a great view.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 恐怕农场附近没有住宿。您想住在湖边吗？那里景色很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Actually, my daughter would prefer to stay in the forest if possible.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 实际上，如果可能的话，我女儿更喜欢住在林间。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's fine, we have some lovely log cabins with room for four people which would suit your family.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那没问题，我们有一些可爱的木屋，可住四人，适合您的家庭。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, that's the kind of thing we want.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，那就是我们想要的那种。

transcriptBlocks.english: I hope you have a wide range of food available. My husband is a meat-eater, I like seafood and my children like organic food, including plenty of vegetables.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我希望你们有丰富的食物选择。我丈夫是肉食者，我喜欢海鲜，我的孩子们喜欢有机食品，包括大量蔬菜。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, we cater for all different types of diet so you can get all of those preferences here, don't worry.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，我们迎合所有不同类型的饮食，所以您可以在这里满足所有那些偏好，别担心。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great. So, what is the transport situation? Can we get there by ferry or van, for instance?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。那么，交通情况如何？比如我们能乘渡轮或面包车去那里吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: No, the best way is by train. There's a regular service from Sheffield, or there is a bike trail all the way here. It generally takes about six hours to ride here from Sheffield.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 不，最好的方式是乘火车。从谢菲尔德有定期班次，或者有一条自行车道一直通到这里。从谢菲尔德骑到这里通常大约需要六小时。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds good, but it might be difficult with our luggage. It's a pity you don't have vans or ferry boats, but I think we will take the train.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来不错，但带着行李可能有点困难。很遗憾你们没有面包车或渡轮，但我想我们会乘火车。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, what activities do you have there?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，你们那里有什么活动？

transcriptBlocks.english: We have a gardening course on planting flowers. Would that be suitable?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们有种植花卉的园艺课程。那适合吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: I was hoping for something a little more energetic, to give us more exercise, a dance course, for example.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我希望有更精力充沛一些的活动，给我们更多锻炼，比如舞蹈课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hmm, that is something guests requested in the past but it's not something we are doing at the moment. I will bear that in mind for the future, though.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，那是客人过去要求的，但目前我们没有。不过我会记在心里，为将来考虑。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay that would be great. I need to get back to work, so can you email me through the prices and all the details?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，那太好了。我需要回去工作了，所以你能把价格和所有细节发邮件给我吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Certainly, I'll send all the details through to your work email address right now.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，我现在就把所有细节发送到您的工作邮箱。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great, thank you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了，谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: You're welcome and we hope to see you here at Lakeside Eco Farm soon.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 不客气，希望很快在湖边生态农场见到您。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thanks, goodbye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢，再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. Westwood Employment Office. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。韦斯特伍德就业办公室。我能为您做什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Good morning. I recently saw some part time jobs on your website. I'm here to see if there's any good chance for me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：早上好。我最近在你们的网站上看到一些兼职工作。我来看看是否有适合我的机会。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's right. We have vacancies for 5 part-time jobs at the moment. I can give you the main details of each job if you like.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 没错。我们目前有5个兼职职位空缺。如果您愿意，我可以给您介绍每个职位的主要信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, that would be great. I'd like to see which one suits me most.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，那太好了。我想看看哪个最适合我。

transcriptBlocks.english: So the first one I recommend is social worker who will help disabled people during the day in the community hospital.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我推荐的第一个是社会工作者，在社区医院白天帮助残疾人。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: I've never done that before. I was wondering if they accept someone without any related experience?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我以前从没做过。我想知道他们是否接受没有任何相关经验的人？

transcriptBlocks.english: For this job, training before you get started is compulsory. And the training will last for a week since this is required by the government.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于这份工作，开始前的培训是强制性的。培训将持续一周，因为这是政府要求的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Okay, when do I need to attend the training?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，我需要什么时候参加培训？

transcriptBlocks.english: For people who get started this month, part of the training will be delivered this Tuesday, during the day. The rest will be given on weekend.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于本月开始工作的人，部分培训将在本周二白天进行。其余部分将在周末进行。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: In that case, I don't think I can attend as I may have some routine work to do this Tuesday, so what about the other jobs?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那样的话，我想我无法参加，因为我本周二可能有一些日常工作要做，那其他工作呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: There is a post for a security guard in a supermarket.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 超市有一个保安职位。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: What are the hours of work?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：工作时间是怎样的？

transcriptBlocks.english: There's a night shift from 8pm to 6am. And you will get a free uniform before you start the job as they don't allow employees to dress casually.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有一个从晚上8点到早上6点的夜班。你会在开始工作前得到一套免费制服，因为他们不允许员工穿便装。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Hmm, I'm not really keen on working night shifts. I get headache if I regularly stay up late. What are the other options?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，我不太喜欢上夜班。如果我经常熬夜会头痛。还有其他选择吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: If you are interested in sales, you can consider this one. It is a job at a furniture store. The only thing that you might not be happy with is that the work time may be variable.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你对销售感兴趣，可以考虑这个。这是一家家具店的工作。唯一你可能不满意的是工作时间可能不固定。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: How's the pay?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：薪水怎么样？

transcriptBlocks.english: It's pretty good, $20 an hour. The job requires the candidate to be reliable. I think you can qualify.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 相当不错，每小时20美元。这份工作要求应聘者可靠。我想你能符合条件。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Hmm, this is a hard one. I used to work for a furniture company, but the experience wasn't satisfying, so I got to be careful this time. Is there an opportunity about working in an office?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，这个有点难。我以前在一家家具公司工作过，但那次经历不太满意，所以我这次得谨慎。有在办公室工作的机会吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: How about working in a local school? There is a vacancy for teaching assistant. You can work regular hours from Monday to Friday.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在当地学校工作怎么样？有一个助教职位空缺。你可以周一至周五正常工作。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That sounds pretty nice. Does it require any skills?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来很不错。需要什么技能吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: It says that the candidate should be good with keyboard. I think most people have that skill nowadays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 上面说应聘者应擅长键盘操作。我想现在大多数人都有这项技能。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That wouldn't be a problem, I'm pretty good at typing and using a variety of office software. Hmm I remember there is one more choice, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那没问题，我打字和使用各种办公软件都很擅长。嗯我记得还有一个选择，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes. Part time actors. A movie company needs people to work part time at Kennedy Park this Saturday. It's just for this week, though.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的。兼职演员。一家电影公司需要人本周六在肯尼迪公园兼职工作。不过只限本周。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That's interesting. I might check that out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那很有趣。我可能会去看看。

transcriptBlocks.english: Agent: Yes. They offer free transport, so you don't have to worry about how to get there. If you are good at using body language, then it's definitely for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 代理人：是的。他们提供免费交通，所以你不用担心怎么去。如果你擅长使用肢体语言，那这工作绝对适合你。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Did they say that the candidates need to be good-looking?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：他们说过应聘者需要长得好看吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Agent: Well, above average.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 代理人：嗯，中等偏上吧。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Thank you. I guess I can tell one of my friends who seems to have some potential in acting. But for me, I want to know more information about the teaching assistant job. I used to be my cousins' tutor, and I use computers every day, so I guess it's the best one. Can you give me a brochure or something?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：谢谢。我想我可以告诉我一个朋友，他似乎有表演潜力。但对我来说，我想了解更多关于助教工作的信息。我以前给我表妹做过家教，而且我每天都用电脑，所以我觉得这是最好的选择。你能给我一份宣传册或类似的东西吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Agent: Yes. Here it is.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 代理人：好的。给你。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Hello. Shining Decorations. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你好。闪耀装饰公司。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hello. We are thinking of renovating our hotel this year. It was built 15 years ago, and it's quite old now. So I'm calling to see if your company can do that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你好。我们今年在考虑翻新我们的酒店。它是15年前建的，现在已经相当旧了。所以我打电话来问问你们公司能否做这个。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, yes. We do all kinds of decoration and renovation projects. Last month, we just renovated the city library. The client was really pleased with the outcome.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，是的。我们做各种装修和翻新项目。上个月，我们刚翻新了市图书馆。客户对结果非常满意。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh really? I heard that one was pretty tough, but the new library does get a fresh look.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦真的吗？我听说那个项目相当棘手，但新图书馆确实焕然一新了。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, it was a tough one. Hmm, may I have the name of your hotel?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，那确实是个棘手的项目。嗯，能告诉我您酒店的名字吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, it's Central Hotel. Should I tell you about some changes we want to make before you come and check it out?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，叫中央酒店。在您来实地查看之前，我应该告诉您一些我们想做的改动吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, please. I will write them down. Just a moment, please.... OK. What are the changes you want to make?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，请讲。我会记下来。请稍等……好的。您想做什么改动？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: First, the address on our signboard in the front of the hotel is not big enough. We would like to have it enlarged.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：首先，酒店前面招牌上的地址不够大。我们希望把它放大。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I see. It's important for the guests to see the location information clearly. No problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了。让客人清楚地看到位置信息很重要。没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: OK. Next is our swimming pool. It's now in the basement. Our guests are not very happy about it. After talking to the designers, we've decided to move it to the roof of the hotel.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。接下来是我们的游泳池。它现在在地下室。我们的客人对此不太满意。和设计师商量后，我们决定把它搬到酒店屋顶。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh. That's a big change, as it'll be an outdoor site, but I believe it's a wonderful idea.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦。那是个大改动，因为会是室外场地，但我相信这是个好主意。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes. Our hotel is right beside a river, so it's got a good view from up there.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的。我们的酒店就在河边，所以从上面看风景很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: That's true. I'm sure more people would stay at your hotel because of it, it's a very competitive feature. We can do that for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：确实。我相信因此会有更多人入住您的酒店，这是一个很有竞争力的特色。我们可以为您做这个。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: We have a big lounge on the ground floor, where our guests can rest. We don't think we are making the most of it. And my manager said we should use the room for reception. The old one is too small.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我们一楼有一个大休息室，客人可以在那里休息。我们认为我们没有充分利用它。我的经理说我们应该把那个房间用作前台。旧前台太小了。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: So you don't need an area for guests to rest?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：所以你们不需要客人休息的区域了？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hmm, the hall will serve the purpose.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，大厅就可以满足这个目的。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Alright. I've written it down. Anything else?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。我记下了。还有别的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Let me see. I think the words on the notice board should be translated. But I'll need to confirm with my supervisor if we need to translate it into Chinese or not. We have quite a lot of Chinese guests now. But, Spanish translation is definitely needed. German is not necessary, neither is Japanese. We don't have many guests from those countries.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：让我想想。我认为公告板上的文字应该翻译。但我需要和主管确认是否需要翻译成中文。我们现在有很多中国客人。但是，西班牙语翻译是肯定需要的。德语不需要，日语也不需要。来自那些国家的客人不多。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK. I'll just need to go and see how to plan the layout later.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。我之后需要去看看如何规划布局。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, please. Also, we don't know if we should upgrade the design of the price board or not. It looks a bit old-fashioned.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。另外，我们不确定是否应该升级价格牌的设计。看起来有点老式。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: What color is it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：它是什么颜色的？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's red. I was wondering if white looks better.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是红色的。我在想白色会不会更好看。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's hard to tell unless we see it in person.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：除非亲眼看到，否则很难说。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: OK. When can the construction team come and start their work?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。施工队什么时候能来开始工作？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Well, we are currently working on another project, but we think we can finish the work there sometime in June. So we can come before July. And it depends on how much time you have for the renovation project. If it's quite urgent, we'll need to discuss the starting time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯，我们目前在做另一个项目，但我们认为可以在六月份完成那边的工作。所以我们可以七月之前来。这取决于你们有多少时间用于翻新项目。如果很紧急，我们需要讨论开始时间。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hmm, we hope to start early, but it's not too urgent. We will wait till the end of the peak season.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，我们希望尽早开始，但也不是太紧急。我们会等到旺季结束。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yeah, you don't want to miss the peak time right now. So who should I contact for the initial check and evaluation?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，你们不想错过现在的旺季。那么我应该联系谁进行初步检查和评估？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: You can call my manager, his name is Cliffton Barron.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你可以打给我的经理，他叫克利夫顿·巴伦。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Excuse me, how do you spell his first name?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：抱歉，他的名字怎么拼写？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: C-L-I-F-F-T-O-N.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：C-L-I-F-F-T-O-N。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: And his phone number?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：他的电话号码呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's 093036602. You can call during work hours.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是093036602。你可以在工作时间打。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Got it. As for the contract details and the cost of the project, should I contact him or..?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：记下了。至于合同细节和项目费用，我应该联系他还是……？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, you can talk to him for all these details.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，你可以和他谈所有细节。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Okay, thanks!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，谢谢！

transcriptBlocks.english: Hi, can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好，我能帮你吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Oh, yes. It's my first time visiting the Skipping islands. Can you recommend any good spots to visit or stay nearby?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦，是的。这是我第一次来跳跃群岛。你能推荐一些好玩的地方或附近的住宿吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Sure, just for your information, this time of year is the best in terms of temperature. It will be colder a month later. So you have a lot of things to do in the warm weather. And let me just give you a brief introduction of the highlights you can visit here. First, there's a place called Hardy Shore. It's amazing. Don't forget to try the local cheese once you are there. It's made from milk of local goats. So, it's very special.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，顺便告诉你，这个季节在温度方面是最好的。一个月后会变冷。所以在温暖天气里你可以做很多事情。让我简单介绍一下你可以在这里参观的亮点。首先，有一个叫哈迪海岸的地方。非常棒。到了那里别忘了尝尝当地的奶酪。它是用当地山羊的奶制成的。所以，非常特别。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: OK. I think I'll have to write all these down in case I forget.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。我想我得把这些都记下来，以防忘记。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes. you should. And do you play any sand sports?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的，你应该记。你玩沙滩运动吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes I do, I heard we can play beach football there. The sand is very soft.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我听说我们可以在那里踢沙滩足球。沙子很软。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, we have great sand here, but we call that beach soccer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，我们这里的沙子很好，但我们都叫沙滩足球。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Oh, thanks for correcting me. Can you recommend some good restaurants here?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦，谢谢纠正。你能推荐一些这里好的餐厅吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, yes. The places with great food are all very close to a market. There are all sorts of interesting food for you to try.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，是的。有好吃的餐厅都在市场附近。有各种有趣的食物供你尝试。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That would be great. I also heard the sugar produced here is different from the common types.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那太好了。我还听说这里生产的糖和普通种类不同。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's true, and that's because we grow a special type of sugarcane.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 确实，那是因为我们种植了一种特殊的甘蔗。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: I see. Hmm, are there any vehicles I can use to get around the island?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我明白了。嗯，有什么交通工具可以让我在岛上出行？

transcriptBlocks.english: Speaking of that, if you want to have a good view of the ocean and the whole island, there's a helicopter tour. It's a little expensive, but the view is fantastic. So it's worth the money.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 说到这个，如果你想好好欣赏海洋和整个岛屿的景色，有直升机游览。虽然有点贵，但景色很棒。所以物有所值。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Sounds like a lot of fun, I've always wanted to do that. I'll note that down.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来很有趣，我一直想体验一下。我会记下来的。

transcriptBlocks.english: By the way, each village has a hostel of a different theme. You can check out the themes in this brochure.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 顺便说一句，每个村庄都有一个不同主题的旅舍。你可以在这个小册子里查看主题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Thanks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: There're also many quieter activities if you just want to relax. We have a theme park nearby, which is 10-minute-drive from here. Currently, there are a dozen of giant pirate models under creation, but you can see a film of pirates in the theme park instead. From previous viewers' feedback, the film is one of those must-see movies, I believe you will be surprised by the special effects of the movie.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你想放松的话，也有很多更安静的活动。我们附近有一个主题公园，离这里十分钟车程。目前，有十几个巨型海盗模型正在制作中，但你可以在主题公园看一部关于海盗的电影。从之前观众的反馈来看，这部电影是必看电影之一，我相信你会被电影的特效所震撼。

transcriptBlocks.english: Or if you want more outdoor activities, there's also tree climbing available on the Tashika Island. If you are new to this, you can ask the coach for some quick training. And we've got a safety net below, no need to worry about injury or anything.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 或者如果你想要更多户外活动，塔西卡岛上也有爬树活动。如果你是新手，可以请教练做快速培训。下面有安全网，不用担心受伤之类的事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: OK. Anywhere else I can go on that island?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。那个岛上我还能去哪里？

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, let's see. You can go to Fisherman's Village.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，让我想想。你可以去渔人村。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: What's special about it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：它有什么特别的？

transcriptBlocks.english: It's a great place for fishing, if you are interested. You can go on a boat tour with the local fishermen. After the tour, you can go to a seaside barbecue site where you can cook the fish.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你感兴趣，那是个钓鱼的好地方。你可以和当地渔民一起乘船游览。游览之后，你可以去海边烧烤点，在那里煮鱼。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Hmm, I haven't done fishing for a long time, no sure if I still can catch one fish or not.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，我很久没钓鱼了，不确定还能不能钓到鱼。

transcriptBlocks.english: Oh, that wouldn't be a problem. The fishermen will give you a hand during the tour. I wanted to recommend the Stone Mountains to you, as it's very popular for its camping trips, but lately it's under reconstruction, so camping is not allowed at the moment. Sorry about that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，那没问题。渔民会在游览期间帮你。我本来想推荐石山给你，那里的露营之旅很受欢迎，但最近它在重建中，所以目前不允许露营。对此很抱歉。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That's OK, I'd like to try fishing. It must be pretty exciting.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：没关系，我想试试钓鱼。一定很刺激。

transcriptBlocks.english: Yes, it is. One more thing is we don't provide towels on this island, so you have to bring your own just in case you get wet.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 是的。还有一件事是我们岛上不提供毛巾，所以你最好自带，以防弄湿。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That won't be a problem. Thank you very much for your information.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那没问题。非常感谢你的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: My pleasure.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 不客气。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Morning, this is Greenwood Scuba Diving Club, how can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：早上好，这里是格林伍德水肺潜水俱乐部，我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Hi, good morning, I am thinking about joining an amateur diving class, since it's my first time, I'm not quite sure which level would suit me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗨，早上好，我在考虑参加一个业余潜水课程，因为这是我第一次，我不太确定哪个级别适合我。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Well, for a green hand, you can start from the level of beginning.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，对于新手，你可以从初级开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yeah, I think so. So when will it start? Is it next month, June?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，我想也是。那么什么时候开始？是下个月，六月吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Not really, the whole area is under construction now and it will be done at the end of June, so we will reopen in July.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不是的，整个区域现在正在施工，六月底会完工，所以我们七月重新开放。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: All right, I will make a note of that. Um, can I take classes on Fridays? I have only got one class that day in university.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我会记下来。嗯，我可以在周五上课吗？我那天在大学只有一节课。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: I'm afraid not, the training is only available on Saturdays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：恐怕不行，训练只在周六进行。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Oh, that's okay, I'm free on the weekends. Erm... I'm wondering what the class will be like, I guess we learn everything in the sea, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，没关系，我周末有空。嗯……我想知道课程是什么样的，我猜我们是在海里学所有东西，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: For the first two weeks, you need some indoor training in the swimming pool under the coach's guidance before you go further.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：头两周，在继续之前，你需要在教练指导下在游泳池里进行一些室内训练。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Oh, that's great, it sounds much safer for me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，太好了，听起来对我来说安全多了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yeah, the safety of students is always our first concern. When you finish the basic training program and have all necessary skills mastered, you will be allowed to try diving in a lake which will give you a quite different experience. And of course, we have two professional lifeguards on duty in case of an accident or emergency.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，学生的安全永远是我们的首要考虑。当你完成基本训练计划并掌握了所有必要技能后，你会被允许在湖中尝试潜水，那会给你一种完全不同的体验。当然，我们有两名专业救生员值班，以防发生事故或紧急情况。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Wow, that's good to know, I won't get too nervous then. Right, should I bring any equipment, like a diving suit or something?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哇，知道这个太好了，那我不会太紧张了。对，我应该带什么装备吗，比如潜水服之类的？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: No, we provide everything you will need for the class, though it's acceptable if you want to bring your own equipment, which may fit you better.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不，我们提供课堂上所需的一切，不过如果你想自带装备也可以，那样可能更合身。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Great, I guess I will only need to buy a new diving mask then. What else do I need to know about the courses?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：太好了，我想那我只需要买一个新的潜水面镜了。关于课程我还需要知道什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Let's see, oh right, every evening, there will be some homework assigned to you. I hope you won't take it as a burden.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：让我看看，哦对，每天晚上会有一些作业布置给你。希望你不要把它当成负担。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Is it written tests or in-pool practice?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是笔试还是泳池练习？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: It can be both. But you may have more written tests at the beginning, which can help you understand some key rules of diving.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：两者都有。但一开始可能会有更多笔试，这可以帮助你理解一些关键的潜水规则。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Oh okay, I don't have a lot of schoolwork this term and next term, so that won't be a problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦好的，我这学期和下学期学业负担不重，所以那没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That's great. By the way, if you do well--according to your coach's evaluation, we will offer you a certificate after you complete this course.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了。顺便说一下，如果你表现好——根据教练的评估，我们会在你完成课程后给你颁发证书。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Wow, that's something I didn't expect before. I am becoming even keener now. Can I register for the class now?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哇，那是我之前没想到的。我现在更感兴趣了。我现在可以报名吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yeah, sure, now I need your name for registration.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，当然，现在我需要你的名字用于注册。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Sure, it's Kate Rowling. Is there a brochure or something that I can learn more about the course?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然，凯特·罗琳。有宣传册之类的东西可以让我了解更多课程信息吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Of course, but I recommend that you visit our website for more detailed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然，但我建议你访问我们的网站了解更多详情。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: OK, I will do that. Oh, I almost forgot, what's the price for my course, a friend told me that's 350 euros for each person, is that right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我会的。哦，我差点忘了，我的课程费用是多少，一个朋友告诉我是每人350欧元，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Actually, that was what we charged last year, it's 375 euros now, and you will need to pay 130 euros as a deposit on the first day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：实际上，那是我们去年的收费，现在是375欧元，你需要第一天支付130欧元作为订金。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Okay, thanks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: My pleasure.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不客气。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Jack?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：杰克？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Oh hi, Mary! How are you? Enjoying your voluntary job? You are working for a large building firm as a volunteer, aren't you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦嗨，玛丽！你好吗？喜欢你的志愿工作吗？你在一家大型建筑公司做志愿者，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yes, I started after I graduated this June. It's fantastic.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，我今年六月毕业后开始的。很棒。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Wow, that's good to know. I remember you majored in architectural design in college, you must have lots of opportunities to put it into practice.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哇，那太好了。我记得你大学主修建筑设计，你一定有很多机会把它付诸实践。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Well actually I am working as a receptionist right now. I want to improve my interpersonal skills as I need to work with different personalities.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯实际上我现在做的是前台接待。我想提高我的人际交往能力，因为需要和各种性格的人打交道。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: I'm sure this will be of great help. But you must be busy all the time, I imagine there are quite a lot of customers all day long as it's a big company.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我相信这会很有帮助。但你一定一直很忙，我想象作为一家大公司，整天都有很多客户。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Not really, I don't work full time, usually the work lasts for 4 hours in the morning. Then someone will be on the afternoon shift. Also, I only need to be there on weekdays, so it's okay.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不完全是这样，我不是全职工作，通常只工作上午4个小时。然后有人会上下午班。而且，我只用在平日去，所以还好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: So what exactly do you do? I guess you have to answer the phone, arrange appointments, and deal with people when they have complaints?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那你具体做什么？我猜你接电话、安排预约，处理投诉？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yeah, those can be part of my work, but I mainly respond to the emails from our clients.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，那些可能是我工作的一部分，但我主要回复客户的邮件。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Have you participated in any training courses yet? I remember last time you once joined a training club as a volunteer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你参加过任何培训课程吗？我记得上次你曾经作为一个志愿者加入过一个培训俱乐部。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yes, of course, I thought I would receive some communication courses from this job, you know, to get some basic interpersonal communication skills. But there are only computer classes available, it's kind of vocational education.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，当然，我本以为会从这份工作获得一些沟通课程，你知道，获得一些基本的人际沟通技巧。但只有电脑课可用，有点像职业教育。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Is that free or do you have to pay for that?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那是免费还是需要付费？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: It's not free, but we've got some subsidies from a bank which has gone into partnership with this building company.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不是免费的，但我们从一家与这家建筑公司有合作关系的银行获得了一些补贴。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That's not bad. I wish I could get some funding from somewhere...our project is so expensive.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那不错。我希望我也能从某处获得一些资金……我们的项目太贵了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I heard that you are working on an Urban River Project, is that right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我听说你在做一个城市河流项目，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, my former employer recommended it to me, it's a big project, the largest irrigation project so far in this city.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我前雇主推荐给我的，这是一个大项目，是本市迄今为止最大的灌溉项目。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Wow, that's amazing, I never knew you are interested in water conservancy. It must be quite challenging.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哇，太棒了，我从不知道你对水利感兴趣。一定很有挑战性。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yeah, actually I was planning to work in the field related to education, you know, I have always wanted to be a math teacher, but I decided to try something different in my life before I become a teacher.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，实际上我本来打算从事教育相关领域，你知道，我一直想当一名数学老师，但我决定在成为老师之前尝试一些不同的东西。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Of course, you will have some special experience. What does this job require you to do? Things like doing some complicated calculations?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然，你会有一段特殊的经历。这份工作需要你做什么？比如做一些复杂的计算？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Right, and before we go into any of that, we need to attend a workshop beforehand, that involves group discussion in which we share our knowledge and experience together.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：对，在进行任何这些之前，我们需要先参加一个研讨会，包括小组讨论，大家一起分享知识和经验。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Sounds interesting, I bet you can get a lot from those discussions with all the experts there...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：听起来很有趣，我敢说你能从那些有专家的讨论中学到很多……

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Sure, I really have learned a lot, it's quite rewarding.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然，我真的学到了很多，很有收获。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Oh right, you remember my cousin, Simon?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦对，你记得我表弟西蒙吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Of course, we took part in an international research project last summer and we cooperated well. He is excellent to work with.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然，我们去年夏天参加了一个国际研究项目，合作得很好。他是个很好的合作伙伴。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yeah, you know he is a construction project major and he just got his Postgraduate Diploma, now he is looking for some similar project like yours, I wonder if you can introduce him.....
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，你知道他是建筑工程专业的，他刚拿到研究生文凭，现在他在找像你这样的类似项目，我想你能不能介绍他……

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Well, it's quite easy for him to join us, my colleagues and I all apply online for this voluntary work. All he needs to do is to fill in some basic information and click on the Go button to finish the application.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，他加入我们很容易，我和同事们都是在线申请这份志愿工作的。他只需要填写一些基本信息，点击"Go"按钮完成申请。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I see, could you send me the project link later?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了，你能晚点把项目链接发给我吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: No problem. Oh, I almost forgot, he will also need a formal recommendation. All volunteers are required to have a reference to vouch for them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：没问题。哦，我差点忘了，他还需要一份正式的推荐信。所有志愿者都需要有一个推荐人为他们担保。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Okay, I will inform him of that. Thank you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我会告诉他的。谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Good morning. Golden Fruit Orchard. Mike speaking.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：早上好。金色水果果园。我是迈克。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Oh, hello. I am interested in the part-time job in your orchard, I mean, the fruit picking job, and I was told to give you a call.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，你好。我对你们果园的兼职工作感兴趣，我是说，摘水果的工作，有人让我给你打电话。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Great. Could I have your name, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了。能告诉我你的名字吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yes, it's Eva Green.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，伊娃·格林。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Okay. Well, let me take down some of your details. First of all, how old are you? You know this job is for young people aged from 18 to 24.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。嗯，让我记下你的一些信息。首先，你多大了？你知道这份工作是为18到24岁的年轻人准备的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I have just turned 19.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我刚满19岁。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Good. May I know how you knew about this job? From our ad or...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。能问一下你是怎么知道这份工作的吗？从我们的广告还是……

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: My friend Naomi just started working in your orchard last week, and she recommended it to me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我的朋友娜奥米上周刚开始在你们果园工作，她推荐给我的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That's good. We do need more hands for work recently.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那很好。我们最近确实需要更多的人手。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I heard that we are required to remove the clay at some parts of the orchard since it hardens when it becomes dry...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我听说我们需要去除果园某些部分的粘土，因为变干后会硬化……

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, that's right. And you have to make sure that you don't have any fear of heights. We pick most fruits with a ladder, usually of 5 meters long or so...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，没错。而且你必须确保你没有恐高症。我们大多用梯子摘水果，通常大约5米长……

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Oh, I don't have acrophobia, so I will be comfortable with that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，我没有恐高症，所以那没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Great. And our workers usually have to work outdoors, so the working environment can be hot. June is approaching, working outdoors can make you sweaty.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了。我们的工人通常需要在户外工作，所以工作环境可能会很热。六月快到了，户外工作会让你出汗。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I see, my friend said there would be free refreshments and cold drinks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了，我朋友说会有免费的茶点和冷饮。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, we do offer those for our workers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我们确实为工人提供这些。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Sounds good. Are there any other skills required for the job?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：听起来不错。这份工作还需要其他技能吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Well, this task also requires a quite high level of concentration, so as to make sure the ripest fruits are collected.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，这项任务还需要相当高的注意力，以确保收集到最成熟的水果。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Got it. That's not a problem for me I suppose. So how about the wages. Is that $5 per hour?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：明白了。我想那对我来说不是问题。那工资呢？是每小时5美元吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Not really, it's $4.5 for every bucket. We pay by workload.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不是，是每桶4.5美元。我们按工作量计酬。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Okay, I see. We will only work on weekdays, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我明白了。我们只在工作日工作，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, you will have weekends off, and we close our orchard every Tuesday, so you can have some rest on that day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，你周末休息，我们每周二关闭果园，所以那天你可以休息。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: How about extreme weather? Like high temperatures and heavy rains? It's quite common here in summer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：极端天气呢？比如高温和大雨？这在夏天很常见。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, it's not a good idea to work if it's raining. Don't worry, we will check the weather report and inform you if the weather affects work.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，下雨天工作不是好主意。别担心，我们会查看天气预报，如果天气影响工作会通知你。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Ummm, I know that you also need extra workers to manage packaging. The wages are different, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯，我知道你们还需要额外的工人做包装。工资不同，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yeah, it's different from that of fruit-picking. We used to pay our workers 10 dollars per hour, but we've increased that to 13.75 dollars per hour. I hope that is reasonable for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，和摘水果的不同。我们过去每小时付10美元，但我们已经提高到每小时13.75美元。希望这对你来说是合理的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Absolutely, will this job be a little bit physically demanding?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然，这份工作会有点体力要求吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: That depends on the season. We used to have a lot work to do in February and November. Since we have introduced some equipment to reduce the workload, now January is our busiest month.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那取决于季节。我们过去在二月和十一月有很多工作。自从我们引入了一些设备来减少工作量，现在一月是我们最忙的月份。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I see. I just checked the location of the orchard, it's far from where I live, I wonder if you provide accommodation?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了。我刚查了果园的位置，离我住的地方很远，我想知道你们是否提供住宿？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yes, we do take that into consideration, and we will offer workers who live far away free lodging. But you will have to do laundry on your own.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我们考虑到了这一点，我们会为住得远的工人提供免费住宿。但你需要自己洗衣服。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Understandable. Oh, right, is there a bus station or subway station nearby? I haven't got my driver's license yet.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：可以理解。哦对，附近有公交站或地铁站吗？我还没有驾照。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Um, I'm afraid our orchard doesn't have easy access to any bus or subway stations. If you don't drive, riding a bike can be a good choice I think.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，恐怕我们的果园不方便到达公交或地铁站。如果你不开车，骑自行车可能是个好选择。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Okay. Thank you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。谢谢。

records.title: Product Change and Repair Report

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Hello, Cozy House Home Appliance, this is sales representative Mike speaking, how may I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你好，舒适之家家用电器，我是销售代表迈克，能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Hello, I bought a vacuum cleaner last month, but it doesn't work as well as I expected, I am considering returning it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你好，我上个月买了一台吸尘器，但它不像我期望的那么好用，我在考虑退货。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Okay, first I need to get a few details about this item, can you give me your name, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，首先我需要了解一些这件商品的信息，能告诉我您的名字吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yes, it's Dinane Ruddick.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，迪娜·鲁迪克。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: It's R-U-D-D-I-C-K, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是R-U-D-D-I-C-K，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yes, that's right.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，没错。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Could you tell me your mobile number?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：能告诉我您的手机号码吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: It's 4-5 double 6-3-2-1, and that's my home number.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是4-5-双6-3-2-1，那是我家的号码。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Got it, and your address, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：记下了，您的地址呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: It's No.42, Garden Avenue.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：花园大道42号。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Right, now I need some information about the product. Do you remember when exactly you bought it last month?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，现在我需要一些关于产品的信息。您记得上个月具体是哪天买的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Um, let me see, there was a promotion from 26th July to 31st July, and I made the purchase on the last day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯，让我想想，7月26日到31日有一个促销活动，我在最后一天买的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Okay, now I need to take down a few details about the problem, is it the noise too loud or it's broken?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，现在我需要记录一些关于问题的细节，是噪音太大还是坏了？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Not really, the problem lies in the handle. After I used the cleaner twice, I noticed that the handle often falls off if I use over 20 minutes. It's just dangerous, I don't want to get hurt. Besides, the buttons on the handle, they are not in good condition. Last night, I pressed all of them, but nothing happened. I highly doubt the quality of the item!!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不是，问题出在手柄上。我用了两次之后，发现如果使用超过20分钟，手柄经常会脱落。太危险了，我不想受伤。此外，手柄上的按钮也不太好。昨晚我按了所有按钮，但什么反应都没有。我高度怀疑这件商品的质量！！

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Okay. I will make a note of that and we will see what we can do. Now I need one more thing, how much did you pay when you bought it? You mentioned you made the purchase during the promotion, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。我会记下来，我们会看看能做什么。现在我还需要一件事，您买的时候付了多少钱？您提到是在促销期间购买的，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yeah, that's right. I still got the invoice, let me check, oh, its original price was $154, but I only paid $104 for that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，没错。我还留着发票，让我看看，哦，原价是154美元，但我只付了104美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Okay, according to what we have talked about just now, I suggest we repair the handle and it's totally free.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，根据我们刚才讨论的情况，我建议我们修理手柄，而且是完全免费的。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: I don't think this is a minor problem that can be fixed. I'm quite disappointed with the vacuum cleaner.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我不认为这是一个可以修复的小问题。我对这台吸尘器非常失望。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Umm, recently we have a new type available, if you are interested..., I can apply for some kind of discount for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，最近我们有一款新型号，如果您感兴趣……我可以为您申请一些折扣。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: That works for me. Could you tell me more about the new model?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那可以。你能告诉我更多关于新型号的信息吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yeah, of course, this model has a reusable bag, so you needn't buy loads of plastic bags, and it's more environmentally friendly.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然可以，这款型号有一个可重复使用的袋子，所以你不需要买很多塑料袋，而且更环保。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Yeah, that's really an advantage for me. Hum, I guess it will be much more expensive than the one I already got, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，那对我来说确实是个优点。嗯，我想它会比我已有的那台贵得多，对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Well, it can be a little bit expensive, but not that much, it's $290 now, and the price will probably go up next month. But in your case, it'll be $190.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，可能会贵一点，但不会太多，现在是290美元，价格下个月可能会上涨。但在您的情况下，会是190美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Ok, that's acceptable, as long as it falls into the range of $100 to $200, but I can't go beyond $200.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，那可以接受，只要在100到200美元之间就行，但我不能超过200美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Great, then which color do you prefer? We have got red, pink and erm... sky blue and...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了，那您更喜欢哪种颜色？我们有红色、粉色和呃……天蓝色和……

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Do you have purple or silver?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你们有紫色或银色吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Man: Yeah, I guess so, but you will have to wait several days for the model with both colors.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我想有的，但您需要等几天才能拿到这两种颜色的型号。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: No problem, as long as it's not a broken one, I will go for purple.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：没问题，只要不是坏的，我就选紫色。
