transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Good afternoon, Dreamtime Travel. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：下午好，梦幻时光旅行社。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Hi. My name is Taylor and I'm interested in the tours you offer to Japan. Could you give me some details about that?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：嗨。我叫泰勒，我对你们提供的日本之旅感兴趣。你能给我一些关于这方面的细节吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Sure. We operate several Japanese tours. Which one in particular do you want to know?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：当然。我们经营几个日本旅游项目。您特别想了解哪一个？

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Well, I like the one that mentioned whales. It is the tour of whale watching, I think.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：嗯，我喜欢那个提到鲸鱼的。我想是观鲸之旅。

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Ah yes, that's our Whale Watch Experience. It's very popular and it's based in a lovely little town with nice beaches, not far from here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：啊是的，那是我们的观鲸体验。它非常受欢迎，位于一个可爱的小镇，有漂亮的海滩，离这里不远。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Good. So, is there someone guiding us on the tour?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：好的。那么，旅途中有导游吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Yes, each tour has one guide during the journey. And you will go there by minibus. We like to keep our tours small and personal, so we don't take a large number of people, just twelve or thirteen people usually.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：是的，每次旅行都有一名导游。你们会乘坐小型巴士去那里。我们喜欢让旅行保持小而个性化，所以通常只接待十二三个人。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Well, that sounds good. How much is it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：嗯，听起来不错。多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: At this time of year it's usually around 150 dollars for each person but let me check. Er ... oh, it's actually 25 dollars cheaper at the moment, so that's 125 dollars. You will have the opportunity to watch a group of whales performing an aqua show, which is the most eye-catching part of the whole trip. And also, you will have a tour on the boat and you can enjoy the magnificent sea views.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：每年这个时候通常是每人150美元左右，但让我查一下。呃……哦，实际上现在便宜25美元，所以是125美元。你将有机会观看一群鲸鱼表演水上节目，这是整个旅程中最引人注目的部分。而且，你还会乘船游览，欣赏壮丽的海景。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Oh right, and how long does the tour last?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：哦好的，旅程持续多久？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: It's two days - that includes four hours' travel time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：两天——包括四小时的交通时间。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: And what about the other things, you know, that are included in the price?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：那其他事情呢，你知道的，价格里包含的其他东西？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Oh, there are lots of things. If you don't want to do the cruise, you can join a free bushwalk we offer. You will get more exercise with the walk option, and that would be attractive for those who try to keep fit. Another option is a fishing trip, which is 12 dollars. Some customers might worry about the safety of the trip, but it's unnecessary, since all activities that might be dangerous will be excluded.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：哦，有很多东西。如果你不想参加游船，你可以参加我们提供的免费丛林徒步。步行选项会让你得到更多锻炼，这对那些想保持健康的人来说很有吸引力。另一个选择是钓鱼之旅，收费12美元。有些客户可能会担心旅途的安全，但没必要，因为所有可能有危险的活动都会被排除。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Good.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：好的。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: And what about the breakfast? Do I have to pay extra money for it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：那早餐呢？我需要额外付费吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: I'm afraid so, breakfast is served in the hotel at a reasonable price. During the trip tourists will have lunch together, which is free of charge.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：恐怕是的，早餐在酒店提供，价格合理。旅行期间游客将一起用午餐，免费。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: And the insurance?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：那保险呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Oh, the fees you pay will cover it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：哦，你支付的费用会涵盖它。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: OK, I see. So what about the evening activities? Are we free at night?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：好的，我明白了。那晚上的活动呢？我们晚上是自由的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Yeah. If you just want to relax, you are free to sit by the hotel pool or walk along the beach. But there is also an alternative if you are not interested in these activities. Theatre is also a great place for you to unwind. There used to be some musicals in the theatre at night, but they got canceled as the audience found them unattractive. Now comedies are available to the public in the theatre every evening and if you want to watch them, please contact the travel agents.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：是的。如果你只是想放松，你可以自由地坐在酒店泳池边或沿着海滩散步。但如果你对这些活动不感兴趣，也有另一个选择。剧院也是你放松的好地方。以前晚上剧院会有一些音乐剧，但因为观众觉得不吸引人而被取消了。现在每晚剧院都有喜剧供公众观看，如果你想看，请联系旅行社。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Well, that sounds good. And is dinner available at the hotel?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：嗯，听起来不错。酒店提供晚餐吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Yes, but that will cost an extra 25 dollars more or less. I would recommend you to try the local shrimps, miso soup and pickles. Those are delicious.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：是的，但需要额外花费大约25美元。我推荐你尝尝当地的虾、味噌汤和泡菜。那些很美味。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Wow, sounds good. Can we purchase souvenirs from the town where we stay? Someone told me that there is a small exhibition of Japanese products near the hotel at night.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：哇，听起来不错。我们可以在我们住的小镇购买纪念品吗？有人告诉我晚上酒店附近有一个日本产品小展览。

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Oh right, I forgot to mention that. There are a variety of products produced by factories here on display, and you can choose any object that catches your eye. Small toys are very popular among tourists.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：哦对，我忘了提这个。这里有工厂生产的各种产品展出，你可以选择任何吸引你眼球的物品。小玩具在游客中很受欢迎。

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: Fantastic. One more question, what is the hotel room like?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：太好了。还有一个问题，酒店房间是什么样的？

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Well ... each room has a balcony. The view from there is quite beautiful as the hotel is located near a national park. Is there anything else you want to know?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：嗯……每个房间都有阳台。因为酒店位于国家公园附近，那里的景色非常美。还有什么想知道的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: CUSTOMER: No, thank you, that is all for now. Bye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 客户：没有了，谢谢，暂时就这些。再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: RECEPTIONIST: Goodbye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 前台：再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hello, West Bay Laundry. Can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你好，西湾洗衣店。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, good morning. I'm ringing about a job - I understand that you have a vacancy?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，早上好。我打电话来问一份工作——我听说你们有一个职位空缺？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh yes, we do. But I'm afraid the person who usually deals with that isn't here today, but I can give you the basic details if you like.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦是的，我们有。但恐怕通常处理此事的人今天不在，不过如果你愿意，我可以给你基本的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: That would be great. Could you tell me a little bit more information about the job?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那太好了。你能多告诉我一些关于这份工作的信息吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Sure. Previously there was only one branch located on Queens Road. Then we decided to expand our business, so we set up another laundry shop last year and this year we are going to establish five more branches on Beacon Road. Oh, by the way, the one we are recruiting for now is on Hillsdunne Road, just next to a ladies' dress shop. Do you know the area?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然。以前只有一家分店在皇后路。然后我们决定扩大业务，所以去年又开了一家洗衣店，今年我们将在比肯路再开五家分店。哦，顺便说一下，我们现在招聘的是在希尔斯邓路，就在一家女士服装店旁边。你知道那个区域吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, I do. I remember there was a special shop where kids were able to find some nice toys, but it went out of business last year. Recently the government is planning to build a department store in this area.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，我知道。我记得那里有一家特别的商店，孩子们能找到一些好玩具，但去年倒闭了。最近政府计划在这个区域建一家百货商店。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, that's true.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，没错。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: So ... What kind of job do you offer?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那么……你们提供什么样的工作？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, if you've learned how to iron clothes, we'll soon have a position for that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，如果你学过如何熨衣服，我们很快会有那个职位。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I did learn that previously. Oh, I'm also good at taking care of leather. Do you have an opening for that?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我以前学过。哦，我也擅长护理皮革。你们有这个职位吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's a shame. We don't have many leather clothes at the moment, so there is no vacancy for that. However, we do have a vacant position of washer operators.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那太可惜了。我们目前没有很多皮革衣物，所以没有那个职位。不过，我们确实有空缺的洗衣机操作员职位。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Okay. And do you know what the rates of pay are?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。你知道工资标准吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, I've got them here. Let me see ... The hourly rate is $6.50. You know, the average in the city is only $5.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我这里有。让我看看……时薪是6.50美元。你知道，市里的平均工资只有5美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Right. And what about lunch breaks, do the staff have to go home to eat or ...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。那午餐休息呢，员工需要回家吃还是……

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: No, you don't have to. We offer a free lunch in a restaurant, which is not far from the workplace. The lunch time is one hour, which is generally enough for you to eat and have a rest.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不，不需要。我们在离工作地点不远的一家餐厅提供免费午餐。午餐时间是一小时，通常足够你吃饭和休息。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh wow. Those conditions are better than my last job.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦哇。这些条件比我上一份工作好。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: And we also offer a morning coffee break, which lasts about 15 minutes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我们还提供上午咖啡休息时间，大约15分钟。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, that's a really good perk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，那真的是一个很好的福利。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, we think so. And in return for the commitment of loyal staff, we offer 4 weeks' vacation for those who have worked here for three years.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我们也是这么认为的。作为对忠诚员工承诺的回报，我们为在这里工作满三年的员工提供四周假期。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, that's good to know.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，那很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, that's for senior staff though. As for the juniors, we will have a training session on every Friday. Oh, I got that wrong, we changed it to every Tuesday since last month.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，那是针对资深员工的。至于初级员工，我们每周五有一次培训。哦，我说错了，从上个月起我们改到了每周二。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I see.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Is there anything else I need to know?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：还有其他我需要知道的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: We also offer some good fringe benefits to attract the best staff.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我们还提供一些好的附加福利来吸引最优秀的员工。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Really?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：真的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, of course. For example, we have a staff discount, which is 25 percent off on most products except sales goods. As for the pension, I'm not quite clear about that, but you can ask our personnel manager when you come in for an interview.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，当然。例如，我们有员工折扣，大部分产品打七五折，促销商品除外。至于养老金，我不太清楚，但你可以在来面试时问我们的人事经理。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: When would be a good time for me to have the interview?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我什么时候来面试比较合适？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I'm afraid I don't know, but I'll let the manager know you've called so he can arrange a date with you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：恐怕我不知道，但我会让经理知道你打过电话，这样他可以和你安排一个日期。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Thanks, that would be great.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：谢谢，那太好了。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Not at all. His office is in Room 12, which is next to Room 10. Oh, please know that we don't have room 11.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不客气。他的办公室在12室，紧挨着10室。哦，请注意我们没有11室。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Thank you. Oh, by the way, who would be my boss exactly?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：谢谢。哦，顺便问一下，我的直属上司到底是谁？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That would be Mrs. Waddell. That's W-A-D-D-E-L-L, Waddell. She's a very energetic woman.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是沃德尔太太。拼写是W-A-D-D-E-L-L，沃德尔。她是一个非常精力充沛的女性。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Got that. And what would I be doing if I get the job? I mean my duties.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：记下了。如果我得到这份工作，我需要做什么？我是说我的职责。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Just need to inform you that there is a set of tasks you need to handle besides loading the washing machines. Window dressing is really important to our branch so that's a priority, by which I mean, you have to arrange some of the decorations in our shop window to make it attractive. Another task is watching for shoplifters, for there have been a number of thefts since last September. And you also need to keep an eye on our stock.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：需要告诉你的是，除了操作洗衣机之外，还有一系列任务需要处理。橱窗布置对我们的分店非常重要，所以那是优先事项，我的意思是，你需要布置一些店铺橱窗的装饰来使其吸引人。另一个任务是留意扒手，因为去年九月以来已经发生了多起盗窃事件。你还需要留意我们的库存。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I see. And is there a uniform? What clothes should I wear?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了。有制服吗？我应该穿什么衣服？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Wearing a black skirt is a must in the workplace. You will also be required to wear a red blouse, which we don't supply unfortunately. A name badge will be given once you get the job and you will have to wear it during the workdays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：在工作场所必须穿黑色裙子。你还需要穿红色衬衫，不幸的是我们不提供。一旦你得到这份工作，会给你一个名牌，工作日期间必须佩戴。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Is there anything else you would like to know?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：还有什么你想知道的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: No, thank you so much for your time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：没有了，非常感谢你的时间。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: You're welcome.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不客气。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Bye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Bye. Have a nice day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：再见。祝你有美好的一天。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Good afternoon! I'm Andrew from Wide World Travel Birmingham. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：下午好！我是广阔世界旅行社伯明翰分社的安德鲁。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: Hi! My mother and I are thinking of taking a holiday, so I would like to book some flights.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：嗨！我母亲和我在考虑去度假，所以我想预订一些航班。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Of course. Where do you want to go?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：当然。您想去哪里？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: We would like to go to Germany from Birmingham. We thought either Hamburg or Berlin might be interesting, but we're not sure which one to pick. Do you have any recommendations?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：我们想从伯明翰去德国。我们觉得汉堡或柏林可能有趣，但不确定选哪个。你有什么推荐吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: I'd choose Berlin. The flights there are the cheapest at this time of the year and we have some good deals at the moment.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：我会选柏林。每年这个时候去那里的航班最便宜，而且我们目前有一些优惠。

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: OK! That settles it. We would like to book two round trip tickets.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：好的！那就定了。我们想订两张往返机票。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Great. What date would you like to leave?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：太好了。您想哪天出发？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: We would like to leave on the 29th of October.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：我们想在10月29日出发。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: OK. I've noted that down. When do you plan to return?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：好的。我记下了。您计划什么时候返回？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: On the 5th of November. We have to come back in time for my father's birthday, which is the next day, the 6th.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：11月5日。我们必须赶回来为我父亲庆祝生日，就在第二天，6号。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Alright, let me just take a look ... OK, so I've just found some prices for you for those dates. There are two flights, the cheaper one is £110 and the other is £150, both leaving at 10am. The cheaper option has a short stopover in Paris, though. Which would you prefer?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：好的，让我查一下……好的，我刚刚为那些日期找到了一些价格。有两趟航班，便宜的是110英镑，另一趟是150英镑，都在上午10点起飞。不过便宜的那趟在巴黎有一个短途经停。您更喜欢哪个？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: We would not consider flights with a stopover as my mother likes direct flights. I think we will take the more expensive one.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：我们不考虑经停的航班，因为我母亲喜欢直飞。我想我们会选更贵的那趟。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: No problem, so I will book you in for the weekly return airfare type, flying with Golden Daybreak Airways.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：没问题，那我为您预订每周往返票价类型，乘坐金晨航空公司航班。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Now I would like to get some necessary personal information from you for the booking. Is that alright?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：现在我需要从您这里获取一些必要的个人信息用于预订。可以吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: No problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Where do you live?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：您住在哪里？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: I live at Bank House, Chalk Street, Birmingham.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：我住在伯明翰粉笔街银行大厦。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: OK. And your name please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：好的。您的名字呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: Lily Cowper. That's C-O-W-P-E-R. My mother's name is Janet Esperance. Oh, I nearly forgot! She has some special needs for the flight. She is lactose intolerant, so definitely no milk in her meal. And apart from that, she's also allergic to nuts.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：莉莉·考珀。拼写是C-O-W-P-E-R。我母亲的名字是珍妮特·埃斯佩兰斯。哦，我差点忘了！她对飞行有一些特殊需求。她乳糖不耐受，所以餐食里绝对不能有牛奶。除此之外，她对坚果也过敏。

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Sure. I've noted this down. Is there any other things we can care for her needs on the flight?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：好的。我记下了。还有其他我们可以在飞行中照顾她需求的事项吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: My mother has trouble walking. Is there any facility available to help?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：我母亲行走不便。有什么设施可以帮助吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: That's no problem at all. The airline offers wheelchairs for anyone in need. Would you like me to call ahead and arrange one at the check-in desk when you arrive?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：那完全没问题。航空公司为有需要的人提供轮椅。您需要我提前打电话，在您到达时在值机柜台安排一个吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: Oh yes, we would really appreciate it. Thank you! She probably will need some more legroom for the flight too. Can that be arranged?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：哦好的，我们真的很感激。谢谢！她飞行时可能还需要更多的腿部空间。那也能安排吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Certainly! I can put you in row 40 if that suits. It isn't an exit row but it will make sure that your mum feels comfortable. Would that be good?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：当然！如果合适的话，我可以把您安排在40排。那不是紧急出口排，但能确保您母亲感到舒适。那可以吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: Yes, that would be great. Now, how should I pay for these flights?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：好的，那太好了。现在，我应该怎么支付这些机票？

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: There are several options. You could come into our agency and pay in person via card or cash, or make an online transfer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：有几种选择。您可以来我们的代理处亲自用卡或现金支付，或者进行在线转账。

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: Alright, I'm coming into the town next week, so I will come and pay in person by credit card ... Oh no, actually I think that an online transfer would be the easiest option for me. Could you please let me know the details?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：好的，我下周会来镇上，所以我会亲自来用信用卡支付……哦不，实际上我觉得在线转账对我来说是最方便的选择。你能告诉我具体细节吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Sure. If you give me your email address. I will send the details and your itinerary through to you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：当然。如果您给我您的邮箱地址，我会把详细信息和行程发给您。

transcriptBlocks.english: LILY: OK, it's la.cowper@sunstream.com. Thank you so much for your help!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 莉莉：好的，是la.cowper@sunstream.com。非常感谢你的帮助！

transcriptBlocks.english: ANDREW: Great, I will send it through. And I hope you enjoy your holiday!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 安德鲁：好的，我会发过去。祝您假期愉快！

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Good afternoon. You must be Clare Allan. I understand you would like to apply for the role as a camp counsellor at Pebble Creek Summer Camp.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：下午好。您一定是克莱尔·艾伦。我了解到您想申请鹅卵石溪夏令营的营地辅导员职位。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: That's right.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：是的。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Great. What we are looking for is a leader for a group of children who will be attending the camp this summer. The person who gets the job needs to be self-motivated, reliable and hard-working. We need someone with a range of skills who has experience with camping.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：很好。我们要找的是一个今年夏天参加夏令营的儿童小组的领队。获得这份工作的人需要自我激励、可靠和勤奋。我们需要一个有各种技能、有露营经验的人。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: Yes, I have those skills. The advertisement also mentioned sports, I think?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：是的，我有这些技能。广告里还提到了体育，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, we are looking for someone who can take the lead in sports. We do many sports, including football and swimming, but for this role we want someone who is a specialist in tennis. We are looking for someone who can teach the children this game, as we think it is a healthy, active sport to play.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我们在寻找一个能在体育方面起主导作用的人。我们做很多运动，包括足球和游泳，但对于这个角色，我们想要一个网球专长的人。我们在寻找一个能教孩子们这项运动的人，因为我们认为这是一项健康、积极的运动。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: Absolutely! Actually I was a coach in a middle school before, so teaching those kids shouldn't be a problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：当然！实际上我以前在中学当过教练，所以教那些孩子应该不成问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's great! That's what we are looking for. The next requirement is that we need someone who is available for most of the summer. Do you have any questions for me?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了！这正是我们要找的。下一个要求是，我们需要一个暑假大部分时间都有空的人。您有什么问题要问我吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: Yeah. I've heard that the camp will last about 12 weeks. Is that true?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：是的。我听说夏令营会持续大约12周。是真的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, it will only take about 8 weeks. For the first half of the period, we will just run Daytime activities. And for the rest of the time, the counsellor will also need to travel with the children, and the trip will last about 3-4 weeks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，只需要大约8周。在前半段时间，我们只进行白天活动。剩下的时间，辅导员还需要和孩子们一起旅行，旅行大约持续3-4周。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: Sounds good to me, I love travelling! Will it start next month, in May?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：听起来不错，我喜欢旅行！会在下个月，五月开始吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: No, we will begin at the start of June.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不，我们会在六月初开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: I see, that's good. Should I do some preparation for that?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：我明白了，那很好。我需要为此做些准备吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh yes! You would need to participate in some training for the first week. Because it's such a position with great responsibilities, we need to make sure you know how to act in a safe way, as a good example to the children.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦是的！你需要在第一周参加一些培训。因为这是一个责任重大的职位，我们需要确保你知道如何以安全的方式行事，为孩子们树立一个好榜样。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: What about the salary? How much does the job pay?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：薪水呢？这份工作付多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: The pay will be about £7 per hour.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：工资大约是每小时7英镑。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: How much does that work out to be for the whole eight weeks? About £1,000?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：整个八周算下来是多少？大约1000英镑？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: After week 8, you will receive £985.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：八周后，你会收到985英镑。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: That's OK for me. Do I have to pay for my insurance?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：那对我来说可以。我需要自己付保险吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, I am afraid you will have to. We would leave it up to you to choose which one you prefer to go with.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，恐怕你必须自己付。我们会让你自己选择你更喜欢哪一家。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: Ok I will keep that in mind. Is there any bonus for working for this camp company?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：好的我会记住的。为这家营地公司工作有奖金吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: You won't get a car to drive or anything like that, but we do offer some discounts exclusively for our staff if you choose to travel with some of our tour products.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你不会得到汽车之类的东西，但如果你选择使用我们的一些旅游产品，我们会为员工提供一些专属折扣。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: That all sounds good to me. Is there a minimum age for the job? I just turned 19, would that be a problem?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：那听起来都很好。这份工作有最低年龄要求吗？我刚满19岁，会有问题吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: We would prefer someone over the age of 21, but applicants over 18 are also considered if they can prove that they are mature, capable and able to work safely.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我们更倾向于21岁以上的人，但18岁以上的申请者如果能证明自己成熟、有能力并能安全工作，也会被考虑。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: Are there any other requirement I would need to fulfil?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：还有其他我需要满足的要求吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: If we hire you, you would also need to register with the police department here in the UK, since you are not a British citizen. I think the fee is about £36. Is there anything else you want to ask?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：如果我们雇用你，你还需要在英国警察部门注册，因为你不是英国公民。我想费用大约是36英镑。你还有什么想问的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: I guess that's pretty much what I need to know.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：我想这就是我需要知道的全部了。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Cool! You will hear from us sometime next week as we have some other applicants to interview at the moment. Thank you for coming in today.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：酷！我们下周会联系你，因为我们现在还有一些其他申请者要面试。感谢你今天来。

transcriptBlocks.english: CLARE: OK, I look forward to hearing from you. Thank you for taking the time to meet with me today.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 克莱尔：好的，我期待收到你们的消息。感谢你今天抽时间见我。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hi! How can I help you today?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗨！今天能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Hello. I would like to sign my family up for some fitness programs. We've just moved here from Bristol. We'd like to start in September if that's possible.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你好。我想给我的家人报名一些健身项目。我们刚从布里斯托搬来这里。如果可能的话，我们想九月开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, here at Workout Weekly Fitness we offer different programs to suit everyone's needs. Our head trainer Mark Critchton offers professional and personalised coaching.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，在每周锻炼健身中心，我们提供不同的项目来满足每个人的需求。我们的首席教练马克·克里奇顿提供专业和个性化的指导。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I'm sorry? What's his family name again, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：抱歉？请问他的姓是什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Crichton, that's C-R-I-C-H-T-O-N.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：克里奇顿，拼写是C-R-I-C-H-T-O-N。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Ok.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: What in particular would you like to do?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你们特别想做什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: As a family, we enjoy running. It's something we can do together.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：作为一个家庭，我们喜欢跑步。这是我们能一起做的事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: And it's a great way to stay fit! We have many running programs available at the moment. Here's a printout of our schedule. Do you prefer sprinting?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：而且这是保持健康的好方法！我们目前有很多跑步项目。这是我们时间表的打印件。你们喜欢短跑吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I do.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我喜欢。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's great! We've got 100-metre sprinting program which has many vacancies available. This program is held on weekends.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了！我们有100米短跑项目，还有很多名额。这个项目在周末进行。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Nice, where's the venue for it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不错，地点在哪里？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's at the local Sports Centre on the other side of town. Unfortunately, we can't operate all our programs here at our centre. We just don't have the room.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：在镇另一边的当地体育中心。不幸的是，我们不能在我们中心开展所有项目。我们没有足够的空间。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: That might be a little far for us to go. Is there anything else available?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那对我们来说可能有点远。还有其他可用的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: We have middle-range distance training held every morning in spring. But you would have to wait until then to start.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我们有中距离训练，在春季每天早上进行。但你们要等到那时才能开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Middle-range ... Would that be about 1 kilometre?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：中距离……大约是1公里吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Nearly. That's 2 laps around the track, exactly 800 metres long. It's a good amount. But it is planned to start at 6.15 every morning. That's a little too early for some of our clients. Is it a problem for you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：差不多。是绕跑道两圈，正好800米。量不错。但计划是每天早上6：15开始。对我们一些客户来说有点太早了。对你们来说有问题吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's not a problem for my husband and me, but our children are in their late teens, and don't like getting out of bed early. I'm sure you know what teenagers are like. And we don't want to have to wait until next spring to start.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：对我丈夫和我来说没问题，但我们的孩子已经快二十岁了，不喜欢早起。我相信你知道青少年是什么样的。而且我们不想等到明年春天才开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I understand. Then "Long Road Runner" is the last program available at the moment. The distance is quite challenging though.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我理解。那么"长跑者"是最后一个可用的项目了。不过距离相当有挑战性。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: My family and I are used to running long distances. We used to compete in the 8-kilometre mini marathons in our old city.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我和我的家人习惯长跑。我们在原来的城市经常参加8公里的迷你马拉松比赛。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: This is for very experienced runners. It is a 10-kilometre run. We practice every Thursday evening at 6 pm. Are you interested?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：这是给非常有经验的跑步者的。是10公里跑。我们每周四晚上6点练习。你们感兴趣吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It sounds like just what we want! Where is it held?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：听起来正是我们想要的！在哪里举行？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's in the Central Park. Oops, sorry. I almost forgot that we just changed the location last week. We now train at North Park, on Gilmore Street. Do you know where that is?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：在中央公园。哦，抱歉。我差点忘了我们上周刚改了地点。我们现在在吉尔摩街的北公园训练。你知道在哪里吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes! That's right near our house. That would be perfect! Please sign us up for that one. We are the Andrews family. There is my husband, my two children and me in our family.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的！就在我们家附近。那太完美了！请给我们报那个。我们是安德鲁斯一家。我们家有我丈夫、两个孩子和我。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Is there anything we need to prepare before we begin? Such as special running shoes? Or do we need a club sweater?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：开始之前我们需要准备什么吗？比如特殊的跑鞋？还是需要俱乐部运动衫？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: We have shirts, shorts, socks and shoes available but they are not compulsory. However, we do recommend that all people participating in our training programs buy a club vest. We want everyone to feel like a part of a team. And it's good for advertising.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我们有衬衫、短裤、袜子和鞋子供应，但不是强制性的。不过，我们确实建议所有参加我们培训项目的人都买一件俱乐部背心。我们希望每个人都感觉是团队的一部分。而且这对宣传也有好处。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK, can we buy them here?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我们可以在这里买吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: You certainly can! I will get them for you in a moment. Are you interested in signing up for our marathon competition? It isn't until June, but if you sign up early, you can start training immediately.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然可以！我等一下就拿给你。你们有兴趣报名我们的马拉松比赛吗？要到六月才开始，但如果你们提前报名，可以立即开始训练。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, we'd love to!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，我们很愿意！

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Eh, wait a minute. I made a mistake. It's actually on the 13th of July. Would you like to hire a private trainer?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：呃，等一下。我搞错了。实际上是7月13日。你们想雇一位私人教练吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I'm afraid it would be over my budget, so we will just stick to the group training program.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：恐怕会超出我的预算，所以我们还是坚持团体训练项目吧。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: No problem at all. Do you have a phone number I can contact you with? To let you know of any changes to the schedule, or things like that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：完全没问题。您有可以联系您的电话号码吗？以便通知您日程变化之类的事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, you can call me at 07958477.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：有的，你可以打07958477找我。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Excellent! Thank you very much. We're very happy to have you with us.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了！非常感谢。我们很高兴你们加入我们。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Hello, Pembroke Holidays, Mary speaking.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你好，彭布罗克假日旅行社，我是玛丽。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh hello. I've seen your advert for vacant positions. Are you the right person to speak to about the jobs?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦你好。我看到了你们的职位空缺广告。你是负责招聘的人吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, I am. Now I'd like to take down some of your details. First of all, could I have your name, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，我是。现在我想记录一些你的信息。首先，能告诉我你的名字吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, it's Jack Green.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，杰克·格林。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: And can I have your address, Jack?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那你的地址呢，杰克？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: This is a little tricky. Now I'm studying at the community college and living in a flat nearby, but I only stay there from Monday to Friday. I go back to my parents' place on the weekends.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：这有点复杂。我现在在社区学院学习，住在附近的一间公寓里，但我只有周一到周五住那里。周末我回父母家。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK, so where's the best place to send you some information about us?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，那么把我们的资料寄到哪里最好？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh, to the flat, please. The address is 7 Market Street.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦，请寄到公寓。地址是市场街7号。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, is it next to the North Park?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，是在北公园旁边吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: No, it's actually the South Park.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：不，实际上是南公园。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK, and your postcode?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，你的邮编呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's VIT 613UL.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是VIT 613UL。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Alright, I've taken that down. Do you have a phone number so we can contact you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我记下了。你有电话号码方便我们联系你吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, my mobile number's 07763 ... Sorry I made a mistake. It should be 07736 545608.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：有的，我的手机号码是07763……抱歉我弄错了。应该是07736 545608。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Got that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：记下了。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: So, you said you are a student at the community college?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那么，你说你是社区学院的学生？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, I started studying at the college a couple of weeks ago, and I'd like to find a part-time job on the weekends.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，我几周前开始在这所学院学习，我想在周末找一份兼职工作。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I see. What kind of job would you like to apply for?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了。你想申请什么样的工作？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Customer service. I like to talk to different kinds of people and it seems that I'm quite good at that. I enjoy listening to what people have to say and helping them solve their problems, that kind of thing. So, I think that customer service would suit me well.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：客户服务。我喜欢和不同类型的人交谈，而且我似乎很擅长这个。我喜欢倾听别人的话并帮助他们解决问题，诸如此类。所以，我觉得客户服务很适合我。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Good. Have you ever thought about cleaning? At the moment we also have vacancy in that area and I thought you might be interested.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。你考虑过清洁工作吗？目前我们在这方面也有空缺，我想你可能会感兴趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Absolutely yes. I've just finished a short-term contract as a hotel housekeeper. I enjoyed the work and it certainly brightened my day to see all the customers staying in a tidy and comfortable environment!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：当然有兴趣。我刚完成了一份酒店客房服务员的短期合同。我很喜欢这份工作，看到所有客人住在整洁舒适的环境中确实让我很开心。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Good. And I will put that down too. Oh, I forgot to ask about your major. What subjects are you studying in college?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的。我也会记下这个。哦，我忘了问你的专业。你在学院学什么科目？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: My major is drama, and I take history as a minor subject. My granddad is quite enthusiastic about theatre, and with his influence, I gradually became interested in it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我的专业是戏剧，我辅修历史。我爷爷对戏剧非常热衷，在他的影响下，我逐渐对它产生了兴趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: That's pretty impressive! What else can you tell me about yourself?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那很了不起！你还能告诉我关于你自己的其他事情吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: For relaxation, I'm keen on Spanish. I used to go to the cinema for Spanish movies once a week, and one of my best friends is from Spain. So you can say my Spanish is intermediate.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：休闲方面，我对西班牙语很有兴趣。我以前每周去电影院看一次西班牙电影，我最好的朋友之一来自西班牙。所以可以说我的西班牙语是中级水平。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK, so with your studying and a part-time job, do you have time for any other interest or hobby?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，那么除了学习和兼职，你还有时间做其他兴趣或爱好吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, I spend quite a lot of time driving - both around town to get to college and to work, and also long-distance, from here to London, for instance. So I'm quite good at driving, especially minibuses.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，我花很多时间开车——既在镇上往返学院和上班，也开长途，比如从这里到伦敦。所以我挺擅长开车的，尤其是小型巴士。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: One more question. Are you sure you will have enough time for this job?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：还有一个问题。你确定你有足够的时间做这份工作吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, for sure. On Mondays and Tuesdays, we have classes from 8.30 am to 9.30 pm, so I couldn't work on these two days. But from Wednesdays to Sundays, I only have classes in the mornings and afternoons, so I can only work at night.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，当然。周一和周二，我们从早上8：30到晚上9：30有课，所以这两天我不能工作。但从周三到周日，我只有上午和下午有课，所以我只能晚上工作。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: OK, so when would you like to start working?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，那你希望什么时候开始工作？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, 25th August works for me. I will have a week-long trip with my best friends and I probably won't come back until then. But I'd appreciate it if I could rest for two days before starting. So that would be the 27th.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，8月25日可以。我会和最好的朋友去旅行一周，可能到那时才回来。但如果能在开始前休息两天我会很感激。所以是27号。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I understand. Thank you for your enquiry, and I hope you have a wonderful journey. Good bye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我明白了。感谢你的咨询，祝你旅途愉快。再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Thank you very much, bye.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：非常感谢，再见。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Welcome to Houston Community College, how can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：欢迎来到休斯顿社区学院，我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I'm thinking of signing up for a course. I have some free time these days and would like to try something different. What courses are available?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我在考虑报名一门课程。我这几天有些空闲时间，想尝试一些不同的东西。有什么课程可供选择？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: We have a few available at the moment. Is there any particular day that suits you best?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我们目前有几种可供选择。有哪一天最适合你吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Any day is good except for Thursday.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：除了周四，任何一天都可以。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Ok, we have lots of courses on the other days. For example, we have our Skating class on Tuesday.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我们在其他日子有很多课程。比如，我们周二有滑冰课。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That sounds interesting. I've never skated before. Are there any courses for novices?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来很有趣。我从来没滑过冰。有初学者的课程吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Sure, actually this course mainly includes basic skills and our professional coaches will teach you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然，实际上这门课主要包括基础技能，我们的专业教练会教你。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's great. When does it begin?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了。什么时候开始？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It used to begin at 8pm, but since it's very popular, now it starts at 7.45pm and goes until quite late in the evening. It is a lot of fun.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：以前是晚上8点开始，但因为很受欢迎，现在晚上7：45开始，一直到深夜。非常有趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Those times work perfectly for me. How much does it cost then?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：这些时间对我来说非常合适。那要多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's 650 dollars.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：650美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh. I see... That's going to be quite expensive for me. I mean, I'm going to have to buy the equipment too.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦，我明白了……那对我来说相当贵。我是说，我还得买装备。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: You don't need to buy any equipment. The skates are included in the price.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你不需要买任何装备。溜冰鞋包含在价格里了。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh. Ok, maybe that's not so bad then.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦。好的，那也许没那么糟。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: But you will need to wear warm clothes since it can be very cold late at night. It would be good to have something to keep you warm.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：但你需要穿暖和点的衣服，因为深夜可能会很冷。带些保暖的东西会比较好。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay, I will keep that in mind. What other courses do you have?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，我会记住的。你们还有什么其他课程？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Well, we also have a First Aid course starting next week.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯，我们下周还有一个急救课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's something new to me. What is it about specifically?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那对我来说是新东西。具体是关于什么的？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's a course that's designed to help old family members in case something emergent happens.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：这是一门旨在帮助老年家庭成员应对紧急情况的课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I see. I suppose it would be very useful. My parents are getting older, and I would like to know what to do if there was an emergency. When will it begin?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我明白了。我想这会很有用。我的父母越来越老了，我想知道如果发生紧急情况该怎么做。什么时候开始？

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: It starts on Wednesday at 7 pm.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：周三晚上7点开始。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Good. How much will it cost?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。要多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Unfortunately, the cost of the First Aid course has just gone up. It used to be only $120 for four classes. Now, it is $140.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不幸的是，急救课程的费用刚刚涨了。以前四节课只要120美元。现在是140美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I think that is quite reasonable. Will I need to bring anything to the classes? Like a notebook?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我觉得那相当合理。我需要带什么东西去上课吗？比如笔记本？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, you will need to take some notes on it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，你需要用它来记笔记。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay, got it. Are there any cooking courses available? I have always wanted to be a chef.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，明白了。有烹饪课程吗？我一直想成为一名厨师。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: You're in luck. There is one space left available in our Cooking course. It's very popular. And at the end, you will get a certificate in cookery, which can help you find a job. The classes start at 5pm every Sunday.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你很幸运。我们的烹饪课程还剩一个名额。它很受欢迎。最后你会获得烹饪证书，这可以帮助你找工作。每周日下午5点开始上课。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That is exactly what I would like to do! Umm, how much does it cost?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那正是我想做的！嗯，要多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's 100 dollars for five classes in total. As for the ingredients, the teacher will provide, but you will have to pay for them, I'm afraid. And that's $56.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：总共五节课100美元。至于食材，老师会提供，但恐怕你需要自己付费。是56美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That sounds reasonable to me. I would like to sign up for the cooking course please. What should I bring with me?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来很合理。我想报名烹饪课程。我需要带什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Most things are provided. We will provide most of the cooking utensils and tools, but you will need to bring your own apron. We don't supply them here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：大部分东西都会提供。我们会提供大部分烹饪用具和工具，但你需要自带围裙。我们这里不提供。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay, that's no problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: My wife is also thinking of doing one of your courses. What do you recommend?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我妻子也在考虑参加你们的一门课程。你有什么推荐？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: What is she interested in?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：她喜欢什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, she often complains that she isn't active enough.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，她经常抱怨自己不够活跃。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Maybe she'll enjoy the Yoga course that we run at Lawton Community Centre every Friday.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：也许她会喜欢我们每周五在劳顿社区中心举办的瑜伽课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I don't think I know where that is. I'll look it up. How do you spell the name?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我想我不知道那在哪里。我会查一下。名字怎么拼写？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: L-A-W-T-O-N. It's not too far from here, maybe a 10-minute walk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：L-A-W-T-O-N。离这里不太远，大概步行十分钟。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Oh great.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：哦太好了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: The trainer there is very experienced and professional.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那里的教练非常有经验和专业。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I see. My wife often gets a sore neck and back, I hope yoga can be helpful.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我明白了。我妻子经常脖子和背部酸痛，我希望瑜伽能有所帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Woman: Absolutely, yoga can be very effective at relieving neck pain.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然，瑜伽对缓解颈部疼痛非常有效。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Alright, I guess she might be interested in that. How much does it cost?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，我想她可能会感兴趣。要多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: The course will cost $50 for a group lesson or $150 if she wants a private lesson.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：团体课50美元，如果她想上私人课的话150美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay, I will let her know. What would she need to bring? Does she need any special shoes or equipment?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，我会告诉她的。她需要带什么？她需要特别的鞋子或装备吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: She needs to bring her own towel as well as a mat designed for yoga. You can find them at any fitness store.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：她需要自带毛巾和瑜伽垫。你可以在任何健身用品店买到。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay. Are there any other courses for females, if she is not interested in yoga?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。如果她对瑜伽不感兴趣，还有其他适合女性的课程吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: She could consider our Make-up Training course at our Logan campus.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：她可以考虑我们在洛根校区的化妆培训课程。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Actually, this would be quite helpful. She is looking for a job as a make-up artist, and I think it would be helpful at a job interview to say she has done some training recently.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：实际上，这会很有帮助。她在找化妆师的工作，我觉得在面试时说最近接受过一些培训会有帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, and the price is reasonable too.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的，而且价格也合理。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: How much will it cost?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：要多少钱？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It comes to $200 and goes for two months.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：200美元，为期两个月。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That sounds great. If she is interested, what does she need to bring? Some makeup tools?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来不错。如果她感兴趣，她需要带什么？一些化妆工具吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Actually, she just needs to bring her own brushes and a small mirror.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：实际上，她只需要带自己的刷子和一面小镜子。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Ok, I will talk to her about it, and get back to you. Thanks for your help.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，我会和她谈谈，然后回复你。谢谢你的帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: No problem. Drop by if you need anymore information. Have a great day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：没问题。如果你还需要更多信息，随时过来。祝你有美好的一天。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Good morning. I'd like to open a bank account, please.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：早上好。我想开一个银行账户。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Certainly. If you'd like to take a seat, I'll just get some information on our different options for you. It won't take long.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然可以。如果您愿意坐下，我会为您获取一些关于我们不同账户选项的信息。不会太久。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Thanks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I've got the application form for you here. I see you've already got our leaflet. As you can see, we have different types of accounts-Is it a current account or a deposit account you want to open today?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我这里有申请表给您。我看到您已经拿了我们的宣传册。如您所见，我们有不同类型的账户——您今天想开的是活期账户还是定期存款账户？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: A deposit account, I suppose. Could you tell me a little more about this type of account? The interest rate, for instance.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我想是定期存款账户。你能多告诉我一些关于这类账户的信息吗？比如利率。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Sure. Our interest rate is 3.4%, which is actually 1.3% higher than other banks. So opening an account here is a good choice if you want to save.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然。我们的利率是3.4%，实际上比其他银行高1.3%。所以如果你想存钱，在这里开户是个好选择。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: And if I wanted to withdraw around 50,000 dollars, would I need to wait?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：如果我想取大约5万美元，需要等吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: No, but when you withdraw more than 1 million dollars, it would be a different process. In the past, you had to give a notice 60 days in advance. But things are little different here. You only need to give a 30-day notice.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不需要，但当你取超过100万美元时，流程会不同。过去，你需要提前60天通知。但这里情况略有不同。你只需要提前30天通知。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I see. That's great.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我明白了。那太好了。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Can I ask, how much will you be opening your account with? We usually ask for a minimum sum of 300 dollars. But if you have more than $600, you'll have a better interest rate.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我能问一下，您打算存多少钱开户？我们通常要求最低300美元。但如果超过600美元，利率会更好。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, I'm going to transfer $1,000 from my Dutch account, just until I get paid.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，我打算从我的荷兰账户转1000美元过来，直到我拿到工资。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: That's not a problem.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：那没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Great! How long should it take to arrange a debit card? A week?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了！安排借记卡需要多长时间？一周？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I'm afraid not. The general process of opening the account needs 10 working days. But it's usually quite fast. It takes most banks two more days than us.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：恐怕不是。开户的一般流程需要10个工作日。但通常相当快。大多数银行比我们多两天。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's good to know. What should I do if I need to close this account? Do I come back to you or...?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那太好了。如果我需要关闭这个账户，该怎么办？我回来找你还是……？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I'm afraid not. My duty as an account administrator is to open the account for you. You'd need to talk to the branch manager about that matter.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：恐怕不行。我作为账户管理员的职责是为您开户。您需要和分行经理谈那件事。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: And what's the best way to withdraw cash?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那取现金最好的方式是什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Well as this is a deposit account, if you need cash, there are two ways to do that. One is through any ATM of our bank at your convenience. Our bank tellers can also handle a cash withdrawal but you need to bring your identification.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯，因为这是定期存款账户，如果您需要现金，有两种方式。一种是在您方便时通过我们银行的任何ATM机。我们的柜员也可以处理取现，但您需要带身份证件。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Alright, I will keep that in mind.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，我会记住的。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I also want to enquire about insurance.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我还想咨询一下保险。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, yes. I forgot to mention that. Deposit accounts with over 50,000 dollars come with a life insurance policy free of charge. But, if you already have that type of insurance then you can change the policy to house insurance if you like.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，是的。我忘了提。超过5万美元的定期存款账户附带一份免费的人寿保险。但如果您已经有那种保险，您也可以选择将其改为房屋保险。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I see, I guess I would go for the latter one.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我明白了，我想我会选后者。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Hmm, take your time to think about it. You can let us know if you change your mind. If you're interested, we also have investment schemes available. You can find information about that option in your leaflet. Just give us a call if you want to know more.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯，您慢慢考虑。如果您改变主意可以告诉我们。如果您感兴趣，我们也有投资计划。您可以在宣传册中找到相关信息。如果想了解更多，给我们打电话就行。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Thanks, I think I'll just open the account today. If I want to apply for a credit card, can I also do that today?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：谢谢，我想今天就开户。如果我想申请信用卡，今天也可以办理吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, but there is an interview for the application. We usually ask for some information about your credit history and income. If you want to get started, there is a form you can fill in now; it won't take long. We just need to know your personal information, like your name, current address, phone number, social security number, and such. We can start the process today and will call you in a few days.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：可以的，但申请需要面试。我们通常会询问一些关于您的信用记录和收入的信息。如果您想开始，有一份表格您现在可以填写；不会太久。我们只需要知道您的个人信息，比如姓名、当前地址、电话号码、社会保障号码等。我们今天可以开始流程，几天后会打电话给您。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Alright. Can I have the form please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。请给我表格好吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Good morning. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：早上好。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hello, I've just been accepted into a study program at the university, so I'd like to know some information about student card application, like the requirements, the cost etc.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你好，我刚被大学的一个学习项目录取，所以我想了解一些关于学生卡申请的信息，比如要求、费用等。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, certainly. Let me get a registration form and learn a bit more about your situation and so forth.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，当然。让我拿一份注册表，了解一下您的情况等等。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay, thank you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的，谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: So first of all, how long would you like to stay?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：首先，您打算待多久？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Well, the study program lasts for three years but at this stage I'd only like to stay for two years. I'm thinking about going elsewhere for the third year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：嗯，学习项目为期三年，但在目前阶段我只想待两年。我在考虑第三年去别的地方。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Two years are long enough to figure out what's next.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：两年足够考虑下一步了。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I hope so. Anyway. I heard that I can apply for an international student card?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：希望如此。不管怎样，我听说我可以申请国际学生卡？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes. I've checked your student file. You're eligible for that card. It will give you lots of advantages, such as discounts.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的。我查了您的学生档案。您有资格申请那张卡。它会给你很多好处，比如折扣。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Sounds good. How can I apply for it?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来不错。我怎么申请？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's pretty simple. You just need to leave some necessary personal information with us and pay for a registration fee, which is only £3. Oh sorry, that was for last month, actually it's £5 now.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：很简单。您只需要在我们这里留下一些必要的个人信息，并支付注册费，只要3英镑。哦抱歉，那是上个月的价格，实际上是5英镑。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's cool. Is the card only for discounts in the university or it can also be used wherever I go?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那很好。这张卡只用于大学里的折扣，还是我到哪儿都能用？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Sure, all shops on campus will accept this card. You can get textbooks with lower prices. Besides, free admission is granted to the holder of the card at the local museum in the city centre.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然，校园里的所有商店都接受这张卡。你可以买到更便宜的教科书。此外，市中心当地博物馆对持卡人免费开放。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I assume I can also be benefited from booking accommodation on campus?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我想预订校内住宿也能享受优惠吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: That's true. Some places are 20% or 30% cheaper.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是的。有些地方便宜20%到30%。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Okay. How about amusement parks? They are my favourite.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。游乐场呢？它们是我的最爱。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh yes, I forgot to mention that. They are also included. The card will come with a booklet outlining all the places where you can get the discounts.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦是的，我忘了提。它们也包括在内。卡片会附带一本小册子，列出所有可以享受折扣的地方。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Great, that will be useful. Can I register right now?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太好了，那会很有用。我现在可以注册吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Sure you can!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：当然可以！

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I'm going to ask you some routine questions. First of all, can I take your name?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我要问您一些常规问题。首先，能告诉我您的名字吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's John Hiddleston.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：约翰·希德勒斯顿。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Could you spell your last name, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：能拼一下您的姓吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes. H-I-D-D-L-E-S-T-O-N.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。H-I-D-D-L-E-S-T-O-N。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Where do you live currently? I mean, where can I send the student card when it is ready?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：您目前住在哪里？我是说，学生卡办好后我可以寄到哪里？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: At the moment, I'm living with my parents. Please send it to 15 Station Avenue, New Castle.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：目前，我和父母住在一起。请寄到纽卡斯尔车站大道15号。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, got that. I have been there once. New Castle is a lovely town. How can I contact you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦，记下了。我去过一次。纽卡斯尔是个可爱的小镇。我怎么联系您？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Call me at 3-0-7-2-8-3-1-0-0-5, which is my mobile number.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：打3072831005，那是我的手机号码。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Thank you. Before you go, I just want you to know that we have recently started to offer a booking service to newly registered students. Do you need any help with that?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：谢谢。在您离开之前，我想告诉您，我们最近开始为新注册的学生提供预订服务。您需要这方面的帮助吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, that would be great. One airline ticket will be good since I'm traveling alone.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，那太好了。一张机票就行，因为我是一个人旅行。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Alright, can I email you a form which requests information like the dates, airline food and seating preferences and so forth? Then we will do our research and come back to you with flight options.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，我可以给您发一份表格吗？上面需要填写日期、机上餐饮和座位偏好等信息。然后我们会研究并给您提供航班选择。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Sounds perfect.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：听起来很完美。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: What's your email address?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：您的邮箱地址是什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It's johnwhite@gmail.com.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是johnwhite@gmail.com。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Thank you. That's all the information I need. Is there anything I can help you with...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：谢谢。这就是我需要的信息了。还有什么我能帮您的……

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Hello? Jennifer speaking.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：你好？我是詹妮弗。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Hello Jennifer. My name's Ben Smith. I'm from the New Zealand Post Office Service. I understand you left a couple of questions on our website forum. Seeing as though you left your phone number as a contact, I thought you might prefer us to call.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你好詹妮弗。我叫本·史密斯。我是新西兰邮政服务的。我了解到你在我们的网站论坛上留了几个问题。考虑到你留了电话号码作为联系方式，我想你可能更喜欢我们打电话给你。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh Ben! Its nice to speak to you again. I really appreciate your help last month. Yes, as I will be moving to Australia soon and need to send some of my things via airmail, I just wasn't sure how to get my mail redirected.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦本！很高兴再次和你通话。我真的很感激你上个月的帮助。是的，因为我很快要搬到澳大利亚，需要空运一些东西，我只是不确定如何转寄我的邮件。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I can help you with that. It's interesting that I recently got more inquiries about international mailing due to migration to other countries. May I ask why you are moving?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我可以帮你解决这个问题。有趣的是，我最近收到了更多关于移民其他国家导致的国际邮寄咨询。我能问一下你为什么要搬家吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Umm... There are a few reasons such as I have family in Australia and the weather there is warmer, but mainly because it hard to find a job here. I have just got the news that I was successful in applying for a job in Australia! I'll be starting in November.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯……有几个原因，比如我在澳大利亚有家人，那边的天气更暖和，但主要是因为这里很难找到工作。我刚收到消息，我成功申请到了澳大利亚的一份工作！我将在十一月开始工作。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: How exciting, congratulations! I have never been to Australia, but I've heard it's a nice place. Is it a permanent job?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：太令人兴奋了，恭喜！我从没去过澳大利亚，但我听说那是个好地方。是永久性工作吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: No, I will only be working for that company as a temporary assistant over this summer. You never know I might get homesick and want to come back after a few months anyway!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：不，我只是在今年夏天作为临时助理在那家公司工作。谁知道呢，我也可能会想家，几个月后就想回来！

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: I hope the job goes well for you. What postal address will you be using in Australia?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：希望你的工作顺利。你在澳大利亚会用什么邮寄地址？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I had organized some accommodation at a hostel in Sydney for the first week, but that fell through, so I will stay at my friend's house until I find somewhere else. My things will have to be sent to her place for now and the address is 9 Queen Street, Sydney.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我原本在第一周安排了悉尼一家旅舍的住宿，但没成，所以我会住在朋友家，直到找到别的地方。我的东西暂时得寄到她那里，地址是悉尼皇后街9号。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Can I know how long you will be staying there? We want to make sure you get your mail while you are there.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我能知道你会在那里住多久吗？我们想确保你在那里时能收到邮件。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I will be staying there for the first two months. You know, it's free staying with her.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：头两个月我会住那里。你知道，住她那里是免费的。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: That's nice! Now, I've got a couple more questions for you. What is your full name and current address?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：那很好！现在，我还有几个问题要问你。你的全名和当前地址是什么？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: My name is Jennifer Simmons.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我叫詹妮弗·西蒙斯。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: How do you spell your surname, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：请问你的姓怎么拼写？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's S-I-M-M-O-N-S.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：是S-I-M-M-O-N-S。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Got that. And your address, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：记下了。你的地址呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Oh, right. I'm currently living at 16 Ocean Road, Auckland.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：哦对。我目前住在奥克兰海洋路16号。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: And your postcode?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你的邮编呢？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: It's 0245.
MAN: That doesn't come up in our system as a valid postcode. Can you check that again, please?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：这在我们的系统中不是有效的邮编。你能再检查一下吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Yes, sorry! I'm not good at remembering numbers. It's 0425.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：好的，抱歉！我不擅长记数字。是0425。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: When would you like your things to be air mailed?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：你希望你的东西什么时候空运？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I will leave New Zealand on the 23rd of September, but I will try to send them on the 22nd, so that's the day before. How long will it take for my things to get to Australia?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我将在9月23日离开新西兰，但我会尽量在22日寄出，也就是前一天。我的东西到澳大利亚要多久？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: It will take about a week.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：大约需要一周。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Perfect. That should give me time to get organized in Australia before everything arrives.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：完美。那应该让我有时间在东西到达之前在澳大利亚安顿好。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: May I ask about the content of your delivery? There are some things you have to sign a goods declaration for, such as expensive items or if you are importing medications in bulk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：我能问一下你邮寄的内容吗？有些东西你需要签署货物申报单，比如贵重物品或者如果你批量进口药物的话。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I won't be sending anything like that. It'll mainly be personal items. I was thinking of posting some books. But I guess that's quite expensive because they are heavy. And my guitar is kind of big.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我不会寄那样的东西。主要是个人物品。我在考虑寄一些书。但我想那很贵，因为它们很重。我的吉他也有点大。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Yes, it can be quite expensive.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：是的，可能相当贵。

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: Ummm... I might not send them then. I definitely need to send some of my files. I have one standard-size file box full of them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：嗯……那我可能不寄了。我肯定需要寄一些文件。我有一个标准大小的文件盒装满了它们。

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Sure. Anything else?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：好的。还有别的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: I've heard the beaches and the ocean are beautiful in Australia. I enjoy diving so I'm going to send my diving gear as well. I have packed it into a box to send it more easily. Would you mind if I weighed everything and sent you information to get a quote on the price?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：我听说澳大利亚的海滩和海洋很美。我喜欢潜水，所以我也要寄我的潜水装备。我已经把它装进一个盒子里方便邮寄。你介意我把所有东西称重，把信息发给你以获取价格报价吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: MAN: Just send it to info@postalservice.nz. Can I help you with anything else?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 男士：就发到info@postalservice.nz吧。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: WOMAN: No, that's everything. Thank you for your help!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 女士：没有了，就这些。谢谢你的帮助！

transcriptBlocks.english: Great Land hotel. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大地酒店。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. Do you have any vacancies? This is my first time traveling in Africa, and some of my friends told me that your hotel is rated high, so I'm calling to book a room for my husband and I.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。你们有空房吗？这是我第一次在非洲旅行，我的一些朋友告诉我你们酒店评价很高，所以我打电话来为我和我丈夫订房。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thanks for the compliment. We work hard to provide satisfying experience to all of our customers. Let me check the availability.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢夸奖。我们努力为所有客户提供满意的体验。让我查一下空房情况。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sure.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。

transcriptBlocks.english: We still have double rooms left this week and next week.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这周和下周我们还有双人房。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's great. Your location is NO. 198 Canyon Road, right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。你们的位置是峡谷路198号，对吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Correct.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对。

transcriptBlocks.english: How much do you charge for one double room? The price depends on the time. Usually, it's £9.9 per night. Right now, it's just £8.37 per night.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 一间双人房收费多少？价格取决于时间。通常是每晚9.9英镑。现在只要每晚8.37英镑。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sounds fair.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来很公平。

transcriptBlocks.english: How long will you be staying? I'm not sure, really. I guess I will stay for 1 night, to see the attractions around here. Hmm, that price requires guests to stay at least two nights. Right. I'm fine with that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们要住多久？我不太确定。我想我会住一晚，看看周围的景点。嗯，那个价格要求客人至少住两晚。好的。我没问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Ok, I will note that down here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，我会在这里记下来。

transcriptBlocks.english: Is breakfast included? Yes, it is. And if you cook, feel free to use the kitchen in your room. It has stoves, ovens and everything. You can cook your own meals if you don't want to eat out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 含早餐吗？是的。如果你们做饭，可以随意使用房间里的厨房。有炉灶、烤箱等所有东西。如果你们不想出去吃，可以自己做饭。

transcriptBlocks.english: That's really nice. Can you teach us how to cook African food? You can ask our staff at the dining hall for some tips when they are not busy.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那太好了。你们能教我们怎么做非洲菜吗？你们可以在餐厅工作人员不忙的时候向他们请教一些技巧。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great. Is there anything else I need to prepare for myself? Like toothbrush or slippers? We have those in the rooms. But I'm afraid you will have to bring your own soap.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了。我还需要为自己准备什么吗？比如牙刷或拖鞋？房间里有这些。但恐怕你们需要自带肥皂。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sure. I will buy one from the shop around the corner. Can I get my room number now? We named our rooms with words related to music. And your room is called ... Melody Space.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然。我会在拐角处的商店买一块。我现在能知道我的房间号吗？我们用与音乐相关的词来命名房间。你们的房间叫……旋律空间。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you. Do you have room service here? Yes. If you need that, you can call the reception. There will be someone to answer your calls 24 hours a day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢。你们这里有客房服务吗？有的。如果需要，可以打电话给前台。全天24小时有人接听电话。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. That would be great. I might need to have my clothes ironed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。那太好了。我可能需要熨衣服。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have any valuables with you, you can keep them in the safe. It's in the closet.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们有贵重物品，可以放在保险箱里。在壁橱里。

transcriptBlocks.english: Thank you. Can you recommend good places to go near here? Our hotel actually arranges tours with professional tour guides.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 谢谢。你能推荐附近好玩的地方吗？我们酒店实际上会安排专业导游带团。

transcriptBlocks.english: What kinds of tours do you have? If you just want to go out for one day, you can visit the city centre. It has a long history, and you can see a lot of African architecture and customs. Each week, there will be different cultural events. This week, after you finish the daytime trip, you can see a firework display from 9pm to 10pm every night, near the Civil Square. Overall, the area is pretty big which takes the whole day, and we highly recommend it!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们有什么样的旅行团？如果你们只想出去一天，可以参观市中心。它有悠久的历史，你们可以看到很多非洲建筑和风俗。每周都有不同的文化活动。这周，白天游览结束后，每天晚上9点到10点，在公民广场附近有烟花表演。总的来说，这个区域很大，需要一整天，我们强烈推荐！

transcriptBlocks.english: Sounds fun. I think my husband and I can explore the city on our own since we did some homework about the area before we came.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来很有趣。我想我和我丈夫可以自己探索这座城市，因为我们在来之前已经做了一些功课。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, but our tour guides can explain the history and culture from a local's perspective. I believe it will be different from the information posted on the internet.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，但我们的导游可以从当地人的角度解释历史和文化。我相信这与网上发布的信息不同。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you can go out for two days, I recommend the trip to see whales. You can see different kinds of whales this time of the year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们能出去两天，我推荐观鲸之旅。每年这个时候你们可以看到不同种类的鲸鱼。

transcriptBlocks.english: That sounds exciting! I've never seen a whale before. Do we go out on boats or..? Well, you can choose a ferry, but most of the visitors are willing to take helicopters. You get to see them from above as well as a great view of the sea. Live, interactive in-flight pilot commentary and narration will also be provided. Right now, there is a discount for two helicopter tickets, it's a good deal!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 听起来太刺激了！我从没见过鲸鱼。我们是乘船出去还是……？嗯，你们可以选择渡轮，但大多数游客愿意乘坐直升机。你们可以从上方看到它们，还能欣赏美丽的海景。还会提供实时的互动式飞行中飞行员解说。现在两张直升机票有折扣，很划算！

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. We will book that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。我们预订那个。

transcriptBlocks.english: Do you need airport pickup? We can arrange that for you. No, thanks. We're on our way to your hotel now.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们需要机场接机吗？我们可以为你们安排。不用了，谢谢。我们现在正在去你们酒店的路上。

transcriptBlocks.english: Great!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 太好了！

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning. This is Blue Planet Aquarium. How can I help you?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好。这里是蓝色星球水族馆。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning. I'd like to book tickets for my group. We are thinking of visiting the aquarium together some time soon. So, I guess it would be necessary to book tickets ahead of time. Sure. It's hard to buy if you come on the day of your visit. I'll make a booking for you.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好。我想为我的团队预订门票。我们正在考虑近期一起去参观水族馆。所以，我想有必要提前订票。当然。如果您参观当天才来很难买到票。我为您预订。

transcriptBlocks.english: First, I'd like to have some basic information from you. Which organization is your group from? We are from Sanders College. That's S-A-N-D-E-R-S.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 首先，我需要您的一些基本信息。您的团队来自哪个组织？我们来自桑德斯学院。拼写是S-A-N-D-E-R-S。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK. And your address, please. It's No.6 Beach Road.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的。您的地址呢？海滩路6号。

transcriptBlocks.english: Just a moment. I will write that down. OK, do you have a phone number through which I can contact you during the day? We usually need to confirm the booking with our customers one day before the visiting date. Sure, my cellphone number is 07768999. Hmm, hold on a second. I no longer use that number. Let me give your another one, hmm, it's 07768529.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 稍等。我记下来。好的，您有白天可以联系到您的电话号码吗？我们通常需要在参观日期前一天与客户确认预订。当然，我的手机号码是07768999。嗯，稍等一下。我不再用那个号码了。我给你另一个号码，嗯，是07768529。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright. How many people will be coming to the aquarium with you? Let me see. There are 16 people in our office. But, hmm, 14 people will be there, including myself. OK. We have discounts for groups with 15 people or more. Do you want to invite one more person so that the whole group can get a discount? Oh I didn't know that, but I guess it's just 14 of us visiting this time as the other two have gone on a business trip.

transcriptBlocks.chinese: 哦，有多大？游泳池大约50米长。所以足够大。还有一家咖啡馆。你游完泳后可以喝杯软饮料。听起来都很不错。我得告诉你附近没有停车场。所以如果你开车去，你可能要花些时间找停车位。对。那可能是个问题。我不想停在路边。有点贵。其他选择呢？
