transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我的职业生涯中，我经常被要求组织这样的活动。这并不奇怪——许多人在购买自行车时不确定要考虑什么。所以，我想给大家快速介绍一下一些知名自行车公司、它们提供什么以及如何充分利用它们的服务。现在，让我们开始吧！

transcriptBlocks.english: First up on our list is Bike world. This company is known for their great customer service. The workers there are very polite and go about their work with such happiness that makes you wonder if they are being paid a million dollars.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们名单上的第一家是自行车世界。这家公司以出色的客户服务而闻名。那里的员工非常礼貌，工作起来充满快乐，让你怀疑他们是否拿着百万美元的薪水。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next on our list is Travel on Bike. While they were previously recognized for their diverse selection of mountain bikes, road bikes, and hybrid bikes to meet specific needs, they now excel in providing a wide range of spare parts for repairs. Whether you purchased your bike from their store or elsewhere, they are equipped to source the necessary parts for repairs.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们名单上的下一家是骑行旅行。虽然他们以前以多样化的山地车、公路车和混合动力车选择而闻名，以满足特定需求，但现在他们在提供广泛的维修备件方面表现出色。无论你是从他们商店还是其他地方购买的自行车，他们都能为维修采购必要的零件。

transcriptBlocks.english: The third company we would be examining today is Two Wheels. With their discount for every member, they are able to tailor their products to cater to those with shallow pockets. Their products are also quality too.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们今天要考察的第三家公司是两个轮子。通过为每位会员提供折扣，他们能够定制产品以满足预算有限的人。他们的产品质量也很好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good Weather Bike often opens up stores near universities, offering products known for their exceptional durability and strength, surpassing that of some competitors. Instead of recommending an immediate purchase, I suggest considering the option to rent one. This allows you to experience the product firsthand and assess its suitability.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好天气自行车经常在大学附近开设门店，提供以卓越耐用性和强度著称的产品，超过了一些竞争对手。我不建议立即购买，而是建议考虑租用一辆。这让你能亲身体验产品并评估其适用性。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you really need a bike, but do not have the resources for a brand new one, you can get across to The Wright Brothers and they would fix you up with a very good second-hand bike. They always verify the ownership of whatever bikes that they sell. So you can be sure there would be no legal issues with whatever bike you purchase from them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你真的需要自行车，但没有购买新车的资源，你可以联系莱特兄弟，他们会为你提供一辆非常好的二手自行车。他们总是核实所售自行车的所有权。所以你可以放心，从他们那里购买的自行车不会有法律问题。

transcriptBlocks.english: Magic Cycling has recently transitioned from bike repairs to offering the up-to-date bike models in town. Despite the recent change, they have quickly become known for their innovative selection. Rest assured, you can trust in their commitment to providing top-of-the-line models for their customers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 魔法骑行最近从自行车维修转向提供镇上最新的自行车型号。尽管最近发生了转变，他们很快以其创新的选择而闻名。放心，你可以相信他们致力于为客户提供顶级型号的承诺。

transcriptBlocks.english: With all I have said, it is very easy to walk into any of these places and get confused by the range of products that they offer. I have experienced this a number of times. To guard against this, we have a few things to consider when we go to buy bikes which would serve as a guide for making the right choices.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我讲了这么多之后，走进任何一家这样的店铺都很容易被他们提供的产品范围搞糊涂。我自己也经历过很多次。为了防止这种情况，我们在购买自行车时有一些需要考虑的要点，可以作为做出正确选择的指南。

transcriptBlocks.english: As an experienced salesperson, I have noticed that when customers express interest in certain models, they often inquire about the safety measures in place. However, there is no need for excessive concern as the latest manufacturing methods have effectively addressed potential safety risks. Instead of focusing on speed or cost, it is advisable to prioritize test riding a bike to ensure comfort. Additionally, it is important to assess the bike's structure and design if you intend to modify any parts.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 作为一名经验丰富的销售人员，我注意到当客户对某些型号感兴趣时，他们经常询问安全措施。然而，没有必要过度担心，因为最新的制造方法已经有效地解决了潜在的安全风险。与其关注速度或成本，建议优先试骑自行车以确保舒适性。此外，如果你打算改装任何部件，评估自行车的结构和设计也很重要。

transcriptBlocks.english: Lastly, Cycling Geek is a great option for cyclists who lack experience in choosing new bikes or are unsure about what to prioritize. They offer a wide range of repair equipment, ensuring that your bike is well-maintained. Although they used to provide free basic training and sell a variety of gear, these services are no longer available. However, they do have a selection of secondhand options. It is worth noting that there have been some customer complaints regarding a decline in product and service quality. Again, every coin has two sides.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后，骑行极客是那些缺乏选择新车经验或不确定优先考虑什么的骑行者的好选择。他们提供广泛的维修设备，确保你的自行车得到良好维护。虽然他们过去提供免费基础培训和销售各种装备，但这些服务不再提供了。不过，他们确实有一些二手选择。值得注意的是，有一些客户抱怨产品和服务质量下降。再说一次，凡事都有两面。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, that wraps up what I wanted to share today. If you have any questions or would like more information about bike purchases, feel free to ask.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好了，这就是我今天想分享的内容。如果你有任何问题或想要更多关于购买自行车的信息，请随时提问。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. My name is Dave Rayson. You can call me Officer Dave. I am here to talk to you about crime on college campuses and to provide recommendations on how you can prevent becoming a victim of some of the crimes which are prevalent on this campus and other campuses across the country.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。我叫戴夫·雷森。你们可以叫我戴夫警官。我在这里和大家谈谈大学校园里的犯罪问题，并提供建议，告诉你们如何避免成为这个校园和全国各地其他校园普遍存在的一些犯罪的受害者。

transcriptBlocks.english: Before I get started on the subject matter, I would like to thank your Student Union for arranging this event and inviting me to speak to you. As a member of the campus police force and the Social Safety Association, I welcome the opportunity to inform university students about some of the criminal activities which are unfortunately taking place on most college campuses.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我开始讲正题之前，我想感谢你们的学生会安排了这次活动并邀请我来演讲。作为校园警察部队和社会安全协会的成员，我很高兴有机会向大学生们介绍一些不幸在大多数大学校园里发生的犯罪活动。

transcriptBlocks.english: Here on this campus, we have been fortunate as we have not had any robberies in recent years. And our campus police force here has done a good job of eliminating most illegal drug sales. However, we have had quite a few reports from students saying that their personal belongings got stolen over the past three months. As you can probably guess, items such as laptop computers and mobile phones are popular items for thieves, once again we encourage you to take extra precautions with these items.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在这个校园里，我们很幸运，近年来没有发生过抢劫案。我们的校园警察部队在消除大多数非法毒品销售方面做得很好。然而，我们收到了不少学生的报告，称他们的个人物品在过去三个月里被偷了。正如你可能猜到的，笔记本电脑和手机等物品是小偷的常见目标，我们再次鼓励你们对这些物品格外小心。

transcriptBlocks.english: Another good thing that I am proud to tell you is we have had fewer and fewer campus crimes for three years in a row now. This improvement coincides with an increase in the number of campus security guards. We should be thankful, as the situation was nearly unmanageable decades ago. I also credit our success to our efforts in educating students about precautionary measures to prevent such crimes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另一件我自豪地告诉你们的好事是，我们已经连续三年校园犯罪率越来越低。这一改善与校园保安人数的增加相吻合。我们应该感恩，因为几十年前情况几乎无法控制。我还将我们的成功归功于我们在教育学生采取预防措施以防止此类犯罪方面的努力。

transcriptBlocks.english: Before the presentation today, I was approached by a young woman who just enrolled in the first year of study. She was quite concerned with crime as she read in the news about some incidents happened here recently. When I looked into the stories, some were completely fabricated. I want everyone to be aware that, the media loves to sprinkle some extra drama on those crime reports, turning a small incident into a blockbuster thriller! We have had some students' parents being paranoid about the perils of crime. But in reality, we should be safe if we take precautions to prevent crimes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在今天的演讲之前，一位刚入学的大一女生找到了我。她非常担心犯罪，因为她在新闻上看到了一些最近在这里发生的事件。当我调查这些报道时，有些完全是捏造的。我想让大家意识到，媒体喜欢在这些犯罪报道上添油加醋，把一个小事件变成一部大片惊悚片！我们有一些学生的父母对犯罪的危险变得多疑。但实际上，如果我们采取预防措施防止犯罪，我们应该能保证安全。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now let's learn the dos and don'ts about self-protection. If you come across a crime, it is likely to have reactions like resisting or running away, but contacting the police or asking others for help should be at the top of your list when witnessing or experiencing a crime.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在让我们学习一下自我保护的注意事项。如果你遇到犯罪，很可能会做出反抗或逃跑等反应，但在目击或经历犯罪时，联系警察或向他人求助应该排在首位。

transcriptBlocks.english: When it comes to staying safe in our daily lives, it's good to know those emergency numbers, but let's be real - trying to remember a bunch of phone numbers can be a bit much. And if you're worried about your safety, maybe consider taking a self-defense class. But for most folks on campus, just keeping an eye out for any fishy situations is the way to go.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 说到日常生活中的安全，知道那些紧急电话号码是好的，但现实地说——试图记住一堆电话号码可能有点太多了。如果你担心自己的安全，也许可以考虑参加自卫课程。但对于校园里的大多数人来说，只要留意任何可疑情况就行了。

transcriptBlocks.english: For those of you who work or study late, we encourage you not to walk alone on campus. Ask a friend or contact a campus security guard to accompany you to your destination on campus. Remember, even if you have a mobile phone, we don't recommend you go home by yourself after midnight.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些工作或学习到很晚的人，我们鼓励你们不要在校园里独自行走。叫一个朋友或联系校园保安陪你到校园内的目的地。记住，即使你有手机，我们也不建议你在午夜后独自回家。

transcriptBlocks.english: I previously mentioned the idea of taking a defense course. Please note that the goal of a self-defense course is not necessarily to make you stronger, but to help you to identify and raise your awareness of possible dangerous situations. In doing so, you'll know how to deal with a possible assault.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我之前提到过参加自卫课程的想法。请注意，自卫课程的目标不一定是让你变得更强壮，而是帮助你识别并提高对可能危险情况的意识。这样做，你会知道如何处理可能的攻击。

transcriptBlocks.english: In the past five years, I have received numerous calls from students inquiring about tools for self-protection. While they are aware that guns are prohibited on this campus, some believe that carrying a knife would be a good idea. I strongly advise against this, as it is illegal to possess weapons on campus and there is a risk of self-inflicted harm. Instead, you can consider non-lethal options such as whistles and pepper spray, which can be effective in various situations where personal safety is a concern.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在过去五年里，我收到了无数学生询问自卫工具的电话。虽然他们知道校园内禁止枪支，但有些人认为携带刀具是个好主意。我强烈反对这样做，因为在校园内持有武器是非法的，而且有自伤的风险。相反，你可以考虑非致命性选择，如哨子和胡椒喷雾，在涉及人身安全的各种情况下这些可能有效。

transcriptBlocks.english: With this in mind, we encourage you to remember what a "university" is? A university is definitely not a military base--we're all about open spaces and free-flowing vibes, no walls needed here! The fewer weapons we have on campus, the safer we will all be.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 考虑到这一点，我们鼓励你们记住什么是"大学"？大学绝对不是军事基地——我们重视开放空间和自由流动的氛围，这里不需要围墙！校园里的武器越少，我们都会越安全。

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, all. My name is Samantha. I am a senior at the university and I am here this afternoon to introduce you to the student union on our campus.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大家好。我叫萨曼莎。我是大学的大四学生，今天下午在这里向你们介绍我们校园的学生会。

transcriptBlocks.english: As a student of this university, you are registered in our student union automatically and can enjoy all the benefits. No submission fees are required; those are included in your tuition. With this in mind, we encourage you to take advantage of all of the different services our student union offers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 作为这所大学的学生，你们会自动注册到我们的学生会，并享受所有福利。无需提交费用；这些已包含在你们的学费中。考虑到这一点，我们鼓励你们充分利用学生会提供的所有不同服务。

transcriptBlocks.english: The student union is governed by students who are chosen by their fellow students in an annual election. Nobody else is allowed to vote in these elections--not even university faculty or staff. The student union is housed at the aptly-named Union House on the southeast corner of the campus where you will also see the library beside it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 学生会由学生管理，他们在年度选举中由同学选出。其他任何人都不允许在这些选举中投票——即使是大学教职员工也不行。学生会位于校园东南角一个恰如其名的“联合会大楼”，你们还会看到图书馆在旁边。

transcriptBlocks.english: A complete list of all clubs governed by the student union is available if you are interested. Compared to the number last year, we have 50 more non-sports clubs available, so that the union now governs 30 sports clubs and over 100 non-sports clubs on campus. These include clubs for each of the majors offered by the university: political clubs, language clubs, international student clubs, sororities and fraternities, etc. We encourage you, as newly enrolled students of this university, to join any of the clubs available. It's a great way to meet fellow students, and to have some fun.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们感兴趣，可以获取学生会管理的所有俱乐部的完整列表。与去年的数量相比，我们新增了50个非体育俱乐部，所以学生会现在管理着30个体育俱乐部和100多个非体育俱乐部。这些包括大学提供的每个专业的俱乐部：政治俱乐部、语言俱乐部、国际学生俱乐部、姐妹会和兄弟会等。我们鼓励你们作为这所大学的新生加入任何可用的俱乐部。这是结识同学和享受乐趣的好方式。

transcriptBlocks.english: But the student union does more than that. It is also available to help you with various problems you might encounter in your time here. If you feel that your civil rights have been seriously violated, for example, the student union can arrange a legal consultation for you. Unlike most consultations offered outside the university, we will do this for you for free since most of the staff are working as volunteers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 但学生会做的远不止这些。它还可以帮助你们解决在这里可能遇到的各种问题。例如，如果你们觉得自己的公民权利受到严重侵犯，学生会可以为你们安排法律咨询。与校外提供的大多数咨询不同，我们会免费为你们做这件事，因为大多数工作人员都是以志愿者身份工作的。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you struggle with paying tuition, the student union has a placement agency for part-time jobs which are available exclusively to students of this university. For health-related problems, we can direct you to the doctors at the campus clinic or to the local hospital, although we're not qualified to give medical advice ourselves, obviously, and if you're feeling a bit overwhelmed or a bit down, then you shouldn't hesitate to call the mental health line in our local area, which is 555 632 1987. They are very professional in this respect.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们在支付学费方面有困难，学生会有一个兼职工作介绍机构，专门为这所大学的学生提供职位。对于健康相关的问题，我们可以引导你们去校园诊所或当地医院看医生，虽然我们显然没有资格自己提供医疗建议，如果你们感到有点不知所措或有点沮丧，那么你们应该毫不犹豫地拨打我们当地的心理健康热线555 632 1987。他们在这方面非常专业。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have problems with your courses or exams, on the other hand, the student union will organise regular sessions to help you improve. I'm afraid it can't solve communication problems with a roommate, a girlfriend, or a boyfriend at the moment, but you should certainly make use of most of the services that are available.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 另一方面，如果你们在课程或考试方面有问题，学生会会定期组织辅导课程来帮助你们提高。恐怕它目前无法解决与室友、女朋友或男朋友的沟通问题，但你们当然应该利用大多数可用的服务。

transcriptBlocks.english: Before I go, I would like to highlight three of my personal favorites from the many clubs or teams which are part of the student union.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我离开之前，我想强调一下学生会所属众多俱乐部或团队中我个人最喜欢的三项。

transcriptBlocks.english: The first is The Movie Makers, which travels to different locations during semester breaks and produces films and documentaries. They have achieved great success and are recognized among the film community for their work. They have won numerous international awards as well as some national awards at the prestigious Sundance Film Festival.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 第一是电影制作人俱乐部，它在学期假期期间前往不同地点制作电影和纪录片。他们取得了巨大成功，并因其作品在电影界获得认可。他们赢得了许多国际奖项以及在著名的圣丹斯电影节上的一些国内奖项。

transcriptBlocks.english: The Team Travel club is an organization that arranges discounted trips for many of our students and staff. It negotiates discounts with airlines, hotels and hostels, car rental companies, and long distance transport companies, so if you are planning a trip at mid-semester or semester break, consult Team Travel and you'll definitely get a better deal for your dollar---and they don't charge a cent for planning!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 团队旅行俱乐部是一个为学生和教职员工安排折扣旅行的组织。它与航空公司、酒店和旅舍、租车公司和长途运输公司协商折扣，所以如果你们计划在学期中或学期假期旅行，咨询团队旅行，你们的钱肯定能得到更好的交易——而且他们不收取规划费用！

transcriptBlocks.english: And finally, Campus Radio, 94.7 FM. is manned mostly by students who are communications majors, marketing, or business majors. The schedule features a campus news show, live sporting events, and lots of great music. No other university campus radio station is bigger than ours, so if you want to stay informed about what's happening on campus, turn your dial to the Campus Radio.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后是校园广播电台，FM 94.7。工作人员主要是通信专业、市场营销或商业专业的学生。节目表包括校园新闻节目、现场体育赛事和大量好音乐。没有其他大学校园广播电台比我们的更大，所以如果你们想了解校园里发生的事情，请把拨盘调到校园广播电台。

transcriptBlocks.english: Okay, thanks for your time and attention today. I hope you enjoy your time here at the university and that you utilize the many resources offered by our student union.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好了，感谢你们今天的时间和关注。希望你们在大学度过愉快的时光，并利用学生会提供的许多资源。

transcriptBlocks.english: As you will have noticed upon entering the main campus, the area is quite vast. I'd like to show you around today and get you familiar with the area.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 正如你们进入主校区时所注意到的，这个区域相当广阔。今天我想带你们四处看看，让你们熟悉这个区域。

transcriptBlocks.english: Right now, we are standing in the campus garden, which is the most conspicuous area in the whole campus. It is roughly in the centre of the campus and makes for a good reference point.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在，我们站在校园花园里，这是整个校园中最显眼的区域。它大致在校园的中心，是一个很好的参考点。

transcriptBlocks.english: To the north-west of the garden, we have what we refer to as the Student service unit. This is where you can find course information, lodge complaints about registration, receive grades, and conduct other administrational tasks. You should become familiar with this place as you will likely be visiting it a lot in the near future, by which I mean, from tomorrow!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在花园的西北方向，我们有所谓的“学生服务部”。在这里你可以找到课程信息、投诉注册问题、接收成绩以及进行其他行政事务。你应该熟悉这个地方，因为你很可能在不久的将来会经常来——我的意思是，从明天开始！

transcriptBlocks.english: To the south-east of the garden near the south gate, we have quite a vibrant venue for both sports and concerts, and it provides over 5000 seats. You can find a lot of posters on the billboard nearby advertising upcoming activities. We usually organize at least one big event each month and have a few regularly scheduled activities that are open to all students on weekends.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在花园的东南方向靠近南门的地方，我们有一个非常活跃的场地，用于体育和音乐会，可提供5000多个座位。你可以在附近的公告板上找到很多广告即将举行的活动的海报。我们通常每个月至少组织一次大型活动，并在周末定期举行一些向所有学生开放的活动。

transcriptBlocks.english: Take the lane leading to the northeastern corner of the campus, and you will find a new building at the end. It's where trained staff are ready to cater to your health needs and give advice for any health related problems that you might have. Just to let you know, the first floor is for physical checkups while the second floor is for consultations.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 走通往校园东北角的小路，你会在尽头找到一栋新建筑。那里有训练有素的工作人员随时满足你的健康需求，并就你可能有的任何健康相关问题提供建议。顺便告诉你，一楼用于体检，二楼用于咨询。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you're from abroad and need help, you'll need to go to the building directly adjacent to the campus garden. Go straight to the second floor, where we have staff there to assist you. By the way, that building is also where we hold most of our international conferences and seminars. It's a great place to listen to experts share their experience. I highly recommend it!
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你是来自国外的学生并且需要帮助，你需要去紧邻校园花园的那栋建筑。直接上二楼，那里有工作人员可以帮助你。顺便说一句，那栋建筑也是我们举办大多数国际会议和研讨会的地方。那是倾听专家分享经验的好地方。我强烈推荐！

transcriptBlocks.english: For those who need to find a place to live on campus, you can go to the accommodation office. Please note that we have closed the old office which is directly to the west of the campus garden, as it is too small. The larger building right next to the café is where the new one is located. I am aware that some students have yet to receive their room keys. This is probably because you have not provided us with your proof of payment and identity card yet. Please don't worry though; I can assure you that there are enough rooms for everybody.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些需要在校内找住处的人，你可以去住宿办公室。请注意，我们已经关闭了校园花园正西边的旧办公室，因为它太小了。咖啡馆旁边的那栋较大的建筑是新办公室的所在地。我知道有些学生还没有收到房间钥匙。这可能是因为你们还没有提供付款证明和身份证。不过请别担心；我可以向你们保证有足够的房间给每个人。

transcriptBlocks.english: The students' dormitory is on the south side of the campus, and it is, of course, where you would be residing throughout your stay. Each room is equipped to accommodate two students. The kitchen space is shared, but you do have a shower for yourselves. After you move in, you will have to talk to the designated manager of your dormitory building before using any of the facilities in the basement, including washing machines and dryers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 学生宿舍在校园南侧，当然，这就是你们在整个学习期间居住的地方。每个房间可容纳两名学生。厨房空间是共用的，但你们有自己的淋浴。搬进去后，在使用地下室的任何设施之前，包括洗衣机和烘干机，你们需要先与宿舍楼的指定管理员沟通。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have signed up for our school meal program, please listen up. In order to prevent any mix-ups when distributing meals, most of our food containers will be marked with each student's name. If the labeling isn't done correctly on yours, please let us know in time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你已经报名参加了我们的学校餐食计划，请注意听。为了防止分发餐食时出现混淆，我们的大多数食品容器都会标上每个学生的名字。如果你的标签没有正确标记，请及时告诉我们。

transcriptBlocks.english: You should be aware that last semester we had some incidents involving theft in the dorms. As such, we've implemented some new policies this year to upgrade our security services. Every student will be provided with an access code, without which they cannot enter their rooms. Please don't share it with anyone. If you want to renew its validity, you'll need to check your portal page and find the button under the tab 'on-campus dormitory'. We hope that this new system should limit the number of thefts this year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你应该知道上学期宿舍发生了一些盗窃事件。因此，我们今年实施了一些新政策来升级我们的安全服务。每个学生都会获得一个门禁密码，没有它就不能进入房间。请不要与任何人分享。如果你想更新其有效期，你需要查看你的门户页面，在"校内宿舍"标签下找到按钮。我们希望这个新系统能减少今年的盗窃数量。

transcriptBlocks.english: Finally, I'd like to talk briefly about campus rules. It is expected that all gadgets and appliances are switched off after the lights are out, which happens at 11.30 pm. Most students' bedtime is around 11 pm, so please keep to this time and respect others' need for quiet. We take this quite seriously and are quite strict. Any gadgets that are seized for breaking this rule won't be returned until the end of the semester.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后，我想简要谈谈校园规则。所有小设备和电器都应在晚上11：30熄灯后关闭。大多数学生的就寝时间在晚上11点左右，所以请遵守这个时间，尊重他人对安静的需求。我们对此非常认真和严格。任何因违反此规定而被没收的设备，要到学期结束才能归还。

records.title: UK Driving Licence and Road Conditions

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, I'm Edward and I'm here to tell you about road conditions in various areas of the UK. I am also going to tell you about driver's licences in the UK.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好，我是爱德华，我在这里要告诉大家英国不同地区的道路状况。我还要告诉大家关于英国驾驶执照的信息。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have never had a driver's licence, or you have one from another country and you want to get a UK licence, you must be a UK resident. You will need to show a medical report when your UK licence needs to be renewed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你从未拥有过驾驶执照，或者你有一张其他国家的驾照并想获得英国驾照，你必须是在英国居住的人。当你的英国驾照需要更新时，你需要出示一份体检报告。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you are trying to translate your original foreign driving licence to apply for a UK licence which is a must if you want to be able to drive here, you will need to visit an official agency. These are scattered throughout the London area and are well-equipped to assist you with any questions you might have, and any services they offer are included in your licence fee.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你想翻译你的原始外国驾照来申请英国驾照——如果你想在这里开车，这是必须的——你需要去一家官方机构。这些机构遍布伦敦地区，设备齐全，可以帮助你解决任何问题，而且他们提供的任何服务都包含在你的驾照费用中。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you already have a translated licence, but need some personal information updating, you do not need to pay for the update---they'll do it for free.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你已经有翻译后的驾照，但需要更新一些个人信息，你不需要为更新付费——他们会免费为你做。

transcriptBlocks.english: When you are getting a new driving licence, you may need to have a new photo taken, as some photos are rejected. It's actually okay if your photo is too small, since we can get it enlarged with our printer. The majority of rejected photos are the ones that were taken with a cream backdrop instead of a monotone grey background. We've now found that photos with the latter allow us to identify the licence holder much more easily. If you were wearing glasses on the previous photo, you don't need to worry about it since it is still allowed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当你获得新驾照时，你可能需要拍一张新照片，因为有些照片会被拒绝。如果你的照片太小，实际上也没关系，因为我们可以用打印机放大。大多数被拒绝的照片是在奶油色背景而不是单调的灰色背景下拍摄的。我们现在发现，后一种背景的照片让我们更容易识别执照持有人。如果你在之前的照片中戴着眼镜，你不需要担心，因为仍然是允许的。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you are not sure whether your previous licence is still valid, then the licence checking service is for you. The procedures are quite clear and you just have to follow them. Ideally, I would like to see the process going faster since it can take hours to finish. From my standpoint, it will help if all the applicants bring the necessary identification with them. Then all they have to do is just fill in the forms accordingly, step by step.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你不确定你之前的驾照是否仍然有效，那么驾照核查服务适合你。程序非常清楚，你只需要遵循它们。理想情况下，我希望看到流程更快，因为它可能需要几个小时才能完成。从我的角度来看，如果所有申请人都带上必要的身份证件会有所帮助。然后他们只需要按照步骤填写相应的表格。

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm often asked whether I have a personal recommendation about the fastest or cheapest place to get all this done, but I think it really depends on where you are. They can all get busy at some point and when it is quiet at one branch it may be busy in another, so take your pick. All I would say is that there is absolutely no difference in price---it's a standard fee. The only advice I would give is that the quickest way to complete an application is to fill out the form on the internet and then bring a print copy with you to the agency location of your choice.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我经常被问到是否有个人推荐，哪里最快或最便宜可以完成这一切，但我认为这真的取决于你在哪里。它们都可能在某个时间点很忙，当一个分店很安静时，另一个分店可能很忙，所以你自己选择。我只能说价格绝对没有区别——这是标准费用。我唯一能给出的建议是，完成申请最快的方法是在网上填写表格，然后打印一份带到你选择的机构。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, people frequently ask me what I think of the road conditions in some of our cities. London is obviously the biggest and busiest, and there are lots of parking restrictions, one way systems, and so on, but on the whole, I find the traffic signs are very clear. In Edinburgh, most people use digital maps to get to know local traffic and road conditions, which can be estimated through different traffic flow lines. It is a city of lights---traffic lights---but they're extremely efficient as they're timed perfectly to get the traffic flowing smoothly. That's important because pedestrian areas and crossings are always packed with people on foot, which needs strong regulation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来，人们经常问我对我们一些城市的道路状况的看法。伦敦显然最大、最繁忙，有很多停车限制、单行道等等，但总的来说，我觉得交通标志非常清晰。在爱丁堡，大多数人使用数字地图来了解当地交通和道路状况，这可以通过不同的交通流量线来估计。这是一个充满灯光——交通信号灯——的城市，但它们非常高效，因为它们的计时完美，能让交通顺畅流动。这很重要，因为步行区和人行横道总是挤满了步行的人，需要强有力的监管。

transcriptBlocks.english: The city of Cardiff has tackled traffic flow in a different way. It recently completed a road expansion scheme and the extra lanes of the dual-carriageway are easing congestion. It's a similar story in Manchester, instead of going through the town center, most vehicles choose ring-roads so as to avoid the downtown congestion. It can still happen, though, so there's a possibility that the city will introduce check points where the police can intervene to direct traffic at peak periods.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 加的夫市以不同的方式处理交通流量。它最近完成了一项道路扩建计划，双车道增加的额外车道正在缓解拥堵。曼彻斯特的情况类似，大多数车辆选择绕城公路而不是穿过市中心，以避免市中心拥堵。不过这种情况仍可能发生，所以该城市有可能引入检查点，警察可以在高峰时段介入指挥交通。

transcriptBlocks.english: And finally, they say all roads lead to Rome, and you could say that about Oxford. I like the many options for getting in and out of the city because drivers can always find alternative routes. The other cities in the UK are...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后，人们说条条大路通罗马，你也可以这样说牛津。我喜欢进出这座城市的众多选择，因为司机总能找到替代路线。英国的其他城市是……

transcriptBlocks.english: Good day everyone! Welcome to the Melbourne Zoo! My name's Mark, and I'd like to welcome you today.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大家好！欢迎来到墨尔本动物园！我是马克，今天欢迎大家的到来。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have a moment, I'd like to give you some information about our zoo before you enter. Please feel free to ask me any questions at the end of my talk.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们有时间，在你们进入之前我想给大家介绍一些关于我们动物园的信息。在我讲话结束后请随时提问。

transcriptBlocks.english: As you know, it's November now, and that means longer days. I have some good news for you. Anyone who hates getting up early in the morning can now enter the zoo after dinner! Because of the time of year, we are offering a two-hour mini-tour after 7 pm. Seeing the animals at a different time of day will be a fascinating experience for many of you and I encourage you to sign up. Unfortunately, due to a fire last month, we no longer allow bonfire nights. By the way, we have been planning two parties for Christmas next month, we'll post the details on our website, it should be a lot of fun.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如你们所知，现在是十一月，这意味着白天更长。我有个好消息要告诉你们。任何讨厌早起的人现在可以在晚餐后进入动物园！因为季节原因，我们在晚上7点之后提供两小时的迷你游览。在一天中不同的时间看到动物对你们中的许多人来说将是一次迷人的体验，我鼓励你们报名参加。不幸的是，由于上个月的一场火灾，我们不再允许篝火之夜。顺便说一下，我们一直在计划下个月圣诞节的两个派对，我们会把细节发布在网站上，应该会很有趣。

transcriptBlocks.english: So let me tell you a little about our residents here at the zoo. Despite what was recently reported in the media, the most popular animal around here is not the kangaroo or even the sheepdog. No, our star animal here is without a doubt, the koala. They are sedentary creatures and can sleep for up to twenty hours a day, so you'll have to keep an eye out for them. You should be able to spot some of them in the treetops, hiding behind branches. But, if you're lucky, you might see one run across your path.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我告诉你们一些关于我们动物园里居民的情况。尽管媒体最近有报道，但这里最受欢迎的动物不是袋鼠，甚至不是牧羊犬。不，我们这里的明星动物毫无疑问是考拉。它们是久坐不动的动物，每天可以睡长达二十个小时，所以你们要留意它们。你们应该能在树梢上看到一些，躲在树枝后面。但如果幸运的话，你们可能会看到一只跑过你们的路。

transcriptBlocks.english: Of course, we do have kangaroos. They are truly fascinating creatures. It might interest you to know that they are the only large animals that use hopping as a means of locomotion. They are generally very friendly, and while we have no problems with people feeding them, we always tell our guests that it's important to stand with an upright posture when giving them food. The kangaroos may interpret you bending over as a sign of aggression, so please be careful. Also, no matter how cute the babies are, any physical contact should be avoided. The adults are quite protective of their young while they are still in the pouch, so please refrain from the urge to give them a pat. They aren't greedy animals, and will generally stop eating once they are full. So, if you have some extra food, you might need to find another one to feed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，我们确实有袋鼠。它们确实是迷人的生物。你们可能感兴趣的是，它们是唯一使用跳跃作为运动方式的大型动物。它们通常非常友好，虽然我们不反对人们喂食它们，但我们总是告诉客人，在给它们食物时保持直立的姿势很重要。袋鼠可能会把你弯腰理解为攻击的迹象，所以请小心。此外，无论小袋鼠有多可爱，都应避免任何身体接触。成年袋鼠在幼崽还在育儿袋里时非常保护它们，所以请克制住想要拍它们的冲动。它们不是贪婪的动物，一旦吃饱了一般就会停止进食。所以，如果你有多余的食物，你可能需要找另一只来喂。

transcriptBlocks.english: As you may have heard, our wild dog pen is temporarily closed, but it should reopen soon. You'll be happy to know that our dogs are all fine and in good health, and I think they are quite excited about their new home. Right now, we are fixing the fences. They are wild animals after all, and we need to consider public safety before opening the exhibit. But please come back to see them when we are finished.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 正如你们可能听说的，我们的野狗围栏暂时关闭了，但应该很快就会重新开放。你们会很高兴知道我们的狗都很好，身体健康，我想它们对新家相当兴奋。现在，我们正在修理围栏。毕竟它们是野生动物，在开放展区之前我们需要考虑公共安全。但请在我们完成后回来看它们。

transcriptBlocks.english: Speaking of return visits. If you enjoy our zoo and want to come back, you may be interested in getting a discount ticket. We used to sell them at the entrance of the zoo as well as on our website, but the website is currently under maintenance, so the coupons are available only at the café near the gift shop for this year. So, if you're interested, make your way over there once you are ready. Be informed, there are a lot of tourists around today, so the earlier, the better.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 说到再次参观。如果你们喜欢我们的动物园并想再来，你们可能会对购买折扣票感兴趣。我们过去在动物园入口和网站上出售，但网站目前正在维护，所以今年的优惠券只在礼品店附近的咖啡馆有售。所以，如果你们感兴趣，准备好后就过去那里。告诉你们，今天有很多游客，所以越早越好。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now, if I can bring your attention to the map of our zoo, I'll provide a brief description of the grounds so that no one gets lost. If you'd like to see some of our animals up close, then you should visit one of our shows in the Arena. We have a show every half hour, so you're sure to see something. We are at the entrance, to get there, cross the bridge and go straight to the end of the path and you'll find it to your right.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在，请你们注意看我们动物园的地图，我会简要介绍一下场地，这样就不会有人迷路了。如果你们想近距离观看我们的动物，你们应该去竞技场观看我们的表演之一。我们每半小时就有一场表演，所以你们肯定能看到一些东西。我们在入口处，要去那里，过桥后直走到小路的尽头，你们会在右手边找到它。

transcriptBlocks.english: For those who are looking for a quieter place to learn about the history of our zoo, in the north of the zoo, we have an educational hall ready for you. It's easy to find, just to the west of the toilets.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些想找个安静地方了解我们动物园历史的人，在动物园北边，我们有一个教育展厅为你们准备好了。它很容易找到，就在厕所的西边。

transcriptBlocks.english: With such beautiful weather right now, I know many of you would love to spend the afternoon having a picnic. There is a great spot for you in the zoo. It's the area surrounding the botanic garden and it's also facing the river. The view is fantastic there! Some of you may recall that our photo printing site was in the northeastern corner of the zoo. It has now been moved to the building next to the bridge. Finally, I'm sure you've noticed that it's quite warm today. If you are not up for walking, don't worry. We have bike sheds at different locations across the zoo and the bikes are free for our guests, so just grab one and take it for a ride. Once you've got your bike, it's only a 5-minute ride to the gift shop and the exit is just beside it. You can't miss it. Please note that cycling is only permitted on the designated paths.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在天气这么好，我知道你们很多人都想花一个下午去野餐。动物园里有一个很棒的野餐地点。那是植物园周围的区域，也面向河流。那里的景色太棒了！你们有些人可能还记得我们的照片打印点以前在动物园的东北角。现在它已经搬到了桥旁边的建筑里。最后，我相信你们已经注意到了今天相当暖和。如果你们不想走路，别担心。我们在动物园的不同地点都有自行车棚，自行车对客人是免费的，所以随便骑一辆去兜风吧。一旦你们拿到自行车，骑到礼品店只需5分钟，出口就在它旁边。你们不会错过的。请注意，只允许在指定路径上骑自行车。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, that's the end of my talk. I hope you have a great time visiting all the animals. Take as many pictures as you like, and don't forget to share them with your friends. Now, does anyone have any questions?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好了，我的讲话到此结束。祝你们参观所有动物愉快。尽情拍照，别忘了和朋友们分享。现在，有人有问题吗？

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. My name is Cathy Clinton, a guide from Fun Travels Agency. I'm delighted to welcome you to our company, and I'm pleased to have the chance to tell you about the camping trip we will be going on this weekend.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。我叫凯西·克林顿，是欢乐旅行社的导游。我很高兴欢迎你们来到我们公司，也很高兴有机会告诉你们我们这周末将要去露营旅行。

transcriptBlocks.english: Please listen carefully. You don't want to miss the important information. You can't make the most of the trip if you do.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 请仔细听。你们不想错过重要信息。如果错过了，你们就无法充分利用这次旅行。

transcriptBlocks.english: As we are going camping, a tent is very important. You don't want to sleep outside in the wild, do you? Our company will not be providing tents. So it's very important for you to bring your own.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 因为我们要去露营，帐篷非常重要。你们不想睡在野外吧？我们公司不提供帐篷。所以你们自己带帐篷非常重要。

transcriptBlocks.english: We will be camping in the Rock Hill camp site, a very beautiful place where you can see snowcapped mountains, green trees and a breathtaking lake. Every year, many old customers sign up for the camping trip again and again because of the scenery. We will book the camp before we go. We are a long-term partner with the site, so they arrange various activities for our customers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们将在石山露营地露营，那是一个非常美丽的地方，可以看到白雪皑皑的山脉、绿树和令人叹为观止的湖泊。每年，许多老客户因为风景一次又一次地报名参加露营旅行。我们会在出发前预订营地。我们是该营地的长期合作伙伴，所以他们为我们的客户安排各种活动。

transcriptBlocks.english: The roads in the forests are amazing. If you are a cycling fan, you can bring your own bikes. It's a good chance for you to enjoy the fresh air and good view. You can just go for a walk if you don't want to cycle. Either way, you will be amazed.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 森林里的道路很棒。如果你是骑行爱好者，你可以自带自行车。这是享受新鲜空气和美景的好机会。如果你不想骑车，也可以散步。无论哪种方式，你都会感到惊喜。

transcriptBlocks.english: Another special thing about this place is that there is a railway track just for the visitors. We will book the tickets for you, so all you have to do is enjoy the landscape around you. It's like traveling in a fairyland. I've taken the train many times, but what I see on it never fails to surprise me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这个地方的另一个特别之处是有一条专门为游客修建的铁路轨道。我们会为你们订票，所以你们只需要享受周围的风景。就像在仙境中旅行。我坐过很多次火车，但我在火车上看到的景色从未让我失望。

transcriptBlocks.english: You may think that the place is totally disconnected to the outside world. Actually, it's just a few miles from the nearby town. Located in the mountains, the town itself is a beautiful place to visit. There will be a football match every Saturday, the local team was one of the best in our area. It's your choice to see it or not. But I promise you it would be worth the price of the ticket.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们可能认为这个地方与外界完全隔绝。实际上，它离附近的小镇只有几英里。这个小镇坐落在山中，本身就是一个美丽的游览地。每周六都有一场足球比赛，当地球队是我们地区最好的球队之一。看不看由你们自己选择。但我向你们保证，这值得门票的价格。

transcriptBlocks.english: Of course, there will be different activities at different times of the year, we will collect all the useful information and print you a booklet, so you will not miss anything fun.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，一年中的不同时间会有不同的活动，我们会收集所有有用的信息，为你们印一本小册子，这样你们就不会错过任何有趣的事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: There are usually four destinations we must go to, because each of them has its unique features. In Capefield, you can visit a museum where you can learn different farming practices. You will see different tools for agriculture. I know most of you are from the city. So it's a wonderful chance to see how the food we eat is produced.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 通常有四个我们必须去的目的地，因为每个都有其独特的特色。在凯普菲尔德，你可以参观一个博物馆，在那里你可以了解不同的农耕方式。你会看到不同的农具。我知道你们大多数来自城市。所以这是一个了解我们吃的食物是如何生产的绝佳机会。

transcriptBlocks.english: In Milton, we will take you to a local market. They sell beautiful silk clothes there. You can't buy them in an ordinary shopping mall, because they were all handmade in the local workshops. You can feel the quality with your hands when you go there. I always buy one or two outfits for my friends when I go.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在米尔顿，我们会带你们去当地市场。那里出售漂亮的丝绸衣服。你们在普通购物中心买不到，因为它们都是当地作坊手工制作的。你们去那里时可以亲手感受质量。我去的时候总是给朋友们买一两件。

transcriptBlocks.english: Speaking of Wellington, what you will find is all kinds of food that are produced locally, like sausages and bacon. They only use organic ingredients. You can try first before you buy, so you won't have to worry about buying something you regret. All the recipes are local. It's not likely to see anything quite like these products in other places.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 说到惠灵顿，你会发现各种当地生产的食物，比如香肠和培根。他们只使用有机食材。你可以先尝后买，所以不用担心买到后悔的东西。所有食谱都是当地的。在其他地方不太可能看到类似的产品。

transcriptBlocks.english: In Landywood, there is a transport museum displaying many old vehicles. And there's a steam train which you can now only see in the movies. It's a great way for us to learn about our past.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在兰迪伍德，有一个交通博物馆，展示了许多旧车辆。还有一辆蒸汽火车，现在你只能在电影里看到。这是我们了解过去的好方式。

transcriptBlocks.english: So that's the basic plan for our trip. More details will be provided in our booklets. Now, if you have any questions, please...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这就是我们旅行的基本计划。更多细节将在我们的小册子中提供。现在，如果你们有任何问题，请……

records.title: Green Vale Camp Site Introduction

transcriptBlocks.english: Welcome to Green Vale Camp Site. It's been only 2 weeks since the opening day of our camp site, so you are among our first visitors. Our site occupies an area of around 500 hectares and we have lots of interesting activities. I'm sure you and your children will have a wonderful time here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 欢迎来到格林维尔露营地。我们的露营地开放才两周，所以你们是我们的第一批游客。我们的营地占地约500公顷，我们有很多有趣的活动。我相信你们和你们的孩子会在这里度过美好的时光。

transcriptBlocks.english: Let's start by seeing what you can do at our site. I hope you can listen carefully, so you don't miss any good places the site has to offer.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 让我们先看看你们可以在我们的营地做些什么。我希望你们认真听，这样就不会错过营地提供的任何好地方。

transcriptBlocks.english: As I can see, many of you have brought your children here. There are many activities for children. We all know children like to run around, and we have many families here today, children might get lost. But you don't have to worry, we have staff members at different spots at the camp to make sure all lost children will be sent to the stage. So, you can go and find your children there. And if you see kids who are wandering around and look like they are lost, please help us lead them there too.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 正如我所看到的，你们中的许多人带了孩子来。有很多适合孩子的活动。我们都知道孩子们喜欢跑来跑去，今天这里有很多家庭，孩子们可能会走丢。但你们不必担心，我们在营地的不同地点都有工作人员，确保所有走失的孩子都会被送到舞台那里。所以，你们可以去那里找到你们的孩子。如果你们看到有孩子四处闲逛，看起来迷路了，也请帮我们带他们去那里。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you want to hear some live music, you can go to West Field. Some local bands will be performing their new songs there. A couple of them have won awards at the national competition last year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们想听现场音乐，可以去西场。一些当地乐队会在那里表演他们的新歌。其中几个乐队去年在全国比赛中获奖了。

transcriptBlocks.english: Then there's green lounge, a place to relax, as there are tables and chairs. It also offers a wide variety of food, including burgers and pizzas, with a taste that has been highly praised by previous visitors.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 然后还有绿色休息室，一个放松的地方，有桌子和椅子。它还提供各种各样的食物，包括汉堡和比萨，味道受到了以前游客的高度赞扬。

transcriptBlocks.english: Riverside is a beautiful area for a walk, and at 5 pm, we play some new movies. Today we will be playing a comedy. You and your children can sit on the grass and enjoy.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 河边是一个散步的好地方，下午5点我们播放一些新电影。今天我们将播放一部喜剧。你们和你们的孩子可以坐在草地上欣赏。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, it's the gateway, where children can have a lot of fun. There are swings and slides. They can keep your children busy for hours. Then you can take a break and do something on your own.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来是入口区，孩子们可以在那里玩得很开心。有秋千和滑梯。它们可以让你们的孩子忙上几个小时。然后你们可以休息一下，自己做点什么。

transcriptBlocks.english: Alright, let me provide you with details about the locations of some important spots at our site.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，让我给你们提供我们营地一些重要地点的位置详情。

transcriptBlocks.english: Firstly, we are currently at the entrance. If you proceed straight ahead on Royal Way and turn left at the first crossing, you will find yourself on Green Street, where you will see a large area with tents, known as Meadow Campsite. This campsite is available for overnight stays.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 首先，我们目前在入口处。如果你们沿着皇家大道直走，在第一个路口左转，你们会发现自己到了格林街，在那里你们会看到一大片有帐篷的区域，叫做草地露营地。这个露营地可供过夜。

transcriptBlocks.english: For those interested in handpicking fresh vegetables, we have the Veggie Garden located at the corner of Royal Way and Green Street, diagonally opposite the camping area.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于那些有兴趣亲手采摘新鲜蔬菜的人，我们有蔬菜园，位于皇家大道和格林街的拐角处，与露营区斜对面。

transcriptBlocks.english: Continuing along Royal Way, you will come across the toilet on your left, and opposite it is Caravan Park, a beautiful park where you can even go boating on the artificial lake.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 沿着皇家大道继续走，你们会在左手边看到厕所，对面是大篷车公园，一个美丽的公园，你们甚至可以在人工湖上划船。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you require access to cash, the cash point is situated to the north of the park. You'll see several ATM machines there.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们需要取现金，取款点位于公园北边。你们会在那里看到几台ATM机。

transcriptBlocks.english: In terms of dining options, I highly recommend the Green Lounge, which I mentioned earlier. It is located close to the western end of Hillside Road. For those seeking a more upscale dining experience, I suggest trying Sam's Restaurant. Simply walk back to Green Street, pass the Veggie Garden and the bridge, and you will find it on your right.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在餐饮选择方面，我强烈推荐我之前提到的绿色休息室。它位于山坡路西端附近。对于那些寻求更高档用餐体验的人，我建议试试山姆餐厅。只需走回格林街，经过蔬菜园和桥，你们会在右手边找到它。

transcriptBlocks.english: Additionally, there is a pharmacy on-site, situated to the east of Hillside Road, approximately 300 meters ahead on the right-hand side.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，现场还有一家药店，位于山坡路以东，大约前方300米的右手边。

transcriptBlocks.english: All of these locations are open for your exploration, but please exercise caution, especially when near water, and be mindful of the environment during your visit.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 所有这些地点都对你们开放探索，但请小心谨慎，尤其是靠近水的时候，并在参观期间注意环境。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you have any questions you can see me at the information office, right here at the entrance. I hope you enjoy your day here.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们有任何问题，可以在信息办公室找到我，就在入口这里。希望你们在这里度过愉快的一天。

records.audioSourceFile: Section2 - Green Vale Camp Site Introduction.mp3

transcriptBlocks.english: Welcome to Bluebay Pier Museum. You are very lucky because we have another important guest in our harbor today---Ship Lutte. Let me first give you a brief introduction of this famous ship before you can get a closer look at it by yourselves.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 欢迎来到蓝湾码头博物馆。你们非常幸运，因为今天我们的港口有另一位重要的客人——卢特号船。在你们亲自近距离参观之前，让我先简要介绍一下这艘著名的船。

transcriptBlocks.english: Lutte was born in 1889 in Victoria, England with its main part of the ship carved from a big piece of log. It was called Felli at first and was renamed Lutte in 1896. Originally, the ship had only 2 sails, and another one was added in the year 1901.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卢特号于1889年在英格兰维多利亚诞生，船的主体部分是用一大块原木雕刻而成的。它最初被称为费利号，1896年改名为卢特号。最初，这艘船只有2面帆，1901年又增加了一面。

transcriptBlocks.english: The ship was purchased by a businessman named John Richardson. In 1913, John set out on this ship and traveled to Fiji, a beautiful island in the Pacific Ocean. Even though his original plan was to travel around the world, he was not able to finish the trip. The ship had a series of voyages after that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这艘船被一位名叫约翰·理查森的商人买下。1913年，约翰乘坐这艘船出发，前往太平洋上美丽的斐济岛。尽管他最初的计划是环游世界，但他没能完成这次旅行。之后这艘船进行了一系列航行。

transcriptBlocks.english: In the year 1918, the ship lost an instrument for measuring speed, which caused trouble to a trip. Thankfully, the sailor used navigation skills and arrived at the destination even before the schedule.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 1918年，这艘船丢失了一个测量速度的仪器，给一次航行带来了麻烦。幸运的是，水手运用了航海技能，甚至提前到达了目的地。

transcriptBlocks.english: Many people have heard of the amazing stories of the ship. People in London even asked to see it. So Lutte stopped in London and was warmly welcomed by people there. So we can see the ship had been popular for so long. But the ship is quite old now and some of its parts are broken, so our exhibition today is to raise funds to fix it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 许多人听说过这艘船的传奇故事。伦敦人甚至要求参观它。所以卢特号停靠在伦敦，受到了当地人的热烈欢迎。所以我们能看出这艘船已经受欢迎了这么久。但现在这艘船已经很旧了，有些部件损坏了，所以我们今天的展览是为了筹集资金修复它。

transcriptBlocks.english: Lutte was retired in the 1930s. After sailing for many decades, the ship finally had to finish its service. On his last trip, Lutte was taken to its original place from Brighton. And it remained in Victoria for many years. People thought it would revisit London, but this didn't happen.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卢特号在20世纪30年代退役。在航行了几十年后，这艘船终于结束了它的服役。在最后一次航行中，卢特号从布赖顿被带回它的原始地点。它在维多利亚停留了很多年。人们以为它会再次访问伦敦，但这没有发生。

transcriptBlocks.english: The museum is quite large. And you can try different activities in different parts. Now let me introduce to you some of the most popular spots.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 博物馆相当大。你们可以在不同区域尝试不同的活动。现在让我给你们介绍一些最受欢迎的地点。

transcriptBlocks.english: First, there is Tiny Cabin. It's where you can give it a try on steering the boat. I'm sure many of you can't wait to do it. Please sign up at the entrance and stand in a line for it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 首先是小船舱。在那里你们可以尝试驾驶船只。我相信你们很多人都迫不及待地想试试。请在入口处报名并排队等候。

transcriptBlocks.english: Another spot I'm going to tell you is Wood Deck. You can get a good view from up there, with the ocean right in front of you. If you are lucky, you will encounter marine mammals like dolphins or even whales. But be careful and make sure you cling to the rails. The ship might be a little bumpy because of the waves.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我要告诉你们的另一个地方是木质甲板。你们可以从上面欣赏美景，海洋就在你们面前。如果幸运的话，你们会遇到海豚甚至鲸鱼等海洋哺乳动物。但要小心，确保抓紧栏杆。由于海浪，船可能会有点颠簸。

transcriptBlocks.english: The next place is called Water Edge. If you want to go out to the sea, you can board our boats and vessels from there. You will have to pay extra fee for that. Our staff will provide life jackets. And if you are hungry, we have cooked fish for you, you just have to go to a place named Sandy Shore. The fish is really good. You can also watch birds there, since there're a lot of seagulls there most of the time. We don't recommend you to feed those birds though. Some human food might be harmful for them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 下一个地方叫做水边。如果你们想出海，可以从那里登上我们的船只。那需要额外付费。我们的工作人员会提供救生衣。如果你们饿了，我们为你们准备了煮鱼，你们只需去一个叫沙岸的地方。鱼真的很好。你们也可以在那里观鸟，因为那里大部分时间都有很多海鸥。不过我们不建议你们喂那些鸟。有些人类食物可能对它们有害。

transcriptBlocks.english: The last place is Rock Pool, where there are a lot of big rocks. And on these rocks, you can find words about marine history. There are a lot of interesting stories and tales about marine world. I believe most of you are here because you are interested in the ocean. So it's a great place for you to gain new knowledge about it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后一个地方是岩石池，那里有很多大岩石。在这些岩石上，你们可以找到关于海洋历史的文字。有很多关于海洋世界的有趣故事和传说。我相信你们大多数人来到这里是因为对海洋感兴趣。所以这是你们获得新知识的好地方。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, these are some of the activities you can do during our ship exhibition. Please follow my coworker Sandy to the...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 所以，这些是你们在船舶展览期间可以参加的一些活动。请跟随我的同事桑迪去……

transcriptBlocks.english: Dear passengers, welcome to Fitchton Railway Station.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 亲爱的旅客们，欢迎来到菲奇顿火车站。

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm sorry to inform you that the train to London is delayed. It will take off two hours later at 11:45am. Please accept our apologies.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 很抱歉通知你们，前往伦敦的火车晚点了。它将在两小时后的上午11：45出发。请接受我们的歉意。

transcriptBlocks.english: In the meantime, allow me to introduce Fitchton Railway Station, so you can make the most of your time while waiting for the train.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 与此同时，请允许我介绍一下菲奇顿火车站，这样你们可以在等车时充分利用时间。

transcriptBlocks.english: The main entrance of the station is on Fitchton Road. If you want to take a bike ride around here, walk down Fitchton Road and pass the taxi stop, you can find a bike rack on the right. But if you just want to stay in the station, it's OK. You can find a luggage locker when you enter the station, it's on the left. You can put your luggage there.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 车站的主入口在菲奇顿路。如果你们想在这里骑自行车，沿着菲奇顿路走，经过出租车站，你们可以在右边找到自行车架。但如果你们只想待在车站里，也行。你们进站后可以在左边找到行李储物柜。你们可以把行李放在那里。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you don't feel very well or you need to buy some medicine, there's a chemist's in the farthest corner of the station, opposite to the café. And, you can have a cup of coffee at the café if you want. The big area near the café is the waiting room where you can have a seat and relax.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们感觉不舒服或需要买药，车站最远的角落有一家药店，在咖啡馆对面。而且，你们如果想喝咖啡，可以去咖啡馆。咖啡馆附近的大区域是候车室，你们可以坐下来休息。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you want to use the toilet, make a left when you enter the station, then turn right, go straight until you walk past platform 2, it's right there at the end.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们想上厕所，进站后左转，然后右转，直走直到经过2号站台，它就在尽头。

transcriptBlocks.english: The news agency is in the southeast corner of the station.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 报刊亭在车站的东南角。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you don't want to stay in the station, you can also have a look around the station, but make sure to get back in time for the train, I'm sure you don't want to miss it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们不想待在车站里，也可以在车站周围看看，但一定要及时赶回来赶火车，我相信你们不想错过它。

transcriptBlocks.english: The Fitchton College is within walking distance from the station, the view is quite good there. The town library is also just down the road if you want to read, oh, there's also an art exhibition at the moment, you can go and check it out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 菲奇顿学院离车站步行可达，那里的景色相当不错。镇图书馆也在前面不远处，如果你们想阅读的话，哦，现在还有一个艺术展览，你们可以去看看。

transcriptBlocks.english: The store across the street opens throughout the day, and you can find all kinds of stuff there. You don't want to buy any gifts for your friends there though, most items would be difficult to carry on a bike. But our local food is something I recommend, it would be too late if you want them once you are on the train, you can buy some at the Foodie's shop, which is right next to the station.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 街对面的商店全天营业，你们可以在那里找到各种各样的东西。不过你们不想在那里给朋友买礼物，因为大多数物品用自行车携带不太方便。但我们的当地食物是我推荐的，一旦你们上了火车再想要就太晚了，你们可以在车站旁边的美食店买一些。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you are looking for anything to wear during the trip, you'd better go to the department store, but I'm afraid there isn't enough time for that. You can send some postcards with local pictures on them to your friends and family. You can buy them in the community college, which is near the museum.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们想买旅行时穿的衣服，最好去百货商店，但恐怕没有足够的时间。你们可以寄一些带有当地风景的明信片给朋友和家人。你们可以在社区学院买到，就在博物馆附近。

transcriptBlocks.english: The old cinema behind the museum cannot compete against the new theater in the shopping center, so the current owner plans to make it an accommodation block instead.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 博物馆后面的旧电影院无法与购物中心的新剧院竞争，所以现在的业主计划把它改建成住宿楼。

transcriptBlocks.english: In the back of the train station, you can see a statue of Richard Travolt, a local government minister who is famous for completing a lot of construction projects in our city.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在火车站后面，你们可以看到理查德·特拉沃尔特的雕像，他是一位地方政府部长，以完成我们城市的许多建筑项目而闻名。

transcriptBlocks.english: Again, I'd like to remind you the train will leave at 11:45. Please get back in time and I hope you enjoy your time at Fitchton...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 再次提醒你们，火车将在11：45出发。请及时回来，希望你们在菲奇顿度过愉快的时光……

transcriptBlocks.english: Good afternoon. Thank you for inviting me here to share with you what I do every day and my work at the Easter Seals, an organization that helps the disabled. I hope more people can join me in what I do and make the world a better place, for everyone.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 下午好。感谢你们邀请我来这里分享我每天所做的工作，以及我在复活节封印组织——一个帮助残障人士的组织——的工作。我希望更多人能加入我所做的事情，让世界变得更美好，为了每个人。

transcriptBlocks.english: So this is how my typical day starts: I usually set my alarm at 5:30 in the morning. Then I allow myself to be lazy and stay in bed for one more hour before getting up at 6:30, because I don't like to get up too abruptly. I do some farm work in the morning, like watering the vegetables. I also prepare breakfast for the disabled children and take it to work later on. But before all that, I cook breakfast for my son first. I do the rest after I see him off at the station for school bus.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 这就是我典型的一天是如何开始的：我通常在早上5：30设闹钟。然后我允许自己懒散一下，在床上多待一个小时，6：30起床，因为我不喜欢起得太突然。我早上做一些农活，比如给蔬菜浇水。我还为残障儿童准备早餐，之后带去工作。但在所有这些之前，我先为我儿子做早餐。送他到车站坐校车后我再做剩下的事。

transcriptBlocks.english: Then I go to Easter Seals, the organization which I work for. And that is the most important thing for me, helping the disabled. I feel it's very meaningful and rewarding helping people in need. And I'm not alone. There are 40 helpers in total. Among them, 30 are women. We work full time at the organization and take turns working day and night shifts. Sometimes there's too much work, and that keeps us extremely busy. Thankfully, we have 15 volunteers plus 10 new volunteers who work at our organization regularly. They help us a lot with everything. I truly hope more warm-hearted people from our neighborhood can use some of their spare time to take part in helping people with disability.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 然后我去复活节封印组织，我工作的地方。对我来说最重要的是帮助残障人士。我觉得帮助需要帮助的人非常有意义和有回报。我并不孤单。总共有40名帮助者。其中30名是女性。我们在组织里全职工作，轮流上白班和夜班。有时工作量太大，让我们极其忙碌。幸运的是，我们有15名志愿者加上10名新志愿者定期在我们的组织工作。他们在各方面帮了我们很多。我真的希望我们社区更多热心人能利用一些业余时间参与帮助残障人士。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, what do we do exactly? You may wonder. I think the public needs a better understanding of the responsibility and content of our work. They know there are people out there who give a helping hand, but they don't have a clear picture. I'll introduce some of the things we do.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，我们到底做什么呢？你们可能会问。我认为公众需要更好地了解我们工作的责任和内容。他们知道有人在伸出援手，但没有清晰的画面。我来介绍一下我们所做的一些事情。

transcriptBlocks.english: We need to carry on a correspondence with the public by sending and replying to emails. This is a part of my job that I don't mind. I just take about an hour a day checking the mailbox. I hope more people could offer good suggestions to us by sending us emails.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们需要通过发送和回复邮件与公众保持通信。这是我工作中不介意的一部分。我每天只花大约一小时查看邮箱。我希望更多人能通过给我们发邮件提供好的建议。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sometimes we need to go out on the street and set up a stand to raise funds. This is something that I hate because I'm kind of shy. Ever since I was young, I've always been afraid to attract too much attention from people around me. So I try to ask coworkers to cover for me.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有时我们需要上街设摊筹款。这是我不喜欢的事情，因为我有点害羞。从小我就害怕引起周围人太多的注意。所以我尽量请同事代劳。

transcriptBlocks.english: Then, we call the helpers on a daily basis, telling them what's going on with the disabled people and share our stories. I love doing this, because it's nice to talk to these warmhearted people and invite more people to participate in our meaningful work. It's actually why I do this job.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 然后，我们每天给帮助者打电话，告诉他们残障人士的情况，分享我们的故事。我喜欢做这件事，因为和这些热心人交谈并邀请更多人参与我们有意义的工作是件好事。这实际上是我做这份工作的原因。

transcriptBlocks.english: Well, let's see, what else? We organize accounting files. To be honest, I'm not good at numbers, and I find that really boring. I think technology will take care of this work in the future.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 嗯，让我们想想，还有什么？我们整理会计文件。说实话，我不擅长数字，我觉得那真的很无聊。我认为未来技术会处理这项工作。

transcriptBlocks.english: Though our work has been quite successful, there are still improvements which should be made in order to better help the disabled people. Of course, nothing is perfect. Right?
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 虽然我们的工作相当成功，但为了更好地帮助残障人士，仍有一些改进需要做。当然，没有什么是完美的。对吧？

transcriptBlocks.english: Every day, we received a lot of donations from the public. We have had some technicians take care of equipment and facilities. However, the methods we use, including the one I mentioned--setting up stands on the street - are not very effective. Moreover, some of the staff at the organization are not skilled enough, especially the volunteer. We should offer more training sessions to them. I'm sure most of the staff are aware of the difficulties the disabled are experiencing, but we still need to be more professional if we want to achieve more in the work.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 每天，我们收到很多公众的捐款。我们有一些技术人员负责设备和设施。然而，我们使用的方法，包括我提到的——在街上设摊——并不是很有效。此外，组织里的一些员工技能不够，尤其是志愿者。我们应该为他们提供更多的培训课程。我相信大多数员工都了解残障人士所经历的困难，但如果我们要在工作中取得更多成就，我们仍然需要更专业。

transcriptBlocks.english: I think that's all I want to say. Please feel free to ask me any questions if you would like to know more about our organization, and if anyone of you is willing to...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我想这就是我想说的全部了。如果你们想了解更多关于我们组织的信息，请随时提问，如果你们有人愿意……

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. Thank you for inviting me here to talk at the National Tree Planting Conference. As we all know, trees play a significant role in our world. They are so common that we sometimes take them for granted.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你好。感谢邀请我来全国植树大会发言。众所周知，树木在我们的世界中扮演着重要角色。它们太常见了，我们有时会认为这是理所当然的。

transcriptBlocks.english: In many parts of the world, forests are shrinking as trees are cleared to increase the amount of land available for agriculture or construction. But our effort in making the world a greener place has been quite successful. Ever since the first Tree Planting Day, around 20 million trees have been planted in my country. And I'm sure that this number will continue to grow more rapidly in the future with our determination.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在世界许多地方，由于为了增加农业或建筑可用土地而砍伐树木，森林正在缩小。但我们在让世界变得更绿的努力方面相当成功。自从第一个植树日以来，我国已经种植了大约2000万棵树。我相信随着我们的决心，这个数字在未来将继续更快地增长。

transcriptBlocks.english: Some of you might wonder: why do we need to keep planting so many trees? Aren't there already enough of them? Can't they reproduce on their own? When we look at the advantages of tree planting, we will know why it's worth our effort.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们有些人可能会想：为什么我们需要不断种植这么多树？难道还不够吗？它们不能自己繁殖吗？当我们看看植树的好处时，就会知道为什么值得我们去努力。

transcriptBlocks.english: Trees can remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and store large quantities of carbon. In hot weather, trees can also create shade for people, animals and plants with their dense leaves, especially in tropical areas. In the more populated urban areas where there are a lot of vehicles on the roads, trees can reduce traffic noises and provide a quieter environment for the residents, because tree leaves can cut the travel of noises. And researchers have found that those who take a walk in an area with trees on a regular basis normally have a lower level of stress than those who have to walk through noisy areas every day.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 树木可以从大气中去除二氧化碳并储存大量的碳。在炎热的天气里，树木还能用茂密的树叶为人们、动物和植物提供阴凉，尤其是在热带地区。在道路上车辆较多的更人口密集的城市地区，树木可以减少交通噪音，为居民提供更安静的环境，因为树叶可以阻断噪音的传播。研究人员发现，那些定期在有树木的区域散步的人通常比那些每天必须穿过嘈杂区域的人压力水平更低。

transcriptBlocks.english: You may have heard of the theory that trees can protect a city from the serious consequences of flooding, which is true. Last year, my team and I revisited a town which used to suffer from floods during rain seasons. But this disaster didn't come back last year because the local council invested a good sum of money on tree planting in areas which were flooded frequently.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你们可能听说过树木可以保护城市免受洪水严重后果的理论，这是真的。去年，我和我的团队重新访问了一个曾经在雨季遭受洪水袭击的城镇。但去年这场灾难没有重演，因为当地议会在经常被淹的区域投入了大量资金植树。

transcriptBlocks.english: Every coin has two sides. Does tree planting have any disadvantages? There might be. During urbanization, when people transform rural areas into towns or cities, trees may cause some inconvenience for reconstruction and rebuilding if they are in the wrong places. Therefore, the right choice of their location is important before planting. This can reduce the cost of removing those unwanted trees.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 凡事都有两面性。植树有什么缺点吗？可能会有。在城市化的过程中，当人们将农村地区转变为城镇或城市时，如果树木位置不当，可能会给重建带来不便。因此，种植前正确选择位置很重要。这可以降低移除那些不需要的树木的成本。

transcriptBlocks.english: What's more, because some trees are planted in the wrong places, they might face the threats. For example, tropical trees may get diseases when planted in places where the temperature is lower. Such changes in climate can be fatal. Another threat is some local insects and pests bring diseases to these trees. And fallen leaves and branches cause clean-up costs.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 更重要的是，因为一些树木种植在错误的地方，它们可能面临威胁。例如，热带树木种植在温度较低的地方可能会生病。这种气候变化可能是致命的。另一个威胁是一些本地昆虫和害虫给这些树木带来疾病。落叶和树枝还产生清理费用。

transcriptBlocks.english: Trees always hold special significance as providing fuel and building materials. Among many others, wood has also been used to make art since ancient times. Our ancestors created sculptures of animals, humans, gods with wood. It is considered a great art material that can be used for a wide variety of projects. It is ideal for painting, sculpture and much more. There are many wood artists who have produced many great works. You can see them in many art exhibitions. These art works make you feel close to nature.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 树木作为提供燃料和建筑材料一直具有特殊意义。除此之外，木材自古以来也被用于制作艺术品。我们的祖先用木材创作了动物、人类和神灵的雕塑。它被认为是一种伟大的艺术材料，可以用于各种各样的项目。它非常适合绘画、雕塑等等。有许多木艺家创作了许多伟大的作品。你们可以在许多艺术展览中看到它们。这些艺术作品让你感觉亲近自然。

transcriptBlocks.english: We will have a display of some of these works of art at the display room later today, where you can also try making a piece of wooden art by yourself. And we are making a new publication of the history of wood art in our country. Those of you who are interested can find booklets on the shelves at the entrance of the room.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 今天晚些时候我们会在展示室展示一些这些艺术作品，你们也可以在那里尝试自己制作一件木艺品。我们正在出版一本关于我国木艺史的新出版物。感兴趣的人可以在房间入口处的架子上找到小册子。

transcriptBlocks.english: As for displays featured wildlife, we will not present it today due to some issues. So if you...
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 至于以野生动物为特色的展示，由于一些问题我们今天不会展示。所以如果你们……

records.title: New Campus of The School of Music

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello. Welcome to the Art and Heart. I'm your host-Alan Green- and this is your very own local radio program. Every Wednesday, we will put the spotlight on different art and culture facilities, which all play a very important part in enriching our life.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大家好。欢迎收听《艺术与心灵》。我是你们的主持人艾伦·格林，这是你们自己的本地电台节目。每周三，我们会聚焦不同的艺术和文化设施，它们在丰富我们生活中都扮演着非常重要的角色。

transcriptBlocks.english: And today our focus is the new campus of our city's school of music. As many of you may know, the original campus of the school, which is located between the post office and city hall, is not big enough to accommodate the increasing number of music students. Therefore, our local council built this new campus opposite to the library in the city center. It's a very good location, and it's only 2 kilometers from the old campus. Students can travel between the two campuses either by bicycle or by bus.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 今天我们的焦点是本市音乐学院的新校区。正如你们许多人所知，学校的原校区位于邮局和市政厅之间，已经不够容纳日益增多的音乐学生。因此，我们的地方议会建了这个新校区，就在市中心图书馆对面。位置非常好，离旧校区只有2公里。学生可以骑自行车或乘公交车往返两个校区。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, what does the new campus look like? It's simply beautiful! And it has 14 classrooms in total, which is 5 rooms more than the old campus. The classrooms are equipped with the latest technology in music education, including headsets and speakers. The instruments are all brand-new. I'm sure the students can really benefit from these facilities.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，新校区长什么样？简直太美了！总共有14间教室，比旧校区多了5间。教室配备了音乐教育的最新技术，包括耳机和扬声器。乐器都是全新的。我相信学生们能真正受益于这些设施。

transcriptBlocks.english: As many students drive to school, there is a big car park on the new campus. It is close to the swimming pool. Oh yes, the swimming pool is one of the best in the city. And it opens to the public on Saturdays. Near the cafeteria, there are tennis and basketball courts where students can exercise.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 由于许多学生开车上学，新校区有一个大停车场。它靠近游泳池。哦是的，游泳池是本市最好的之一。周六向公众开放。自助餐厅附近有网球场和篮球场，学生可以在那里锻炼。

transcriptBlocks.english: To get more details about the new campus, you can go to the school's website: www.playwell.co.uk. There, you will see a map of the campus as well as a lot amazing pictures. Those of you who are interested in learning music, don't forget to check it out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 要了解更多关于新校区的详细信息，你可以访问学校网站：www.playwell.co.uk。在那里，你会看到校园地图以及许多令人惊叹的图片。那些对学习音乐感兴趣的人，别忘了去看看。

transcriptBlocks.english: So, to give you some more ideas of what courses the new campus has to offer, we've developed a few programs on instruments. I'm sure there's always a good course for you! If you are interested in violin, great, because they teach all levels of it. So it doesn't matter if you are an absolute beginner or you are very proficient, you can find your place there. There are also drum classes, but if you haven't learned to play the drums before, I'm afraid it's not for you, because the school only offers lessons above level 5. Perhaps next year, there would be a class for beginners. And you can learn the third level of piano, which will be taught by a teacher who just finished her study in Europe.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 那么，为了让你们更了解新校区提供什么课程，我们开发了几个乐器课程。我相信总有一门适合你的课程！如果你对小提琴感兴趣，太好了，因为他们教授所有级别。所以无论你是完全的初学者还是非常熟练，都能找到适合你的课程。还有鼓课，但如果你以前没学过打鼓，恐怕不适合你，因为学校只提供5级以上的课程。也许明年会有初学者的课程。你可以学第三级的钢琴，将由一位刚从欧洲完成学业的老师授课。

transcriptBlocks.english: It's okay if you haven't made up your mind to take music lessons, for those of you who are interested in concerts, there is good news for you, too! There are concerts being held in June and December. In the past, concerts were only held in October. Some famous singers and bands in the country will be invited to play on stage with our local artists. So music fans, it's a great chance for you to meet and hear your favorite singers or bands, maybe you can even get an autograph.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们还没决定上音乐课也没关系，对于那些对音乐会感兴趣的人，也有好消息！六月和十二月有音乐会。过去，音乐会只在十月举行。一些国内著名歌手和乐队将被邀请与我们的本地艺术家同台演出。所以音乐爱好者们，这是你们见到和聆听你们最喜欢的歌手或乐队的绝佳机会，也许你们甚至能得到签名。

transcriptBlocks.english: Every March and May, you can be in the limelight yourself if you are interested or good at singing, because singing contests will be held in the music hall. Music lovers, don't lose the chance of winning some CDs as prizes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 每年三月和五月，如果你们感兴趣或擅长唱歌，你们可以自己成为焦点，因为音乐厅会举办歌唱比赛。音乐爱好者们，不要错过赢取一些CD作为奖品的机会。

transcriptBlocks.english: What's more, in the campus theater, there are musicals performed by students every Friday night. And it's free of charge! If you are running out of ideas of what to do, why not go and check it out with your family or friends? I bet you can enjoy yourself and learn something new at the same time.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 此外，在校区剧院，每周五晚上有学生表演的音乐剧。而且是免费的！如果你们不知道做什么，为什么不去和家人或朋友看看呢？我敢打赌你们既能享受乐趣又能学到新东西。

records.title: City Museum Speech and Visit

transcriptBlocks.english: Hello, everyone. My name is Michael Law, the general manager of the City Museum. Thank you for joining our press conference. You can ask any questions you have later, but please identify yourself and your news organization. Thanks.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 大家好。我是迈克尔·劳，市博物馆的总经理。感谢你们参加我们的新闻发布会。你们可以在之后提问任何问题，但请先表明身份和你们所在的新闻机构。谢谢。

transcriptBlocks.english: As many of you already know, our museum was founded in 1884. It is also a famous historical building in the city. Since 1928, it has been the host of this art exhibition. And this art exhibition is a yearly event, only with an exception of the year 1949, when our museum went through a big renovation.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 正如你们许多人所知，我们的博物馆成立于1884年。它也是本市一座著名的历史建筑。自1928年以来，它一直主办这个艺术展览。这个艺术展览是一年一度的活动，只有1949年例外，当时我们的博物馆进行了大翻新。

transcriptBlocks.english: Over the years, our art exhibition has enjoyed a good reputation nationwide. A growing number of visitors are coming to the exhibition every year. In the last five years, the average number of visitors has reached 12,000. Last year, the figure climbed to a higher level at 15,000. And it's expected to grow to 17,000 this year.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 多年来，我们的艺术展览在全国享有良好的声誉。每年有越来越多的参观者来到展览。在过去五年里，平均参观人数达到了12，000人。去年，这个数字攀升到15，000人。预计今年将增长到17，000人。

transcriptBlocks.english: I'm sure most of you remember the memorable speech Tom Bay delivered at last year's exhibition. During his speech, he shared his travel experiences and the beautiful scenery he had seen, especially the Nile river. He said he was amazed by the breathtaking beauty of nature, and it was even more impressive than Sahara Desert and the Andes Mountains, so he took many stunning pictures, rather than draw on canvas. It's true. His photographs were showed at his personal exhibition last year, and it was one of the most successful events we have had so far. He even published a book this year about his travel experience.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我相信你们大多数人还记得汤姆·贝去年在展览上发表的令人难忘的演讲。在演讲中，他分享了他的旅行经历和他看到的美景，尤其是尼罗河。他说他对大自然的惊人美丽感到惊叹，甚至比撒哈拉沙漠和安第斯山脉更令人印象深刻，所以他拍了很多令人惊叹的照片，而不是在画布上作画。这是真的。他的照片去年在他的个人展览上展出，这是我们迄今为止最成功的活动之一。他今年甚至出版了一本关于他旅行经历的书。

transcriptBlocks.english: This year at the exhibition, we are going to give our visitors a chance to show their talents as well. They can bring their own paintings to the show and we will invite some local artists to be the judges. The winner will get, instead of shopping coupons, free tickets to this year's Art Festival which is going to be held in December. I'm sure this is going to be a very exciting game for all art lovers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 今年的展览，我们也打算给参观者一个展示才华的机会。他们可以带自己的画作来参展，我们将邀请一些本地艺术家担任评委。获胜者将获得今年12月举行的艺术节的免费门票，而不是购物券。我相信这对所有艺术爱好者来说将是一场非常激动人心的比赛。

transcriptBlocks.english: OK, let's take a look at this map here, so you will know what you can do here on the ground floor. We are now in the meeting room here at the bottom right hand corner. When you enter from the main gate on Harley Street, you can see a tour operator to your right. You can ask for travel information there. There is a lift in front of you which can take you to the exhibition rooms on the second and third floor. The room next to where we are now is the restroom. If you keep walking towards the north gate, you will find a café to your left, you can relax and have a cup of coffee there. A convenience store will be on the right side.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 好的，让我们看看这里的这张地图，这样你们就知道在一楼可以做什么了。我们现在在右下角的会议室。当你们从哈雷街的正门进入时，右边可以看到一个旅行社。你们可以在那里询问旅行信息。你们面前有一部电梯，可以带你们去二楼和三楼的展览室。我们现在旁边的房间是洗手间。如果你们继续向北门走，你们会在左边找到一家咖啡馆，可以在那里放松喝杯咖啡。便利店在右边。

transcriptBlocks.english: Not far from the café, on the top left corner of the map, you can see a cooking demonstration. If you are a foodie, don't forget to check it out. They will be showing you how to bake cookies and different kinds of bread.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 离咖啡馆不远，在地图左上角，你们可以看到一个烹饪演示。如果你们是美食爱好者，别忘了去看看。他们会展示如何烤饼干和各种面包。

transcriptBlocks.english: Near the lift, to the left, there's an Airline's reception desk where you can ask about flight information. We have a stand where you can see different cultural things and performances from India. You can see it right next to the south entrance, on the left-hand side. The fire exit is right behind it, just in case if you need to use it. But we have security here 24 hours a day, so I'm sure safety problems are not going to happen.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 电梯附近左边有一个航空公司的接待台，你们可以在那里询问航班信息。我们有一个展台，你们可以看到来自印度的不同文化物品和表演。就在南入口旁边，左手边。消防出口就在它后面，以防你们需要使用。但我们这里24小时有保安，所以我确定安全问题不会发生。
