transcriptBlocks.english: Good evening. You are listening to the local radio. Tonight, we will be looking at some international voluntary programs, opportunities for you to help others in different countries.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 晚上好。你们正在收听本地广播。今晚，我们将介绍一些国际志愿项目，你们在不同国家帮助他人的机会。

transcriptBlocks.english: Volunteering is intended to promote goodness or to improve quality of living for those in need. Volunteering not only has positive benefits for the volunteers but also for the person or community served. Let's see what programs there are.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 志愿服务的目的是促进善意或改善有需要者的生活质量。志愿服务不仅对志愿者有积极的好处，对接受服务的个人或社区也有好处。让我们看看有哪些项目。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you are interested in Africa, Explorer International is just for you. It is a program setting up in small villages in Ghana. Your task is to help local people by doing some labor work. Currently, the villagers have difficulty in transporting the goods from trucks to some local residents' houses, because trucks cannot go into some areas where there are no roads. The great thing about this program is that there are a group of old residents in these villages, who are willing to teach you how to make use of herbal medicine.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们对非洲感兴趣，国际探险家项目正适合你们。这是在加纳小村庄设立的项目。你们的任务是通过做一些体力劳动来帮助当地人。目前，村民们很难把货物从卡车上运到一些当地居民家中，因为卡车无法进入一些没有道路的区域。这个项目的好处是，这些村庄里有一群老年居民，他们愿意教你们如何使用草药。

transcriptBlocks.english: Wild Exchange is a program that aims to help tourists get to know the locals and culture in rural areas in South America. So you will have a chance to experience life from locals' perspective. As an exchange, you reshare local culture to tourists. You can even teach them how to do farm work, like feeding the cows. It will be a very rewarding experience.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 野生交流是一个旨在帮助游客了解南美农村地区当地人和文化的项目。所以你们将有机会从当地人的角度体验生活。作为交换，你们向游客重新分享当地文化。你们甚至可以教他们如何做农活，比如喂牛。这将是一次非常有益的经历。

transcriptBlocks.english: Track Abroad is a program based in Nepal. It involves doing chores in local community centers. You can go to the Himalayas with ecological protection teams and help protect the habitat of antelopes that live in the mountains. This is a very exciting program, I'm sure many of you will like it.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 海外足迹是一个设在尼泊尔的项目。它涉及在当地社区中心做杂务。你们可以和生态保护队一起去喜马拉雅山，帮助保护生活在山区的羚羊的栖息地。这是一个非常令人兴奋的项目，我相信你们很多人会喜欢。

transcriptBlocks.english: In a program called Go Adventure, you will have a chance to stay in Tanzania for 2 months. You will be very close to nature. The highlighted part of the program is you will help the scientists to do research about the endangered species in the rainforest. At other times, you will stay on the farms and take care of the animals. A very meaningful job.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在一个叫“去冒险”的项目中，你们将有机会在坦桑尼亚待2个月。你们将非常亲近自然。项目的亮点是你们将帮助科学家研究雨林中的濒危物种。其他时间，你们将待在农场照顾动物。一份非常有意义的工作。

transcriptBlocks.english: And lastly, a program in Thailand called Going Shot will require you to have related qualifications, because you will be demonstrating to the local kids how to do handicrafts such as woodcraft. So, you need to be patient with children and know basic teaching skills.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 最后，泰国一个叫“去射击”的项目要求你们有相关资质，因为你们将向当地孩子展示如何做手工艺，如木工。所以，你们需要对孩子有耐心并了解基本的教学技能。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now, let's listen to the story of Lyra, a university student who did her voluntary work in Sri Lanka last year. She worked in a local zoo last summer holiday. Originally, she thought her job would be repairing the carpets that some animals slept on, because during her interview she said she was good at sewing and knitting. But the zoo management team arranged the job of washing elephants for her. At first, she was quite afraid of doing it. But as she got more experienced, she loved it. She also found that local people respect elephants very much, and they don't ride the elephants.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在，让我们听听莱拉的故事，她是一名大学生，去年在斯里兰卡做志愿工作。她去年暑假在当地一家动物园工作。最初，她以为她的工作是修理一些动物睡觉用的地毯，因为在面试时她说自己擅长缝纫和编织。但动物园管理团队为她安排了洗大象的工作。起初，她非常害怕做这件事。但随着经验增加，她爱上了这份工作。她还发现当地人非常尊重大象，他们不骑大象。

transcriptBlocks.english: Life was not always easy for volunteers, of course. When Lyra first got to Sri Lanka, she was not very used to the food there. Nothing was close to the food made at home. She had stomach problems and had to stay in bed for a couple of days. Luckily, she recovered with the help of local medical workers. Soon, she got into the simple routine of her work and life.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 当然，志愿者的生活并不总是一帆风顺。当莱拉第一次到斯里兰卡时，她不太习惯那里的食物。没有一样食物接近家里做的。她胃出了问题，不得不在床上躺了几天。幸运的是，她在当地医务人员的帮助下康复了。很快，她就适应了简单的工作和生活节奏。

transcriptBlocks.english: Sometimes, the workload was quite heavy, so it couldn't be done by just one person. In order to improve members' enthusiasm and efficiency, the groups were formed based on what the volunteers were interested. People of different ages will work on the same team, regardless of their educational or social background. Lyra's group members were very supportive of her, so there was always someone that could back her up.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 有时，工作量相当大，所以不能只靠一个人完成。为了提高成员的积极性和效率，小组是根据志愿者的兴趣组建的。不同年龄的人将在同一团队工作，不论他们的教育或社会背景如何。莱拉的团队成员非常支持她，所以总有人能支持她。

transcriptBlocks.english: On the weekends, life can be different. Normally, she would work as a guide or go swimming on her own. She would also go to the coastal area with her friends. The area is very beautiful. There were a few means of transportation, and the cheapest way to go was by coach. Every once in a while, she visited the National Park with her neighbors in Sri Lanka.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在周末，生活可能不同。通常，她会做导游或自己去游泳。她还会和朋友一起去沿海地区。那个地区非常美丽。有几种交通方式，最便宜的方式是乘长途汽车。每隔一段时间，她会和斯里兰卡的邻居一起去国家公园。

transcriptBlocks.english: Now whenever Lyra thought of her time in Sri Lanka, she felt that the experience was absolutely memorable. She learned how to take care of elephants and communicate with local people. And she was proud when she talked about her volunteering experience with others, like how she saved a young elephant's life with other medical workers.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 现在每当莱拉想起在斯里兰卡的时光，她觉得那段经历绝对令人难忘。她学会了如何照顾大象和与当地人交流。当她和别人谈起她的志愿经历时，她感到自豪，比如她如何和其他医务人员一起救了一头小象的生命。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good evening. My name is Arthur Jones. I'm very glad to have this opportunity to speak to you over the radio. The host asked me to give a talk about my experience of starting my own business.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 晚上好。我叫亚瑟·琼斯。我很高兴有机会通过广播与你们交流。主持人请我谈谈我创业的经历。

transcriptBlocks.english: I can't say my business is successful, but there are some things that I want to share with you, which I think will be helpful if you want to start your own company.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我不能说我的生意很成功，但有一些事情我想和你们分享，我认为如果你们想创办自己的公司，这些会有所帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: I've talked to many young people and they told me that they are afraid of making mistakes when they start their business. What I want to say is that mistakes are very common, especially when you do something new. Mistakes can actually show you where you need to improve, so you can take actions about them and use the chance to learn new methods. This is a very important attitude you should have. Besides, most mistakes are not that fatal. Don't be too anxious when they occur.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我和很多年轻人谈过，他们告诉我他们害怕创业时犯错。我想说的是，犯错非常常见，尤其是当你做新事情的时候。错误实际上可以告诉你需要改进的地方，所以你可以采取行动并利用机会学习新方法。这是你们应该有的一个重要态度。此外，大多数错误并没有那么致命。当它们发生时不要太焦虑。

transcriptBlocks.english: Next, I want to go on to talk about self-confidence, which is quite important in achieving business success. Being self-confident means that you can have faith in yourself and what you do. Self-confidence can be gained through hard work, even playing sports. However, sometimes self-confidence may make you ignore problems and even cause failure. Business leaders should remain calm and not take impulsive actions.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 接下来，我想继续谈谈自信心，这在取得商业成功中相当重要。自信意味着你对自己和你所做的事情有信心。自信可以通过努力工作获得，甚至通过运动也可以。然而，有时自信可能让你忽视问题，甚至导致失败。企业领导者应保持冷静，不采取冲动行动。

transcriptBlocks.english: I know that when people start their business, they have confusions. They don't know how they can be more professional. They read business journals or watch related videos, but these don't seem to help sometimes. My suggestion is that, instead of aimlessly trying many new things, they should always be committed to their goal. As long as they stick to it, they will not be easily distracted or confused by other things, and they are sure to get better.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我知道当人们开始创业时，他们会感到困惑。他们不知道如何能更专业。他们阅读商业期刊或观看相关视频，但有时这些似乎没有帮助。我的建议是，与其漫无目的地尝试许多新事物，他们应该始终致力于自己的目标。只要坚持，他们就不会轻易被其他事情分散注意力或感到困惑，他们一定会变得更好。

transcriptBlocks.english: We will all meet difficulties, especially at the beginning. We can't always rely on ourselves to solve all the problems. I had a problem with marketing earlier this year, luckily I found an expert to help me deal with it. So, there's always a way, but we should know how and when to seek help from these people.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们都会遇到困难，尤其是在开始的时候。我们不能总是靠自己解决所有问题。今年早些时候我在营销方面遇到了问题，幸运的是我找到了一位专家帮我处理。所以，总有办法，但我们应该知道如何以及何时向这些人寻求帮助。

transcriptBlocks.english: Business leaders have different kinds of styles. Some are very good at public speaking, others are very down to earth and have strong executive skills. But in general, they should be able to win the respect from their employees, so that they can carry out their orders more easily.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 企业领导者有不同的风格。有些人非常擅长公开演讲，另一些人非常务实，有很强的执行力。但总的来说，他们应该能赢得员工的尊重，这样他们就能更容易地执行命令。

transcriptBlocks.english: There are times when a company might face risks. During such times, leaders will need to take prompt actions and they can't always plan for distant future. Leaders should analyze and deal with the risks with caution. If they bare this in mind, there is always a way out.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 公司有时可能面临风险。在这种时候，领导者需要迅速采取行动，他们不能总是为遥远的未来做计划。领导者应该谨慎地分析和处理风险。如果他们牢记这一点，总有出路。

transcriptBlocks.english: At the beginning of my business, I experimented with quite a few strategies, hoping to find out the best solution for my business. Here is what I found. At first, my company wanted to work out prices for the products and make them realistic. However, prices are always changing, so they can't be fixed. Another thing I always keep in mind is that leaders must stay committed to their jobs. Without enough commitment, you may easily give up when problems happen. I have some friends whose businesses didn't survive during difficult times. It wasn't because they were stupid, it was just the lack of commitment.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我创业初期，我尝试了很多策略，希望能找到最适合我公司的解决方案。以下是我的发现。起初，我的公司想制定产品的价格并使其切合实际。然而，价格总是在变化，所以它们不能固定。我始终牢记的另一件事是，领导者必须对自己的工作保持投入。没有足够的投入，当问题发生时你可能轻易放弃。我有一些朋友的企业在困难时期没有存活下来。不是因为他们愚蠢，只是缺乏投入。

transcriptBlocks.english: I can't always be sure that my products or services are better than my competitors', but I pay attention to details, and try to improve all the little things, as they can actually make a big difference.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我不能总是确定我的产品或服务比竞争对手的更好，但我注重细节，努力改进所有小事情，因为它们实际上可以产生很大的不同。

transcriptBlocks.english: You might worry that you don't have a very clear and sophisticated business strategy. Personally, I don't think it's a problem, because you will be changing them all the time anyway.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 你可能会担心你没有非常清晰和复杂的商业策略。就我个人而言，我不认为这是个问题，因为你无论如何都会一直改变它们。

transcriptBlocks.english: In terms of support, at any stage, we do need support from others to back up our business. The support can really make a difference. Before I started my business, my family helped me a lot, both financially and mentally. There were also people who gave me advice on how to run businesses successfully. However, these advice and ideas were not so practical to me, so I didn't really use them. Looking back, I felt lucky that I followed my own way of thinking. Also, I was short of funds back then, and I loaned money from the bank to start my company. I was grateful for that.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在支持方面，在任何阶段，我们确实需要他人的支持来支撑我们的业务。支持真的可以带来改变。在我创业之前，我的家人在经济上和精神上都给了我很大帮助。也有人给了我如何成功经营企业的建议。然而，这些建议和想法对我来说不太实用，所以我并没有真正采用它们。回顾过去，我觉得很幸运，我遵循了自己的思维方式。而且，那时我资金短缺，我从银行贷款创办了我的公司。我对此心存感激。

transcriptBlocks.english: Good morning. Welcome to the local garden exhibition. I'm James Green, one of the organizers of this event.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 早上好。欢迎来到本地花园展览。我是詹姆斯·格林，本次活动的组织者之一。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our aim is to make our visitors better aware of the natural environment around so that more people can make more contribution to our ecological conservation. Today, we have invited representatives from different gardens to our exhibition. And they all have displays of their own feature.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们的目标是让参观者更好地了解周围的自然环境，以便更多的人能为我们的生态保护做出更多贡献。今天，我们邀请了来自不同花园的代表参加我们的展览。他们都有各自特色的展示。

transcriptBlocks.english: There are some activities you can do at our exhibition. If you have brought your children here, you can go to the humming bird costume section. We offer humming bird suits at a low price. So, you can get one for your children. They can wear it and have fun with the other kids there.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在我们的展览中，你们可以参加一些活动。如果你们带了孩子来，可以去蜂鸟服装区。我们以低价提供蜂鸟服装。所以，你们可以为孩子买一套。他们可以穿上它，和其他孩子在那里玩耍。

transcriptBlocks.english: If you are interested in gardening, we have good news for you. In the middle of the exhibition area, we will offer free guidance on how to trim branches, which can show you some useful tips of keeping your plants in order. All you have to do is to put gloves on and follow the direction of our staff. If you haven't brought your own gloves with you, we sell at 2 dollars a pair at the entrance.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 如果你们对园艺感兴趣，我们有好消息要告诉你们。在展览区中央，我们将提供关于如何修剪树枝的免费指导，可以教你们一些保持植物整齐的有用技巧。你们只需要戴上手套，按照我们工作人员的指示操作。如果你们没有自带手套，我们在入口处出售，每双2美元。

transcriptBlocks.english: For insect lovers, we have an interesting activity for you. We have prepared boxes with ladybugs in them. You can set them free. It's very meaningful and I'm sure you will get an unforgettable experience. And you don't need to pay to join the activity. If you want to do it, please sign up quickly because we only have a limited number of boxes.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 对于昆虫爱好者，我们有一个有趣的活动。我们准备了装有瓢虫的盒子。你们可以放生它们。这非常有意义，我相信你们会获得一次难忘的经历。而且参加这个活动不需要付费。如果你们想做，请尽快报名，因为我们的盒子数量有限。

transcriptBlocks.english: To know more about different plants and how to take care of them properly, you can refer to the gardening brochures we have made. There's a complete list of the most popular plants with each brochure. Right now, we are offering a special promotion. So these brochures will not be expensive. You can check them out at the counter near the entrance.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 为了更多了解不同的植物以及如何正确照顾它们，你们可以参考我们制作的园艺手册。每本手册都附有最受欢迎植物的完整列表。现在，我们正在进行特别促销。所以这些手册不会很贵。你们可以在入口附近的柜台查看。

transcriptBlocks.english: Our exhibition also offers voluntary opportunities. If you have some spare time, you can consider joining us. Help is needed in the café, where staff already has their hands full because we have many customers there. Currently, we don't hire volunteers as tour guides as you will need more training for the job. We have enough staff to receive the visitors at the entrance, so you don't need to worry about that. However, we do need volunteers at our gift shops. They're packed with visitors who want to buy something for their friends and family. You can give them shopping advice which also helps our sales. We will need some office helpers after this season, if you have time in the future, feel free to sign up.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我们的展览也提供志愿机会。如果你们有空闲时间，可以考虑加入我们。咖啡馆需要帮助，那里的工作人员已经忙得不可开交，因为我们有很多顾客。目前，我们不招志愿者做导游，因为这份工作需要更多培训。我们有足够的员工在入口接待游客，所以你们不用担心这一点。不过，我们的礼品店确实需要志愿者。那里挤满了想给朋友和家人买东西的游客。你们可以给他们购物建议，这也有助于我们的销售。这个季节之后我们会需要一些办公室帮手，如果将来你们有时间，欢迎报名。

transcriptBlocks.english: As I said earlier, we have some gardens from all over the city here at our exhibition. Now I will introduce what you can see at their display sections.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 正如我之前所说，我们的展览上有来自全市各地的一些花园。现在我将介绍你们在它们的展示区可以看到什么。

transcriptBlocks.english: In Murry Garden, you can see local plants. You might be very familiar with them, but some of the indigenous plants they are showing are not seen very often now because of urbanization. Another reason is many plants we see now are imported. So, I recommend you visit the garden for a better understanding.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在默里花园，你们可以看到本地植物。你们可能对它们非常熟悉，但他们展示的一些本地植物现在不常见了，因为城市化。另一个原因是我们现在看到的许多植物都是进口的。所以，我建议你们参观这个花园以获得更好的了解。

transcriptBlocks.english: Vincent Garden has a collection of plants which can live in dry land with little rainfall. A typical example of the collection is cactus. These plants are both from home and abroad. They don't need special irrigation support. So, it's not hard to grow them.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 文森特花园收集了能在雨量少的干旱土地上生存的植物。其中典型的例子是仙人掌。这些植物既有国产的也有进口的。它们不需要特殊的灌溉支持。所以，种植它们并不难。

transcriptBlocks.english: I know some of you use your garden to grow vegetables. In Smith Garden, you can see plants that can be eaten, including vegetables. There are various kinds, some of which you might have not seen before. You should keep wildlife away when growing these plants, for they can devour your effort.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 我知道你们中有些人用花园种植蔬菜。在史密斯花园，你们可以看到可食用的植物，包括蔬菜。有各种种类，其中一些你们可能以前没见过。种植这些植物时，你们应该让野生动物远离，因为它们会吞噬你们的劳动成果。

transcriptBlocks.english: In Lilian Garden, there are 7 types of grasses which can live in various soil and water conditions. They are actually innovative products which can be a replacement for the grass you use in your yard. I recommend the innovation. You can feel and touch the grass and decide whether you need to make some changes to your lawn.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 在莉莉安花园，有7种草可以在各种土壤和水分条件下生长。它们实际上是创新产品，可以替代你们在院子里使用的草。我推荐这种创新。你们可以感受和触摸这些草，决定是否需要对你们的草坪做一些改变。

transcriptBlocks.english: Cameron Garden features the use of fertilizers, and all of them are organic. They can add nutrients to soil without causing any harm. This characteristic is very important for the health of all plants.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 卡梅伦花园以使用肥料为特色，而且都是有机的。它们可以在不造成任何伤害的情况下为土壤添加养分。这个特性对所有植物的健康都非常重要。

transcriptBlocks.english: Dolly garden is very special, because unlike other gardens which have all kinds of colorful flowers, their flowers are of a single white color. It looks very pure and elegant.
transcriptBlocks.chinese: 多莉花园非常特别，因为与其他拥有各种五颜六色花朵的花园不同，他们的花是单一的白色。看起来非常纯洁和优雅。
